### [1] [Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0: A Unified Multimodal Model for Scalable 3D Generation, Understanding, and Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02711)
*Junliang Ye,Kenkun Liu,Guocun Wang,Yang Li,Yansong Qu,Chunshi Wang,Jingwei Xu,Yunhan Yang,Zibo Zhao,Jiachen Xu,Jiaao Yu,Lifu Wang,Zhihao Liang,Zhuo Chen,Chunchao Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0是一个统一的3D多模态框架，支持3D理解、文生3D、指令引导的3D编辑和文本驱动的部件生成。通过构建8700万规模的3D多模态语料库（含2500万理解样本、5000万文生3D对和1200万编辑对），结合Hunyuan3D-VLM（语义/结构/空间理解）和Hunyuan3D DiT（高保真3D合成），在多项基准上达到领先性能，并通过实验证明生成与理解的联合训练能够互相促进编辑能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一多模态模型在图像生成领域已展现巨大潜力，但统一的3D建模仍受限于稀缺的多模态数据，尤其是缺乏大规模且几何一致的3D编辑数据。作者旨在解决这一数据瓶颈，构建支持理解、生成、编辑和部件生成统一架构的3D模型。

Method: 1) 构建8700万规模的3D多模态语料库，包括2500万理解样本、5000万文生3D对和1200万编辑对（通过Nano3D-v2生成）。2) 架构上结合Hunyuan3D-VLM（负责语义、结构、空间理解）与Hunyuan3D DiT（负责高保真3D合成）。3) VLM为生成提供多模态语义条件，编辑和部件生成进一步以源对象表示作为扩散条件，以保持整体结构和未编辑区域。

Result: 在文生3D生成和3D编辑基准上取得SOTA或领先性能，同时展现出强大的3D理解和部件生成能力。分析表明生成与理解训练共同提升了编辑性能，验证了统一3D多模态训练的有效性。

Conclusion: Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0证明了统一3D多模态训练的有效性——通过大规模数据构建和单一架构设计，3D理解、生成、编辑和部件生成能够相互促进，为未来统一的3D多模态建模提供了可行范式。

Abstract: Recent advances in image generation have demonstrated the potential of unified multimodal models that integrate understanding, generation, and editing. However, unified 3D modeling remains constrained by scarce multimodal data, particularly the lack of large-scale and geometrically consistent editing data. To address this limitation, we propose Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0, a unified framework supporting 3D understanding, text-to-3D generation, instruction-guided 3D editing, and text-grounded part generation within a single architecture. To enable scalable training, we construct an 87M-scale 3D multimodal corpus, comprising 25M understanding samples, 50M text-to-3D pairs, and 12M editing pairs generated using Nano3D-v2. Architecturally, the framework combines Hunyuan3D-VLM for semantic, structural, and spatial understanding with Hunyuan3D DiT for high-fidelity 3D synthesis. The VLM provides multimodal semantic conditions for generation, while editing and part generation additionally condition the diffusion process on the source object representation to preserve its overall structure and unedited regions. Extensive experiments show that Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0 achieves state-of-the-art or leading performance on text-to-3D generation and 3D editing benchmarks, while exhibiting strong understanding and part-generation capabilities. Our analysis further shows that both generation and understanding improve editing, demonstrating the effectiveness of unified 3D multimodal training. Project Page: https://tencent-hunyuan.github.io/Hunyuan3D-Buffalo1.0/

</details>


### [2] [AIDE: Automated Instruction via Distilled Expertise for Reference-Free Motor Skill Coaching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03047)
*Yoshiki Ito*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AIDE框架，一种用于技能动作反馈生成的自动化指令系统。该框架仅在训练阶段利用专家示范，推理时仅需学习者的姿态序列即可生成自然语言反馈，避免了现有方法在训练和推理阶段都需要专家示范的限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成自然语言的动作技能教练反馈可以加速学习，但专家教练稀缺且昂贵。现有的基于参考（reference-based）方法在训练和推理时都需要专家示范，这限制了实际部署的可行性。因此需要一个仅依赖学习者数据即可在推理时生成反馈的框架。

Method: AIDE采用教师-学生（teacher-student）两阶段蒸馏架构。教师模型通过冻结的语言模型从配对的（学习者-专家）姿态中学习生成反馈，并产生分离的学习者令牌（learner tokens）和差异令牌（difference tokens）来编码学习者与专家的差异。学生模型继承教师的编码器和权重初始化，用一个辅助模块替代显式的专家对比，仅从学习者的姿态序列生成互补令牌。

Result: 在ExpertAF数据集上，AIDE在多数指标上优于无参考（reference-free）基线，并与需要在训练和推理阶段都使用专家示范的方法表现相当。LLM-based评估结果也支持了这些发现。

Conclusion: AIDE证明可以通过知识蒸馏将专家信息压缩到学生模型中，实现在推理阶段无需专家示范即可生成高质量动作反馈，为动作技能学习反馈生成的可扩展部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Generating natural-language coaching feedback on motor skills can accelerate learning, yet expert coaches are scarce and expensive. Existing reference-based methods require expert demonstrations at both training and inference time, limiting practical deployment. We propose AIDE (Automated Instruction via Distilled Expertise), a framework that exploits expert references only during training and generates feedback from a learner's pose sequence alone at inference. A teacher model first learns to generate feedback from paired learner-expert poses via a frozen language model, producing separate learner tokens and difference tokens that encode the learner-expert difference. A student model then inherits the teacher's encoder and weight initialization, replacing the explicit expert comparison with an auxiliary module that produces complementary tokens from the learner's pose alone. On the ExpertAF dataset, AIDE outperforms reference-free baselines on most metrics and performs comparably to methods requiring expert demonstrations at both training and inference, with LLM-based evaluation supporting these findings.

</details>


### [3] [Quo Vadis, World Modeling?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02713)
*Yu Yang,Xuemeng Yang,Licheng Wen,Lingdong Kong,Xiaobin Hu,Dongyue Lu,Wei Chow,Xiyan Huang,Yuxiang Feng,Yue Liao,Jianbiao Mei,Daocheng Fu,Rong Wu,Pinlong Cai,Ran Yi,Ying Tai,Jiangning Zhang,Botian Shi,Yong Liu,Shuicheng Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"以智能体为中心的交互式世界代理"（Agent-Centric Interactive World Proxies）这一新范式，将世界建模从传统的物理状态预测扩展到智能体可用信息的转换，并系统性地将世界代理组织为六种功能形式（动力学、空间、执行、记忆/经验、技能、奖励/验证代理），同时提出三个渐进层次（推理时引导、训练时优化、代理-代理共同进化）来说明这些代理如何赋能智能体的持续改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体持续改进需要动态交互反馈，但真实环境交互成本高、速度慢、不安全且难以并行化。传统世界模型主要预测未来物理状态，这种表述对需要超越原始状态转换的可操作反馈的智能体而言过于狭窄。因此需要一个更广义的世界建模范式来提供多样化的反馈。

Method: 作者提出了Agent-Centric Interactive World Proxies概念，将范式从物理状态转换转变为智能体可用信息转换（如执行结果、检索经验或技能、验证信号）。他们设计了系统性分类框架：六种功能形式（动力学、空间、执行、记忆/经验、技能、奖励/验证代理）和三个赋能层次（L1推理时引导、L2训练时优化、L3代理-代理共同进化）。

Result: 本文提供了一种系统化的世界代理设计空间映射，展示了世界代理如何通过六种反馈模态和三个赋能层次来服务于智能体的持续改进，建立了一条构建世界代理的路线图。

Conclusion: 这项工作将世界建模重新定位为以智能体为中心的范式，为构建能够帮助智能体更好地规划、更快学习和持续进化的世界代理奠定了路线图。

Abstract: Continually improving agents require dynamic interaction feedback beyond static supervision, yet direct real-environment interaction is costly, slow, unsafe, and hard to parallelize. World modeling offers a natural intermediate proxy that allows agents to query lower-cost, more controllable feedback before committing to real actions. Classical world models instantiate this proxy primarily through future physical-state prediction, a formulation useful yet narrow for agents that require actionable feedback beyond raw state transitions. In this work, we conceptualize Agent-Centric Interactive World Proxies, shifting the fundamental paradigm from physical state transitions to agent-usable information transitions, such as execution outcomes, retrieved experiences or skills, and verification signals, broadening the scope of world modeling to provide versatile feedback for continually improving agents. To systematically map this design space, we organize world proxies into six functional forms based on their feedback modalities: dynamics, spatial, execution, memory/experience, skill, and reward/verification proxies, which together characterize the primary ways world modeling serves agent improvement. We further analyze how these proxies empower agents across three progressive levels: L.1 Inference-Time Guidance, where proxy outputs enrich in-context information for superior decisions; L.2 Training-Time Optimization, where proxy outputs yield rewards, critiques, or synthetic rollouts for policy learning; and L.3 Agent-Proxy Co-Evolution, where real-environment evidence continuously updates both the proxy and the agent for co-evolution. Ultimately, this work recasts world modeling into an agent-centric paradigm, establishing a roadmap for building world proxies that empower agents to plan better, learn faster, and evolve continually.

</details>


### [4] [Oh Deer, How Should I Handle This? Seasonal Priors for Selective Wildlife Annotation and Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02762)
*Hugo Markoff,Christoph Praschl,Anton Hjalte Jørgensen,Christian Emil Mogensen,Mathias Bech Skadhauge,Sara Beery,Michael Ørsted,David C. Schedl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究航空影像中红鹿成年雄性细粒度分类问题，提出基于鹿角周期的季节性日历框架，将季节性结构与标注质量、下游分类和选择性预测相关联。多模态（RGB+热成像）联合标注能恢复单一模态遗漏的标签，软季节性先验主要改进热成像视图性能，不确定性带弃权策略可将覆盖准确率提升至98.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度野生动物分类在航空影像中面临两大限制：模型性能不足和标签不可靠。动物仅占少量像素、视觉线索随季节变化、单一模态证据具有歧义性，这些问题导致标注和预测在特定时期均不可靠，亟需结合生物学先验来指导标注协议设计。

Method: 利用红鹿鹿角周期定义可靠的证据窗口，构建季节性日历框架。数据集包含7,295个RGB-only、thermal-only和RGB+thermal匹配裁剪集，由3名标注者标注。通过季节结构与三类任务（标注质量、下游分类、选择性预测）的关联分析，结合软季节性先验和多模态融合以及不确定性带弃权策略进行实验。

Result: RGB+热成像匹配联合审查比任一单一模态能解决更多样本，在人工和模型分类中都能恢复单模态遗漏的多数雄性标签。高标注弃权月份对应较低分类器置信度。软季节性先验主要有利于受季节限制的热成像视图。不确定性带弃权将覆盖准确率提升至98.9%，但覆盖率下降且弃权不成比例地落在雄性样本上。

Conclusion: 基于生物学的季节性日历能够预测标注和预测不可靠的区域，指导标注协议设计和模态权重分配，为野生动物细粒度分类提供了一种结合领域先验的系统性解决方案。

Abstract: Fine-grained wildlife classification in aerial imagery is limited not only by model performance, but also by unreliable labels: animals occupy few pixels, key visual cues vary seasonally, and modality-specific evidence can be ambiguous. We study adult-male identification in red deer, where the antler cycle defines predictable windows of reliable evidence for both annotation and prediction. Using 7,295 RGB-only, thermal-only, and matched RGB+thermal crop sets labeled by three annotators, we show that seasonal structure links (I) annotation quality, (II) downstream classification, and (III) selective prediction. Matched RGB+thermal review resolves more samples than either single modality, recovering majority-male labels otherwise missed by RGB or thermal alone, in human based as well as model based classification. Months with high annotator abstention also show lower classifier confidence, and soft seasonal priors mainly benefit the season-limited thermal view. Uncertainty-band abstention further improves covered accuracy up to 98.9%, though at reduced coverage and with deferral that falls disproportionately on males. Overall, a biologically grounded seasonal calendar predicts where annotation and prediction are unreliable, and can guide both annotation protocol design and modality weighting.

</details>


### [5] [Confident but Unreliable: A Behavioral Safety Audit of Vision-Language Models on Brain MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02790)
*Amir Sabbaghziarani,Mohammadsajad Abavisani,Sergey Plis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过脑MRI作为受控测试平台，对六个指令微调视觉语言模型（VLM）进行行为审计，发现模型虽然答案覆盖面近乎完整，但口头化置信度校准很差（ECE 0.27-0.40），33-46%的回答是高置信度错误，最准确的模型反而对其错误最为自信。医学适应能提升肿瘤检测能力但不能改善置信度可靠性，因此主张医学图像VLM评估应同时报告置信度可靠性、自信错误、幻觉和弃答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（包括医学专科模型）越来越多地应用于医学影像，但其声称的置信度很少与正确性分开评估。在脑MRI这一高风险场景中，模型可能表现得能力胜任却缺乏可靠的自我认知，这种"表面能力"的失败模式需要被系统性地审计和暴露。

Method: 对六个指令微调VLM（五个通用+一个医学专科）进行自动评分的行为审计，使用4,102张图像（4,032张来自250名受试者的轴向/冠状/矢状MRI切片+70张非脑/噪声控制图）。标签来源于公开元数据和专家分割掩码而非新的人工标注。评估指标包括答案覆盖率、ECE校准误差、错误答案上的平均置信度、高置信度错误比例，并对比基础/专科模型家族的差异。

Result: 所有模型答案覆盖率接近完整，但置信度校准差：ECE范围0.27-0.40，错误答案上的平均置信度0.82-0.97，33-46%的回答是高置信度错误。最准确的模型也是其错误上最自信的模型；医学适应改善了肿瘤检测但未改善置信度可靠性。开放式诊断显示幻觉和弃答与多项选择准确率是独立变化的维度。

Conclusion: 医学影像VLM评估不应仅报告准确率，还应报告口头化置信度可靠性、高置信度错误率、幻觉率和弃答率。这些发现揭示了一个更广泛的失败模式：前沿多模态系统可能表现称职但缺乏可靠的自我知识。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs), including medical specialists, are increasingly proposed for medical imaging, yet their stated confidence is rarely evaluated separately from correctness. We use brain MRI as a controlled, high-stakes testbed for a broader failure mode in frontier multimodal systems: models can appear competent while lacking reliable self-knowledge. We present an automatically graded behavioral audit and pilot study of six instruction-tuned VLMs (five general-purpose and one medical specialist) on 4,102 images (4,032 axial/coronal/sagittal MRI slices from 250 subjects plus 70 non-brain/noise controls), with labels derived from public metadata and released expert segmentation masks rather than new human annotation.
  Across models, answer coverage is near-complete, but verbalized-confidence calibration is poor: ECE ranges from 0.27 to 0.40, mean confidence on incorrect answers ranges from 0.82 to 0.97, and 33-46% of answered items are high-confidence errors. The most accurate model is also the most confident on its errors, while a base/specialist family contrast suggests that medical adaptation improves tumor-presence detection without improving confidence reliability. Open-ended diagnostics further show that hallucination and abstention vary separately from multiple-choice accuracy. These findings argue that medical-image VLM evaluation should report verbalized-confidence reliability, confident error, hallucination, and abstention alongside accuracy.

</details>


### [6] [Better, Stronger, Faster, and Broader: Structured All-Mask Prediction for MLLM-Based Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02791)
*Jiazhen Liu,Mingkuan Feng,Long Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出All-Mask Prediction框架，通过将自回归对话与非自回归掩码预测解耦，解决MLLM分割中的"三重困境"（高性能分割、保持对话能力、快速推理）。其二元实例STAMP使用<SEG>触发词和混合注意力一次性完成前景/背景分类；而结构化的STAMPlus进一步生成带ID的目标列表，将多个目标绑定到共享的多类掩码空间，实现单次非自回归预测所有目标。STAMPlus在指代分割、推理分割、开放词汇语义分割、实例感知分割和遥感小目标分割中均达到SOTA性能，同时保持对话能力并将12类分割延迟从13.50秒降至5.16秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的MLLM分割方法面临三重困境：嵌入预测方法虽分割性能好但像素级目标可能干扰语言建模；自回归next-token生成虽然保持对话能力但生成稠密掩码效率低下。需要一种方法同时兼顾分割性能、对话保持和推理速度。

Method: 1) All-Mask Prediction框架：将自回归对话与非自回归掩码预测解耦。2) STAMP（二元版本）：生成<SEG>触发词，融合图像对齐的掩码token与补丁特征，使用混合注意力一次性分类所有token为前景/背景。3) STAMPlus（结构化版本）：生成带ID和可选框的目标列表，将ID绑定到共享多类掩码空间，一次非自回归预测所有目标；高分辨率掩码token缩放保留精细空间证据。

Result: STAMPlus在指代分割、推理分割、开放词汇语义分割、实例感知分割和遥感小目标分割等场景中均达到SOTA性能；保持通用多模态指令跟随能力；12类分割延迟从13.50秒（重复STAMP推理）降至5.16秒。分析还表明准确的目标线索能改善分割，学习到的空间grounding有利于look-twice推理。

Conclusion: STAMPlus通过单一统一checkpoint同时保留了STAMP的指代和推理分割能力，扩展到更多分割场景，成功解决了超越单目标预测的三重困境，证明了"解耦自回归对话与非自回归掩码预测"这一设计范式的有效性。

Abstract: MLLM-based segmentation faces a core segmentation trilemma: high segmentation performance, preserved dialogue ability, and fast inference. Embedding-prediction methods may disrupt language modeling through pixel-level objectives, whereas next-token generation is inefficient for dense masks. We propose All-Mask Prediction, decoupling autoregressive dialogue from non-autoregressive mask prediction. Its binary instantiation, STAMP (Simultaneous Textual All-Mask Prediction), emits an in-vocabulary <SEG> trigger, fuses image-aligned mask tokens with corresponding patch features, and uses hybrid attention to classify all tokens as foreground or background in one pass. It thereby combines strong referring and reasoning segmentation with preserved multimodal ability and efficient inference. However, binary masks cannot retain multiple semantic or instance identities without repeated target-specific predictions. We therefore propose Structured All-Mask Prediction and develop STAMPlus. It generates a target list with explicit IDs and optional boxes, binds these IDs to a shared multi-class mask space, and jointly predicts all targets in one non-autoregressive pass. A single unified checkpoint retains STAMP's referring and reasoning capabilities while extending to open-vocabulary semantic, instance-aware, and remote-sensing small-target segmentation, where high-resolution mask-token scaling preserves finer spatial evidence. Across these settings, STAMPlus achieves state-of-the-art segmentation performance, preserves general multimodal instruction following, and reduces 12-category latency from 13.50s for repeated STAMP inference to 5.16s. Further analyses show that accurate target cues improve segmentation and learned spatial grounding benefits look-twice reasoning. Overall, STAMPlus resolves the trilemma beyond single-target prediction.

</details>


### [7] [PixelUp: Zero-Shot Semantic Feature Upsampling for Fine-Grained Vision Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02792)
*Deepank Singh,Anurag Nihal,Vedhus Hoskere*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PixelUp是一种零样本、与VFM无关的上采样器，通过粗到细的窗口交叉注意力架构结合多尺度语义特征，实现对patch-token级别特征的像素级细化，在语义分割和深度估计等密集预测任务上显著优于现有的VFM专用和VFM无关上采样方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督视觉基础模型（VFMs）的patch-token特征过于粗糙，难以满足语义分割和深度估计等密集预测任务对精细像素级预测的需求。现有方法存在局限：可学习上采样器通常针对特定编码器设计，需要为不同编码器重新训练；图像引导方法使用浅层像素编码器，会引入纹理伪影且缺乏语义引导。

Method: 提出了PixelUp，一种零样本、VFM无关的上采样器。核心架构是粗到细的窗口交叉注意力链，由多尺度语义特征引导，以逐步恢复像素级细节并保持语义一致性。该方法不需要针对不同VFM重新训练，具备跨模型泛化能力。

Abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have achieved remarkable success on images and short videos, yet scaling them to long videos remains challenging due to frame-centric tokenization and limited context windows. 3D geometry provides a natural compression mechanism for visual streams: depth and camera pose enable observations from multiple views and time steps to be fused into a persistent, world-aligned representation. While recent 3D LMMs leverage geometry-aware representations to improve spatial reasoning, they continue to lag behind specialist 3D perception systems on grounding and segmentation tasks. We argue that a key limitation is geometry-aware decoding: existing methods communicate 3D predictions through language tokens, proposal selection, or lightweight grounding queries, creating a bottleneck between language reasoning and dense geometric prediction. Qwen-3D augments visual tokens with 3D Rotary Positional Embeddings, allowing attention to operate directly in 3D scene space rather than across independent image frames and thereby facilitating scalable cross-view and temporal reasoning. To bridge language and geometry, Qwen-3D incorporates a query-based segmentation decoder that grounds language directly in the underlying 3D scene representation, unifying referential grounding, instance segmentation, and visual question answering across both images and videos. Across a diverse set of benchmarks, Qwen-3D surpasses existing 3D LMMs and outperforms several large proprietary 2D models. Abstract: As generated videos become increasingly realistic, reliable video forgery detection is increasingly important. Abstract: Accurate chest X-ray interpretation is inherently hierarchical. Clinical decisions depend not only on what abnormality is present but where it is situated, requiring reasoning from broad anatomical systems down to specific pathological findings. Motivation: 遥感语义分割受限于像素级标注成本高昂，因此需要免训练（training-free）的开放词汇方法。虽然DINOv3的发布带来了具备开放词汇分割潜能的DINO.txt模块，但现有DINO系列模型在免训练开放词汇分割领域仍存在空白，且遥感图像具有密集分布、多尺度和大幅面的特点，需要专门适配。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Static quantization assigns one weight precision to every denoising step. To preserve quality, that precision must accommodate the most quantization-sensitive step, even though many other steps can tolerate fewer bits. The resulting model may satisfy its memory budget, but it repeatedly pays worst-case arithmetic throughout the denoising trajectory. We introduce Temporal-Adaptive Bit Sparsification Quantization (TASQ) to separate these two costs. TASQ stores one shared maximum-precision weight buffer and learns a Temporal-Spatial LSB Mask that selects a lower effective precision for each layer and denoising stage by truncating least-significant bits. Storage therefore remains fixed by the worst case, while BitOPs decrease at less sensitive stages without per-stage weight copies or runtime search. A Temporal-Precision Engine maps the learned schedule to bit-serial execution, where cycles scale with effective precision and switching precision has no measured cycle overhead. On PixArt-Sigma, SANA-1.6B, and SDXL-Turbo, TASQ achieves quality comparable to static quantization with less computation. Together with the Temporal-Precision Engine, it reduces execution cycles by 25 to 50 percent over static quantization and by 6.1 to 7.5x over a naive static 8-bit bit-serial execution. </details>


### [25] [RIDGE: Re-Noising with Internal Dynamic Guidance for Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03059)
*Ruiliang Gong,Zhen Wang,Yanghao Wang,Long Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RIDGE是一种免反演、免训练的基于流的图像编辑方法，通过"重新加噪"内部动态指导机制，在无需外部分割模型的情况下，在保持源图像语义和实现目标编辑之间取得更好的平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的免反演流式图像编辑方法虽然避免了隐空间反演，但仍需要在每个编辑步骤中使用目标侧状态。常用的等位移构造方法在不同噪声水平下保持噪声源状态与目标侧状态之间的位移不变，这与加噪过程的自然规律不一致——当噪声水平增加时，两个干净状态在相同噪声水平和噪声样本下的位移应当收缩。这种不一致导致在高噪声水平下产生过于激进的更新，影响编辑质量。

Method: RIDGE将编辑状态视为对不可用的干净目标状态的逐步逼近。具体而言：(1) 使用与干净源状态相同的噪声水平和噪声样本对逼近状态重新加噪，使噪声位移随噪声增加自然减小；(2) 在早期高噪声步骤中应用内部动态指导，利用模型内部生成的干净目标状态预测和软动态掩码，聚焦于需要修改的区域，无需外部分割或检测模型。

Result: 在两个基准测试上使用SD3 Medium和FLUX.1-dev两个骨干模型进行实验，结果表明RIDGE在源图像保持、目标对齐和感知质量之间提供了更优的聚合权衡。

Conclusion: RIDGE通过重新加噪和内部动态指导解决了等位移构造的固有缺陷，在保持源图像信息的同时更自然地引导编辑过程，且无需训练和外部模型辅助，是一种高效且泛化性强的图像编辑方法。

Abstract: Inversion-free flow-based image editing avoids latent inversion, but still requires a target-side state at every editing step. The widely used equal-displacement construction keeps the displacement between the noisy source state and the target-side state unchanged across noise levels. This is inconsistent with noising, under which the displacement between two clean states noised with the same noise level and noise sample should contract as the noise level increases. Thus, it can lead to overly aggressive updates at high noise levels. We introduce RIDGE: Re-Noising with Internal Dynamic Guidance for Image Editing, an inversion-free and training-free method that maintains the edited state as an evolving approximation to the unavailable clean target state. RIDGE re-noises this approximation using the same noise level and noise sample as the clean source state, allowing their noisy displacement to decrease naturally with increasing noise. Since the edited state initially contains limited target semantics, RIDGE further applies internal dynamic guidance during the early high-noise steps. A clean target state prediction guides the provisional edited state through a soft dynamic mask derived internally from the model, focusing guidance on regions that require modification without external segmentation or detection models. Experiments on two benchmarks using two backbones, SD3 Medium and FLUX.1-dev, show that RIDGE offers a favorable aggregate trade-off among source preservation, target alignment, and perceptual quality.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法大多隐式建模物体间关系，或依赖局部成对约束和局部优化，与全局、高度非凸的布局空间不匹配，导致生成的场景虽然局部合理但全局不一致或物理上不可行。

Abstract: We study open-vocabulary 3D indoor layout generation, which synthesizes diverse and physically plausible scenes from unlabeled 3D assets using free-form language instructions. Recent methods leverage large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) to generate structured scenes from text. However, most model inter-asset relations implicitly or rely on local pairwise constraints and local optimization. These formulations are poorly aligned with the global, highly non-convex layout space, often yielding locally plausible yet globally inconsistent or physically infeasible scenes. We address this problem with a graph-based intermediate representation that separates semantic coherence from physical feasibility, together with a hybrid search-and-refinement strategy. First, Global Semantic Verification (GSV) represents scenes as structured graphs and enforces semantic constraints through rule-based verification. This explicit validation removes contradictory configurations and produces a globally consistent semantic scaffold. Second, Global Physical Feasibility Search (GPFS) combines evolutionary search for global exploration with gradient-based refinement for local exploitation. It reduces dependence on VLM-proposed initialization and improves robustness in non-convex and discontinuous feasible spaces. Together, GSV and GPFS move layout generation beyond local relational modeling and initialization-sensitive optimization toward globally consistent reasoning and search. Experiments show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in open-vocabulary 3D indoor layout generation, improving both semantic consistency and physical plausibility.

</details>

*Huanglong Ji,Botong Zhao,Shujing Lv,Yue Lv*

Main category: cs.CV

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 构建LDU-Bench基准：基于真实光刻和集成电路审核图像，将审核工作流分解为四个独立任务（缺陷分诊、形态识别、粗定位、图像条件原因分析），采用任务级指标、诊断读数和LCS评分进行系统评估。

Conclusion: LDU-Bench提供了一个可量化、可诊断的统一平台，用于评估工业MLLM在光刻审核链路中的可用性、失败点和能力边界。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models have demonstrated strong defect recognition capability in industrial anomaly detection. However, in lithography review, merely determining whether an image contains a defect is insufficient for engineering inspection; models must also understand defect morphology, spatial location, and the potential causes supported by visible evidence. To this end, this paper proposes LDU-Bench, a multi-task multimodal benchmark for lithography defect understanding. Constructed from real lithography and integrated-circuit review images, LDU-Bench decomposes the review workflow into four independent tasks: defect triage, morphology recognition, coarse localization, and image-conditioned cause analysis. It systematically evaluates models using task-level metrics, diagnostic readouts, and the Lithography Closure Score (LCS). Experimental results show that although existing MLLMs can perform defect triage relatively reliably, this ability does not stably transfer to downstream review stages. Morphology alignment, effective localization, and evidence-to-cause mapping remain the major bottlenecks. Further diagnostics indicate that this capability break is not a fluctuation of a single metric, but reflects insufficient structured understanding across semantic levels. Overall, LDU-Bench provides a quantifiable and diagnostic unified platform for evaluating the usability, failure points, and capability boundaries of industrial MLLMs in lithography review chains.

</details>

Abstract: Breast core needle biopsy (CNB) is central to breast cancer diagnosis yet remains challenging because limited tissue sampling, lesion heterogeneity, and subtle morphologic overlap can obscure subtype distinctions. We developed CorePath, a breast-specialized multimodal pathology foundation model fine-tuned from PRISM using 7901 paired CNB whole-slide images and diagnostic reports from two centers. CorePath-CRG achieved zero non-breast hallucinations among released outputs and showed the strongest overall performance in pathologist-validated LLM-based Evaluation Scores and quantitative report-generation metrics across most centers. Abstract: Recent advances in Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have enabled remarkable progress in visual synthesis, benefiting from their superior scalability. To facilitate DiTs' capability of capturing meaningful internal representations, recent works such as REPA incorporate external pretrained encoders for representation alignment. Specifically, we introduce a novel metric, termed the Weighted Diversity Score (WDS), to measure the representational discrepancies across different blocks. Through extensive investigations on the evolution and influence of internal representations under various settings, we reveal that representation diversity across blocks is a critical factor for effective representation learning in DiTs. More importantly, WDS exhibits a strong correlation with synthesis quality across diverse settings, model scales, and training stages (Pearson's $r=-0.869$ with $\log(\text{FID})$), suggesting its potential as an indicator to reflect model performance and a principled guide for model optimization. *Mengjie Zhang,Qihui Zhu,Tao Zhang,Shuangwu Chen,Huihuang Qin,Yu Guo,Shenghao Ye,Zijian Wen,Yunpeng Hou,Dong Jin,Xiaobin Tan,Huasen He,Jian Yang*

Method: GSTEP将视频视为连续的时空信息流，通过两个关键组件构建token级时空密度：1) 连续时间密度，由平滑化的帧级变化信号得到；2) 帧内空间密度。随后通过联合平衡信息密度与覆盖率来进行全局token采样，实现全局剪枝。该框架为即插即用设计，可适配多种VideoLLMs。

Result: 在多个VideoLLMs和公开基准上进行了广泛实验，GSTEP持续实现强精度的精度-效率权衡，并能跨模型架构和评估设置泛化。在LLaVA-OneVision-7B上，剪除75%视觉token后保留了100.2%的原始平均性能，并实现1.17倍端到端加速。

Conclusion: GSTEP通过全局时空密度建模替代段级局部剪枝，有效解决了局部剪枝对语义密集短片段和全局关键token的欠保留问题，展示了良好的通用性和实际部署潜力。

Abstract: Video large language models (VideoLLMs) achieve strong video understanding performance, but their inference remains expensive due to the large number of redundant spatio-temporal visual tokens in long videos. Existing token pruning methods alleviate this cost by reducing redundant tokens, yet most of them rely on segment-level local pruning, where videos are partitioned into isolated segments and tokens are selected independently within each segment. To address this issue, we propose GSTEP (Global Spatio-Temporal Density Pruning), a plug-and-play pruning framework that models video as a continuous spatio-temporal information flow. GSTEP constructs a token-level spatio-temporal density by combining a continuous temporal density, obtained from a smoothed centered frame-level change signal, with intra-frame spatial density, and then performs global token sampling by jointly balancing information density and coverage. Extensive experiments on multiple VideoLLMs and public benchmarks demonstrate that GSTEP consistently achieves strong accuracy-efficiency trade-offs and generalizes well across model architectures and evaluation settings. On LLaVA-OneVision-7B, GSTEP prunes 75% of visual tokens, preserves up to 100.2% of the original average performance across benchmarks, and achieves a 1.17 end-to-end speedup.

</details>

TL;DR: SUV是一个统一的端到端驾驶框架，将未来场景理解建模为视频生成任务，利用预训练视频基础模型同时预测未来外观、语义、相对深度和实例级动态四种视频流，并通过联合视频-动作注意力机制生成自车轨迹，在NAVSIM-v2和WOD-E2E基准上取得领先性能。

Abstract: End-to-end driving requires a coherent understanding of future scenes, yet existing methods model these scenes using task-specific heads and output formats, with limited scalability. Can video generation instead provide a shared predictor? We introduce SUV, a unified end-to-end driving framework that casts future Scene Understanding as Video generation using a pretrained video foundation model. SUV models future appearance, semantics, relative depth, and instance-level dynamics as video streams with a shared video expert, without stream-specific visual prediction heads. Through joint video-action attention, the action expert attends to the latent representations of all future streams and generates the ego trajectory. Experiments show that SUV directly predicts all four future streams, while controlled ablations show that structured future supervision and direct future-stream access yield higher trajectory planning scores. With only a single front camera and no candidate-trajectory selection, SUV outperforms a broad set of recent state-of-the-art methods on both NAVSIM-v2 splits, achieving 91.0 EPDMS on navtest and 36.9 on navhard. On the long-tail WOD-E2E benchmark, SUV achieves a competitive RFS of 7.94.

</details>


### [32] [Channel-wise Dynamic Knowledge Distillation via Adaptive Sample Generation for Action Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03100)
*Ping Li,Chenhao Ping,Jie Song,Mingli Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种自适应样本感知的通道动态（ASCD）知识蒸馏方法，通过自适应样本生成模块和通道级动态蒸馏模块，解决现有动作识别模型KD方法中特征对齐不佳和蒸馏强度设置不合理的问题，在三个视频基准和两个图像数据集上取得了最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏方法在压缩大规模动作识别模型时存在两个关键局限：1）依赖固定输入样本，导致教师（大模型）与学生（小模型）之间特征对齐次优；2）对所有通道施加统一的蒸馏强度，未能考虑不同通道在捕获不同知识（如运动节奏或幅度）时的重要性差异。

Method: 提出两阶段的ASCD方法：第一阶段，使用自适应样本生成模块，通过最小化由各层通道质心频率差异加权的特征损失导出样本梯度，并利用这些梯度创建更新样本；同时应用高斯掩码于频率特征以保留关键运动相关细节。第二阶段，采用通道级动态蒸馏模块，在生成的样本上训练学生模型，由样本梯度和特征频率引导。为提升效率，样本采用周期性更新而非每epoch更新。

Result: 在三个视频基准（UCF101、Kinetics-400、Something-Something-v2）和两个图像数据集（CIFAR-100、ImageNet）上的大量实验证明了该方法达到了最先进的性能。

Conclusion: ASCD通过自适应样本生成和通道级动态蒸馏，有效解决了动作识别模型KD中的特征对齐和蒸馏强度分配问题，在视频和图像任务上均展现出优异的泛化能力。

Abstract: Knowledge Distillation (KD) offers a promising yet underexplored path for compressing large action recognition models. However, existing KD methods suffer from two key limitations: 1) reliance on fixed input samples leads to suboptimal feature alignment between the frozen teacher (larger model) and the learnable student (smaller model), and 2) applying a uniform distillation strength for all channels fails to account for their varying importance in capturing distinct knowledge (e.g., motion tempo or magnitude) across training epochs. This motivates us to develop an Adaptive Sample-aware Channel-wise Dynamic (ASCD) KD approach, which operates in two stages. First, we use an adaptive sample generation module to create updated samples by incorporating semantics from sample gradients, which are derived by minimizing a feature loss weighted by channel centroid frequency differences at each layer. Meanwhile, crucial motion-related details are preserved by applying a Gaussian mask to frequency features. Second, we employ a channel-wise dynamic distillation module to train student on these generated samples, guided by sample gradients and feature frequencies. For efficiency, samples are updated periodically rather than per epoch. Extensive experiments on three video benchmarks (UCF101, Kinetics-400, Something-Something-v2) and two image datasets (CIFAR-100, ImageNet) demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of our method. Code is available at https://github.com/mlvccn/ASCD_KD_Action.

</details>


### [33] [Double Down on Defense: Strengthening Deep Perceptual Hashes against Evasion Attacks without Retraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03101)
*Bangjie Sun,Nayoung Kim,Mun Choon Chan,Jun Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DualShield是一种即插即用的防御方法，用于增强深度感知哈希在近似重复图像匹配中的鲁棒性。它结合匹配时的随机平滑和发布时的图像硬化（添加不可感知的扰动），无需重新训练或修改底层模型，即可在保持低碰撞率的同时显著降低对抗攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度感知哈希广泛应用于信任与安全、版权执法和大规模视觉搜索等领域，但对抗性扰动可使近似重复图像绕过匹配检测。现有方法缺乏针对感知哈希的鲁棒性保障，且重新训练模型成本高昂。

Method: DualShield由两个互补机制组成：(1) 匹配时随机平滑（matching-time randomized smoothing），对参考查询对进行扰动聚合决策；(2) 发布时硬化（publication-time hardening），在参考图像发布前添加优化过的不可感知扰动。两者结合提供认证鲁棒性和经验鲁棒性。

Result: DualShield实现了约0.3的认证l2半径，保证该半径内的查询扰动无法绕过匹配。在8种深度感知哈希和3个数据集上，针对自适应白盒、黑盒和图像变换攻击，DualShield大幅降低了攻击成功率，同时保持了低碰撞率。

Conclusion: 深度感知哈希可以通过改进匹配流程和在发布前硬化参考图像来增强鲁棒性，而无需昂贵的重新训练。DualShield证明了这种即插即用防御方法的有效性。

Abstract: Near-duplicate image matching is crucial for trust and safety, provenance verification, copyright enforcement, and large-scale visual search. Modern platforms increasingly rely on deep perceptual hashes, which map visually similar images to nearby representations despite common image transformations. However, adversarial perturbations can cause near-duplicates to evade matching. We present DualShield, a plug-in defense that improves the robustness of existing deep perceptual hashes without retraining or modifying their underlying models. DualShield combines matching-time randomized smoothing, which aggregates decisions over perturbed reference-query pairs, with publication-time hardening, which adds an optimized imperceptible perturbation to each reference image before publication. Together, these mechanisms provide certified and empirical robustness. DualShield achieves a certified $\ell_2$ radius of approximately 0.3, guaranteeing that query perturbations within this radius cannot evade matching. We further evaluate it against adaptive white-box, black-box, and image-transformation attacks. Across eight deep perceptual hashes and three datasets, DualShield substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving low collision rates. These results show that deep perceptual hashes can be strengthened without costly retraining by improving the matching procedure and hardening reference images before publication.

</details>


### [34] [FaithIR: Rethinking Infrared Image Super-Resolution from Perceptual Sharpness to Task Relevant Fidelity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03106)
*Axi Niu,Zhenguo Wu,Kang Zhang,Qingsen Yan,Jinqiu Sun,Yanning Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FaithIR框架，用于红外图像超分辨率，通过结合patch级条件分支（捕获全局热力学和结构信息）和像素级重建分支（在结构引导下进行密集局部重建），直接在像素域完成恢复，以保留红外特有结构和任务相关信息。实验在FLIR-IISR、M3FD和FMB数据集上展示了强的重建保真度、跨数据集泛化能力以及目标检测和语义分割的优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有红外超分辨率方法常常产生人工纹理、过度锐化的边缘和虚假的高频细节，这些会扭曲真实热结构和语义信息。作者旨在解决这一问题，证明保真红外结构比追求感知锐度对可靠机器感知更重要。

Method: FaithIR包含两个分支：(1) patch级条件分支，用于捕获全局热力学和结构信息；(2) 像素级恢复分支，在结构引导下执行密集局部重建。整个恢复过程直接在像素域进行，以保留红外特有结构和任务相关信息。

Result: 在FLIR-IISR、M3FD和FMB三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法实现了强的重建保真度、跨数据集泛化能力，并在下游任务（目标检测和语义分割）中表现优越。

Conclusion: 该研究表明，对于可靠的机器感知，保真红外结构保留比仅追求感知锐度更为重要。

Abstract: Infrared image super-resolution (IISR) is important for downstream tasks such as object detection and semantic segmentation. Existing IISR methods often produce artificial textures, over-sharpened edges, and spurious high-frequency details that distort authentic thermal structures and semantic information. To address this issue, we propose FaithIR, a faithful infrared super-resolution framework for reliable machine perception. FaithIR consists of a patch-level conditioning branch that captures global thermal and structural information and a pixel-level restoration branch that performs dense local reconstruction under structural guidance. The entire restoration process is performed directly in the pixel domain to preserve infrared-specific structures and task-relevant information. Extensive experiments on FLIR-IISR, M3FD, and FMB demonstrate strong reconstruction fidelity, cross-dataset generalization, and superior performance in object detection and semantic segmentation. These results show that demonstrate that preserving faithful infrared structure preservations is more important for reliable machine perception than merely pursuing perceptual sharpness alone.

</details>


### [35] [A Unified Resolution-Conditioned Framework for Orthogonal Line-Scanning Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03107)
*Yiming Gong,Kai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Rank Enhanced Linear Attention (RELA)的统一分辨率条件融合框架，通过Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM)按分辨率比连续条件化网络，使单一模型适应不同狭缝宽度的激光线扫描显微成像配置，恢复近各向同性分辨率。还引入Adaptive RELA，用比率条件多尺度深度卷积替代固定核秩增强，并采用可学习注意力温度调节选择性。在多个狭缝配置下达到34-40 dB PSNR，优于无条件训练和专门的per-slit模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激光线扫描显微镜可实现快速体积成像，但产生各向异性的横向分辨率。正交线扫描可提供互补方向信息以恢复近各向同性分辨率，但现有深度学习方法需要为每种光学配置训练单独模型，缺乏对不同狭缝宽度的泛化能力。

Second, a perturbation-based consistency constraint addresses the residual overfitting risk from the learnable coupling functions by aligning the adapted model with a frozen CLIP reference branch using an asymmetric InfoNCE objective - augmented inputs feed the frozen branch while clean inputs feed the trainable branch - anchoring the learned representations to CLIP's generalizable feature space. Method: 将组合生成视为边界条件问题而非反复控制演化轨迹。RTD框架包含两个核心组件：1) Soft-Overlap Disentanglement (SOD)：将归一化的概念图重叠转化为可微分的、与布局无关的分离目标；2) Isotropic Gradient Rectification (IGR)：归一化SOD梯度并施加有界潜变量位移，在不同提示和初始化下保持一致尺度。整个过程在标准去噪前仅修正一次初始分配。

To this end, we propose Rectify-then-Diffuse (RTD), a training-free framework that rectifies the initial allocation once before standard denoising. Firstly, we propose Soft-Overlap Disentanglement (SOD), which converts normalized overlap between pilot concept maps into a differentiable and layout-agnostic separation objective. Abstract: Cross-city object detection requires a detector trained in one city to generalize to an unlabeled target city. Abstract: Realistic handwritten text generation plays an important role in numerous applications, such as font design, biometric authentication, and robotic calligraphy. Existing methods are typically divided into two independent paradigms: online approaches that estimate handwriting trajectories and offline approaches that synthesize realistic handwriting images. However, unifying online and offline models remains challenging due to (1) the lack of an explicit physical model linking stroke kinematics to pixel-level appearance and (2) the absence of paired trajectory-image datasets. Abstract: Dataset distillation compresses a large training set into a compact synthetic set while retaining its downstream utility. This division preserves the visual realism provided by the generative prior while progressively steering samples toward representative and class-discriminative regions of the SSL representation space. Abstract: Human-interpretable computer-aided diagnosis is crucial for clinical decision making. Consequently, adapting Foundation Vision-Language Models (FVLMs) demands costly label engineering and repeated post-training. Existing intervention mechanisms remain rigidly tied to predefined concepts, lacking adaptability and hindering scalable dermatology CAD deployment. (2) Open-linguistic based multi-faceted semantic specifications to overcome sparse textual label limitations, improving boundary sensitivity in uncertain clinical contexts. Abstract: Multi-focus image fusion (MFIF) aims to generate an all-in-focus image from multiple images of the same scene focused at different regions. This paper presents a novel Clarity Contrast and Similarity Selection Network (CSNet), to bridge direct information exchange for MFIF. Abstract: Estimating room layouts from multi-view imagery is a core task for indoor scene understanding. Most also estimate rooms independently, failing to exploit shared building structure such as dominant directions, ground plane or ceiling height.

The optimization objective is predicted by a neural network on top of robust pre-trained visual features and trained end-to-end with supervision only on output room layouts. At the same time, camera projection and polygon updates remain explicit and model-based. This separation between learned scoring and geometry improves generalization to new datasets and camera parameters. During optimization, PolyLayout adaptively refines the polygon topology through iterative wall split and merge operations while jointly utilizing structural cues across rooms. We introduce two new multi-view multi-room layout benchmarks by providing layout annotations to existing datasets, and experiments show that PolyLayout outperforms prior approaches, both in terms of accuracy and robustness.

</details>

*Shanghao Liu,Renze Chen,Size Zheng,Yuanqiang Liu,Yun,Liang,Hailong Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SPADE是一个训练无关的稀疏注意力引擎，用于视频扩散Transformer（vDiTs），通过动态掩码和3D分块策略，在保持生成质量的同时加速注意力计算2.26-3.40倍，端到端推理加速1.49-1.80倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频扩散Transformer虽能生成高质量视频，但其二次自注意力计算成本随视频token规模快速增长，导致推理开销过高。现有方法需要输入自适应的稀疏性策略——即选择关键的Q/K/V token且开销可忽略不计，从而获得端到端的性能收益。

Method: SPADE由三部分组成：(i) vDiT-SSR规范，定义3D分块候选并通过Summarizer/Estimator表达式形式化动态掩码；(ii) 利用SICS和头级策略进行运行时方案生成；(iii) 执行器包含低开销索引搜索、flash块稀疏注意力和内核分组。

Result: 在Hunyuan-Video和Wan 2.1/2.2上针对文本到视频和图像到视频生成任务，SPADE在提升稀疏性和速度的同时保持生成质量，注意力计算加速2.26-3.40倍，端到端推理加速1.49-1.80倍。

Conclusion: SPADE证明了无需训练即可实现高效的自适应稀疏注意力，为视频扩散Transformer的实际部署提供了可行方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Video diffusion transformers (vDiTs) generate high quality but pay quadratic self-attention cost, making inference prohibitive at video-token scales. The challenge is input-adaptive sparsity: selecting critical Q/K/V tokens with negligible overhead and executing them for end-to-end gains. We present SPADE, a training-free sparse-attention engine of three parts: (i) vDiT-SSR, a specification defining 3D blocking candidates and formalizing dynamic masks via Summarizer/Estimator expressions; (ii) runtime scheme generation using SICS and a head-wise policy; and (iii) an executor with low-overhead index search, flash block-sparse attention, and kernel grouping. Across Hunyuan-Video and Wan 2.1/2.2 for text-to-video and image-to-video generation, SPADE raises sparsity and speed while preserving quality, accelerating attention by 2.26x-3.40x and end-to-end inference by 1.49x-1.80x. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/6somehow/DAC-SPADE.

</details>


### [65] [When Oracle Conditioning Misleads Deployment: Conditioning-Availability Bias in Echocardiographic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03342)
*Dang P. M. Cao,Hieu D. Pham,Hieu Pham*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究条件分割模型在训练/评估时使用干净辅助信号（如相位标签）但在部署时只能获得估计信号的"捷径学习"问题。通过"互补间隙对"指标（部署可用的oracle估计路径损失 + oracle随机路径敏感性），在超声心动图分割中量化训练与部署之间的协议级漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 条件分割模型在训练和评估时可能依赖比实际部署更干净的辅助信号（如心脏相位标签），导致部署时性能严重退化。现有工作缺乏系统性的协议级分析来揭示这种捷径学习与辅助变量漂移问题。

Method: 提出"互补间隙对"（complementary gap pair）评估框架：1）在部署可用的oracle估计路径上度量损失（衡量实际部署性能）；2）在oracle随机路径上探测敏感性（衡量对错误相位的鲁棒性）。并在多个数据集上结合部署感知的检查点选择和相位扰动缓解。

Result: 在CAMUS数据上，强周期oracle选择的运行在估计相位下严重失败，而错误相位的敏感性在三次运行间持续存在；在EchoNet-Dynamic上，当前估计器可用但随机相位测试显示强潜伏敏感性。部署感知检查点选择和相位扰动可同时减少两个间隙且Dice变化很小。下游EF审计发现恢复分割未必恢复EF误差或符号偏差。

Conclusion: "互补间隙对"能有效检验oracle条件性能是否在实际部署推理路径中存活。分割性能恢复不等于临床下游指标（如EF）恢复，评估需同时关注协议级间隙和临床后果。

Abstract: Conditional segmentation models may be trained and evaluated with auxiliary signals cleaner than those available at deployment. We study this protocol-level manifestation of shortcut learning and auxiliary-variable shift in phase-conditioned echocardiographic segmentation. The complementary gap pair measures loss on the deployable oracle-estimated pathway and probes sensitivity on the oracle-random pathway. On held-out CAMUS data, one strong-cyclic, oracle-selected run fails severely with estimated phase, while sensitivity to incorrect phase persists across three runs. On EchoNet-Dynamic, the current estimator remains usable, but random-phase testing reveals strong latent sensitivity. Deployment-aware checkpoint selection and phase perturbation reduce both gaps with little change in mean Dice. Exploratory subgroup analyses quantify variation across measured strata, and a downstream ejection fraction (EF) audit shows that recovering segmentation does not necessarily recover EF error or signed bias. Together, the gaps test whether oracle-conditioned performance survives the inference pathway actually available at deployment.

</details>


### [66] [Can Text-to-Image Models Draw from the Right Frame of Reference?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03357)
*Zheyuan Gu,Ruihang Li,Yong Huang,Yiqian Zhang,XIangzhao Hao,Jiaxin Niu,Jiahao Hu,Zhenyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FoR-T2I基准，用于评估文本到图像生成模型在遵循参照系（如物体内在朝向 vs 相机视角）进行空间布局时的能力。实验发现模型在FoR提示上的准确率远低于相机视图提示，并提出VLM门控重写策略缓解此问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2I基准虽揭示布局失败，但很少隔离测试模型在参照系不同于相机视图时能否正确跟随指定参照系。方向表达（如"左边"）可指相机坐标或物体内在朝向，导致预期布局不同，这一区分需要专门的评估。

Method: 构建包含1,200个提示对的FoR-T2I基准，每对包含相机视角（Cam）提示和参照系（FoR）提示描述相同的目标布局。测试22个开源和闭源T2I模型，并分析不同关系类型和相机视角下的性能差距，提出VLM门控重写方法通过视觉反馈选择重写后的提示。

Result: 模型在FoR提示上的平均最终准确率比匹配的Cam提示低41.8%，最佳模型也仅达到44.3%的FoR准确率。VLM门控重写方法在相同生成预算下将平均FoR准确率从25.0%提升到29.2%。

Conclusion: 当前T2I模型在通过物体朝向描述布局时明显弱于直接使用图像坐标描述，存在显著参照系理解差距。基于视觉反馈的提示重写策略可以提供适度的改进，但仍需更根本的方法来解决参照系跟随问题。

Abstract: Spatial instruction following has become a crucial requirement for text-to-image (T2I) generation. A common challenge arises when directional expressions are interpreted under different frames of reference. For example, ``the left of'' may refer to the viewer's image coordinates or to the intrinsic orientation of an object, leading to different expected layouts. Existing T2I benchmarks reveal important layout failures, yet they rarely isolate whether models can follow a specified frame of reference when it differs from camera view. To mitigate this gap, we introduce FoR-T2I, a benchmark for evaluating this distinction with 1,200 prompt pairs built from controlled spatial layouts. In each pair, the camera-view (Cam) prompt states the target relation in camera view, while the frame-of-reference (FoR) prompt describes the same target placement through an oriented anchor object. Across 22 closed-source and open-source T2I models, mean final accuracy is 41.8\% lower on FoR prompts than on matched Cam prompts; even the best-performing model achieves only 44.3\% FoR accuracy. This suggests that current models struggle more when the same layout is described through an object's orientation rather than directly in image coordinates. We further analyze this gap by relation type and camera view, compare several training-free prompting and feedback-based mitigation strategies, and propose a VLM-gated rewriting approach that selects rewritten prompts using visual feedback, improving average FoR accuracy from 25.0\% to 29.2\% under the same generation budget.

</details>


### [67] [DRPFNet: Dual-domain Residual Progressive Fusion Network for RGB-Thermal Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03370)
*Zian Wang,Changchun Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DRPFNet，一种双域残差渐进融合网络，通过结构、特征、增强三个层面的协同优化来解决RGB-T目标检测中跨尺度知识继承不足、噪声抑制缺乏双向优化、频率-空间协同缺失等问题，在两个公开数据集上取得了有竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RGB-T融合检测方法在各特征尺度上独立进行跨模态融合，存在三个关键局限：(1)各尺度独立融合导致跨层级知识继承不足；(2)缺乏双向优化导致噪声难以持续抑制；(3)缺乏频率-空间协同导致信息退化。这些问题限制了检测性能的提升。

Method: 提出DRPFNet（双域残差渐进融合网络），从三个协同层面构建统一的信息流优化系统：(1)结构层面：通过自底向上的知识累积和双向增强实现跨尺度信息传播，保证信息流顺畅；(2)特征层面：通过频带分离和边缘引导，协同提取RGB高频边缘与热成像低频结构，保证表征质量；(3)增强层面：通过边缘引导的双域细化增强前景-背景判别能力，实现精确的目标定位。

Result: 在两个公开RGB-T数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法取得了有竞争力的性能，同时保持了有竞争力的效率，验证了层级协同策略的有效性。

Conclusion: DRPFNet通过结构-特征-增强三层协同的层级融合策略，有效解决了现有RGB-T检测方法中跨尺度信息传递、双向噪声抑制和频率-空间协同的问题，为RGB-T目标检测提供了更优的融合框架。

Abstract: RGB-thermal (RGB-T) object detection aims to fuse complementary information from visible and thermal modalities to achieve robust detection under varying illumination and weather conditions. Current methods typically employ attention mechanisms or transformers to perform cross-modal fusion independently at each feature scale, directly combining RGB and thermal features in the spatial domain. However, they still face significant limitations: cross-level knowledge inheritance caused by independent fusion at each scale,suppressing noise continuously due to the lack of bidirectional optimization, and information degradation induced by the absence of frequency-spatial collaboration. To address these issues, we propose DRPFNet, a Dual-domain Residual Progressive Fusion Network that constructs a unified information flow optimization system from three synergistic levels:structure, feature, and enhancement. At the structural level, we establish cross-scale propagation through bottom-up knowledge accumulation and bidirectional enhancement,ensuring smooth information flow. At the feature level, we collaboratively extract RGB high-frequency edges and thermal low-frequency structures via frequency band separation and edge guidance, guaranteeing representation quality. At the enhancement level, we enhance foreground-background discrimination through edge-guided dual-domain refinement,achieving precise object localization.Extensive experiments on two public RGB-T datasets demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance with competitive efficiency, validating the effectiveness of this hierarchical collaborative strategy.

</details>


### [68] [Residual Flow Matching with Dynamic Cross-Interaction for 3D Multi-Person Motion Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03379)
*Wei Wei,Yinyuan Zhao,Ruixuan Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于先验引导的残差流匹配框架（Prior-Guided Residual Flow Matching），用于3D多人运动预测。通过确定性粗先验（DCP）建立运动学锚点，将生成过程转化为条件残差流以保持结构稳定性；通过动态交叉交互（DCI）机制按积分进度时序同步智能体间消息传递，提取可靠的社会上下文；并采用解耦的关节-运动架构进行双向融合保持运动学相干性。在多个数据集上取得最先进的预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的流匹配方法虽然能通过多假设生成提高3D多人运动预测精度，但从纯噪声直接预测骨骼序列会导致结构一致性受损，且早期噪声主导的积分阶段会产生不可靠的跨智能体交互。因此需要一个既能保持生成多样性优势、又能维护运动学结构一致性和可靠社会交互的框架。

Method: 提出Prior-Guided Residual Flow Matching框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) Deterministic Coarse Prior (DCP)：建立运动学锚点，将生成过程描述为基于运动残差的条件流，简化生成目标并保持结构稳定；(2) Dynamic Cross-Interaction (DCI)：将智能体间消息传递与积分进度时间同步，按进度动态提取可靠的社会上下文；(3) 解耦的关节-运动架构结合双向融合，保留细粒度的运动学相干性。

Result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法取得了最先进的预测精度。

Conclusion: 通过先验引导的残差流匹配与动态交叉交互机制，有效解决了纯噪声生成中结构不一致和早期交互不可靠的问题，在3D多人运动预测任务上达到了最优性能，并公开了代码。

Abstract: 3D multi-person motion prediction requires modeling both individual kinematics and inter-person interactions. While Flow Matching is effective for multi-hypothesis generation to improve prediction accuracy, directly predicting skeletal sequences from pure noise often compromises structural consistency and introduces unreliable cross-agent interactions during early noise-dominated integration steps. To address this, we propose a Prior-Guided Residual Flow Matching framework. First, a Deterministic Coarse Prior (DCP) establishes a kinematic anchor, formulating the generative process as a conditional flow over motion residuals to simplify the generative objective and preserve structural stability. Second, a Dynamic Cross-Interaction (DCI) mechanism temporally synchronizes inter-agent message-passing with the integration progress, ensuring the extraction of reliable social contexts and improving multi-person motion fidelity. Finally, a decoupled joint-motion architecture with bidirectional fusion effectively preserves fine-grained kinematic coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art prediction accuracy across multiple datasets. Code is available at https://github.com/Wei-Wei-a/Residual-Flow-Matching-with-Dynamic-Cross-Interaction-for-3D-Multi-Person-Motion-Prediction.

</details>


### [69] [FreqAdapt: Frequency-Adaptive Processing for RAW Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03385)
*Hanxi Li,Huiling Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出FreqAdapt，一个轻量级的频率域自适应RAW图像增强模块。与传统在空间域处理ISP操作不同，FreqAdapt将ISP操作映射到傅里叶频率域，并根据ISP操作的物理特性进行域分离，确保每个操作在最适合的域中执行。通过自适应频率域编码器联合分析幅度谱、相位谱和RAW图像特征，为ISP参数预测提供全局上下文，并采用可学习融合机制实现自适应特征增强。实验表明在多种光照和天气条件下达到SOTA性能，且可无缝集成到现有目标检测框架中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有目标检测方法主要使用sRGB输入，这些图像是经过为可视化设计的ISP从RAW传感器数据压缩而来。相比之下，RAW图像具有更好的噪声特性和更丰富的信息表示，尤其在恶劣天气或低光照等挑战性条件下对目标检测至关重要。然而，现有的RAW域处理方法多在空间域进行，未能充分利用频率域的优势。

Method: FreqAdapt包含两个核心创新：(1) 将ISP操作创新性地映射到傅里叶频率域，根据ISP操作的物理特性进行域分离，使每个操作在最适合的域中执行；(2) 采用自适应频率域编码器，联合分析幅度谱、相位谱和RAW图像特征，为ISP参数预测提供全局上下文，并通过可学习融合机制实现自适应特征增强。

Result: 在多个涵盖不同光照和天气条件的数据集上进行的大量实验表明，FreqAdapt在保持轻量级效率和良好物理可解释性的同时，达到了最先进的性能水平。

Conclusion: FreqAdapt可无缝集成到现有目标检测框架中，为RAW域的视觉感知任务提供了一种新颖的解决方案，展示了频率域处理在RAW图像增强中的巨大潜力。

Abstract: Existing object detection methods predominantly utilize sRGB inputs, which are compressed from RAW sensor data using Image Signal Processors (ISP) originally designed for visualization purposes. Compared to RGB images, RAW images possess favorable noise characteristics and richer information representation, which are crucial for object detection, particularly under challenging conditions such as adverse weather or low-light environments. In this paper, we propose FreqAdapt, a lightweight module for adaptive RAW data enhancement in the frequency domain. Unlike traditional spatial domain processing methods, FreqAdapt innovatively maps ISP operations to the Fourier frequency domain and performs domain separation based on the physical properties of ISP operations, ensuring each operation is performed in its most suitable domain. Meanwhile, through an adaptive frequency domain encoder that jointly analyzes amplitude spectrum, phase spectrum, and RAW image features, we provide global context for ISP parameter prediction and employ a learnable fusion mechanism to achieve adaptive feature enhancement. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets with diverse lighting and weather conditions demonstrate that FreqAdapt achieves state-of-the-art performance while maintaining lightweight efficiency and good physical interpretability. Furthermore, our module can be seamlessly incorporated into existing object detection frameworks, providing a novel solution for visual perception tasks in the RAW domain.

</details>


### [70] [SRAP: SVD-Refined Adversarial Perturbations for Imperceptible Face-Swap Defense](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03395)
*Sungwon Cho,Kwanghyun Ko,Myungjoo Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SRAP方法，通过结合截断SVD细化和身份重要性掩码来优化PGD对抗扰动，在保持换脸防御效果的同时显著提升保护图像的视觉质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PGD生成的对抗扰动虽然能破坏换脸模型的身份表征，但存在两个视觉质量问题：扰动广泛分布在图像各处（包括身份不敏感区域），且包含视觉上明显的高频分量。需要更精细的扰动优化策略。

Method: SRAP包含两个关键组件：(1) 逐通道截断SVD细化，抑制高秩高频残差；(2) 身份重要性掩码，将扰动限制在对身份表征影响最大的区域。两者在每个优化步骤中结合使用。

Result: 在CelebA-HQ和VGGFace2-HQ数据集上，SRAP在所有报告指标上显著提升保护图像保真度，同时保持有竞争力的身份破坏性能，实现了换脸防御与视觉不可感知性之间的有利权衡。

Conclusion: 通过空间（身份掩码）和频谱（SVD细化）两个维度的分析，有效解决了PGD扰动在身份不敏感区域分散和高频分量突出的问题，证明了精细化的扰动优化可以在不牺牲防御效果的前提下大幅提升图像质量。

Abstract: Deepfake technologies pose increasing threats to facial privacy and identity security, motivating proactive defenses that protect facial images before misuse. Although adversarial perturbations generated by projected gradient descent (PGD) can disrupt the identity representations used by face-swapping models, their visual quality is degraded by two characteristics: perturbations are distributed broadly over the image, including identity-insensitive regions, and they contain visually salient high-frequency components. We analyze these spatial and spectral inefficiencies through identity-sensitivity estimation and the singular-value decomposition (SVD) of PGD perturbations. Our analysis shows that later singular components contain a disproportionate amount of high-frequency energy, while the leading components preserve most of the perturbation energy and defense utility. Based on these observations, we propose SRAP, which combines per-channel truncated SVD refinement with an identity-importance mask at every optimization step. The SVD refinement suppresses high-rank, high-frequency residuals, while the mask restricts perturbations to locations that strongly influence identity representations. Experiments on CelebA-HQ and VGGFace2-HQ demonstrate that SRAP substantially improves protected-image fidelity across all reported metrics while maintaining competitive identity-disruption performance, yielding a favorable trade-off between face-swap defense and visual imperceptibility.

</details>


### [71] [Distilled Roads: Generalisable Road Network Extraction Across Sensors, Resolutions, and Region](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03407)
*Sanayya,Rakshith Sathish,Ashwathi Nambiar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将全球道路提取视为持续适应问题而非架构问题，通过跨分辨率知识蒸馏、多传感器训练和拓扑感知监督，构建一个能泛化于0.3-1.0m分辨率、多平台卫星影像的单一模型，在公开基准上F1提升22点、APLS提升15点，同时推理速度提升3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有道路分割模型在窄分辨率-区域组合下训练，难以泛化到未见环境（如乡村、不同道路材料、新卫星平台），常产生断裂或不连通的预测。适应新域需要重新训练或微调，成本高且存在灾难性遗忘风险。

Method: 将全球道路提取重构为持续适应问题，提出一个结合三种策略的框架：(1) 跨分辨率知识蒸馏配合分辨率递减的数据课程；(2) 多传感器训练；(3) 拓扑感知监督。由此得到一个能跨0.3-1.0m分辨率、多卫星平台、多大陆泛化的单一模型。

Result: 在City-Scale和Global-Scale等公开基准上，模型相比最先进方法F1提升最多22点、APLS提升15点，同时保持最高效率，推理速度快3倍。

Abstract: Road network segmentation from satellite imagery remains challenging due to large geographic variation in road appearance, occlusions, and domain shifts introduced by differing resolutions and sensors. Existing models, typically trained under narrow resolution--region combinations, generalise poorly to unseen environments such as rural settings, regions with distinct road materials, or imagery from new satellite platforms, often producing broken or disconnected predictions. Adapting these models to new domains usually requires retraining or fine-tuning, which is costly and risks catastrophic forgetting.
  In this work, we reframe global road extraction as a continual adaptation problem rather than an architectural one. Our framework combines cross-resolution knowledge distillation across a resolution-decreasing curriculum, multi-sensor training, and topology-aware supervision, yielding a single model that generalises across $0.3-1.0$ m imagery from multiple satellite platforms across continents. On publicly available benchmarks, including City-Scale and Global-Scale, our model outperforms state-of-the-art results by up to $22$ F1 points and $15$ APLS points, while remaining the most efficient, with $3\times$ faster inference. Our results suggest that improved robustness across diverse sub-meter satellite imagery can be achieved through targeted training strategies, such as data curricula, distillation, and topology-aware losses, rather than increasingly complex architectures.

Abstract: Earth observation is moving from foundation models that users must run themselves toward embedding products that package model feature outputs as reusable data without needing to download and process the imagery used to generate them. Earth embeddings are vectors that summarize locations, image patches, or pixels, letting users analyze compact features instead of repeatedly training or running large models on raw satellite imagery. ### [73] [HyperbolicDiffusion: Sharp & Scalable Tiled Generation on the Hyperbolic Plane](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03422)
*Hugo Caselles-Dupré*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HyperbolicDiffusion是一种无需训练的生成方法，直接在双曲平面H2上生成有限视觉场。它通过Hyperbolic Blooming Cover将窗口放置简化为紧凑动态规划，利用永久表面ID形成共享潜在画布，标准扩散模型去噪局部窗口并将预测融合回H2。针对曲率导致的接缝模糊问题，采用几何推导的第二阶段重新噪声和修复。生成的视觉场锐利、可重投影且跨视角一致，是对Escher圆极限系列的提示驱动生成对应物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平面平铺扩散方法处理的是矩形画布上的重叠窗口，但双曲平面不存在这样的画布，且其面积随半径呈指数增长。现有方法无法直接应用于双曲几何空间，因此需要一种新的方法来生成双曲平面上的有限视觉场。

Method: 1) Hyperbolic Blooming Cover：将窗口放置问题转化为紧凑动态规划，运行时间仅为秒级，同时提供强理论保证。2) 永久表面ID构成共享潜在画布，标准扩散模型去噪局部窗口，预测结果融合回H2。3) 由于曲率引起多窗口接缝处残留不一致和模糊，采用几何推导的第二阶段对这些区域进行重新噪声和修复。

Result: 生成的视觉场锐利、可重投影且跨视角一致，成功实现了提示驱动的双曲平面生成。方法在理论上提供了覆盖的强保证，实践上运行高效（秒级）。

Conclusion: 该方法提供了Escher《圆极限》系列的提示驱动生成对应物，证明无需额外训练即可在双曲平面上生成高质量的有限视觉场，并通过几何感知的修复策略解决了曲率带来的接缝问题。

Abstract: Planar tiled diffusion denoises overlapping windows of one rectangular canvas. The hyperbolic plane has no such canvas, and its area grows exponentially with radius. We introduce HyperbolicDiffusion, a training-free method for generating finite visual fields directly on the hyperbolic plane H2. Our Hyperbolic Blooming Cover reduces window placement to a compact dynamic program that runs in seconds while providing strong theoretical guarantees. Permanent surface IDs form a shared latent canvas: a standard diffusion model denoises local windows, whose predictions are fused back onto H2. Because curvature causes residual disagreement and blur at multi-window junctions, a geometry-derived second stage re-noises and repairs precisely those regions. The resulting fields are sharp, reprojectable, and consistent across viewpoints, providing a prompt-driven generative counterpart to Escher's Circle Limit series.

</details>


### [74] [SGFormer: Structure-Guided Transformer for Robust Local Feature Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03423)
*Runyu Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SGFormer是一种结构引导的Transformer匹配网络，通过引入Triple-Structure-Attention模块来缓解注意力发散问题，在遮挡区域中增强对显著结构的关注，从而提高特征匹配精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的无检测器匹配方法（如LoFTR）依赖无约束注意力机制获取全局特征，但在大视角变化场景中，全局注意力会使相似特征在无关区域获得同等权重，导致注意力发散——部分高置信度匹配落在有效匹配区域之外，降低匹配可靠性。

Method: 提出SGFormer（Structure-Guided Transformer），采用半稠密粗到细流水线，并在骨干网络中嵌入Triple-Structure-Attention（TSA）模块。TSA利用早期网络层的浅层局部特征增强显著结构周围的表示，引导后续Transformer阶段在全局范围内加强对显著结构区域的关注。

Result: 大量实验表明，SGFormer显著缓解了注意力发散问题，并提升了匹配精度。

Conclusion: 通过结构引导注意力，SGFormer有效增强了对视觉一致区域的关注，同时削弱非重叠区域的影响，为挑战性摄影测量环境下的特征匹配提供了更可靠的解决方案。

Abstract: Local feature matching is a fundamental component of photogrammetry, enabling accurate image correspondence critical for tasks such as 3D reconstruction, stereo mapping, and visual localization. While recent detector-free matching methods, like LoFTR, have advanced the field, the global features obtained by leveraging the global-range modeling capacity of the unconstrained attention mechanism compromise the model's attention to the salient structures in certain scenarios. This limitation leads to a phenomenon we define as attention divergence, wherein a portion of high-confidence matches are distributed outside the valid matching region (overlapping region), especially in scenes with large viewpoint variations. This occurs because similar features in irrelevant regions may receive equal weighting and consideration within the standard Transformer, limiting matching reliability in challenging photogrammetric environments. To address this issue in feature matching, we propose SGFormer (Structure-Guided Transformer), a novel structure-aware matching network that adaptively updates attention on features near salient structure in overlapping regions. SGFormer employs a semi-dense coarse-to-fine pipeline and incorporates the proposed Triple-Structure-Attention (TSA) module into the backbone net for extracting distinctive features. The TSA module utilizes shallow local features from early network layers to enhance the representation around salient structure, guiding subsequent transformer stages to intensify the model's focus on regions with salient structure across the global scope. SGFormer, thereby reinforcing attention to visually consistent areas while mitigating the influence of non-overlapping regions. Extensive experiments show that SGFormer significantly mitigates attention divergence and improves matching accuracy.

</details>

*Dimitrios I. Zaridis,Traianos Tsiokris,Vasileios C. Pezoulas,Daphni Plati,Eugenia Mylona,Eleni Georga,Nikos Tsiknakis,Antonis Sakellarios,Dimitrios I. Fotiadis*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: PEFT方法适配小型VLM可以在专业食物识别任务上超越大幅更大的专有模型，证明了轻量级微调路线的有效性。模型和代码均已公开。

Abstract: Image based dietary assessment offers a scalable alternative to self reported food diaries, yet fine-grained food recognition remains challenging due to high intra-class variability and visually similar dishes. This study presents OliveGemma, a vision language model for recognising and reasoning about Mediterranean and European cuisine. Built on the open-weight PaliGemma-2-3B architecture, OliveGemma is fine-tuned with LoRA on a unified corpus of 17,340 images from three European research project datasets (MedGR, ODIN, and VIPPSTAR), reconciled into a vocabulary of 216 composed dish categories and paired with 102,642 instruction style question-answer items covering dish recognition, likely and visible ingredients, class boundary discrimination, visual evidence and overall visual food understanding. Under a 3-fold cross-validation scheme, OliveGemma achieves a top-1 accuracy of 92.96% +/- 0.91%, exceeding the strongest CNN baseline (DenseNet-121) by 7.31% and outperforming zero-shot frontier models with exact instructions and bounded classes including Gemini Flash 3 and 3.5, GPT-5.4 Mini, and Claude Haiku 4.6 by 8%, 46%, and 64% respectively. Furthermore, OliveGemma demonstrates competitive performance on Top-3 and Top-5 accuracy, being second best across CNNs and frontier models, surpassed only by DenseNet-121. In addition, OliveGemma achieves 90.79% +/- 1.3% Exact-Set on the likely ingredients of the food categories. These results demonstrate that PEFT adaptation of a small VLM can surpass substantially larger proprietary models on specialised food recognition. The model is publicly available at https://huggingface.co/JamesZar/OliveGemma-3B and the experiments and results can be found at https://github.com/tsiokris/OliveGemma.

</details>


### [76] [SLAMFormer-$\infty$: Infinite SLAM Transformer for Unbounded Frontend and Backend Processing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03429)

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的几何Transformer在SLAM任务中通常受限于显式距离边界或首帧锚定公式，这限制了其支持长距离（长轨迹）前端和后端处理的能力。作者旨在打破这一瓶颈，设计一个能够处理无界长距离轨迹的Transformer架构。

Method: SLAMFormer-∞采用内存条件（memory conditions）而非首帧锚定来定义输入帧的灵活坐标系和尺度，增强了结构条件的表达能力。基于此基础，前端保持高效的局部计算，后端则对长距离轨迹和场景几何进行全局一致的联合优化。

Result: 在大型数据集上，SLAMFormer-∞在轨迹估计和场景重建任务中均取得优越或极具竞争力的性能。特别地，该模型能够成功处理超过17公里长的极端轨迹序列，展现出强大的泛化能力。

Conclusion: SLAMFormer-∞证明了通过内存条件替代首帧锚定，可以构建无需显式距离边界的几何Transformer，从而有效支持长距离SLAM的前端和后端处理，为大规模场景下的SLAM建模提供了新的可行范式。

Abstract: We introduce the Infinite SLAM Transformer (SLAMFormer-$\infty$), the first geometric transformer capable of supporting both long-range frontend and backend processing without an explicit distance bound. Instead of relying on a first-frame-anchored formulation, SLAMFormer-$\infty$ employs memory conditions to define flexible coordinate systems and scales for input frames, enabling more expressive structural conditioning. Built upon this formulation, the frontend preserves efficient local computation, while the backend jointly optimizes long-range trajectories and scene geometry in a globally consistent manner. Experimental results demonstrate that SLAMFormer-$\infty$ achieves superior or highly competitive performance in both trajectory estimation and scene reconstruction across large-scale datasets. Notably, SLAMFormer-$\infty$ generalizes to extremely long trajectories, successfully operating on sequences exceeding $17\mathrm{km}$.

</details>

*Ivo Herzig,Pascal Paysan,Daniel Barco,Marc André Stadelmann,Frank-Peter Schilling,Igor Peterlik,Michal Walczak,Lijin Aryananda,Woo Sang Ahn,Rudolf Marcel Füchslin,Lukas Lichtensteiger*

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 提出一种CNN架构，扩展自U-Net：编码器作用于滤波投影堆栈，解码器在体积域工作，用多分辨率的不可训练反投影函数替换跳跃连接以在域间传递特征。网络输出静态吸气末体积加10个位移向量场（DVFs）覆盖整个呼吸周期。

Result: 在模拟数据上，图像质量与SART-TV相当（RMSE: -1.19 HU, PSNR: +0.09 dB, SSIM: -0.009），同时实现了4D重建。临床评估中，专家偏好该方法用于肿瘤可见性（59% vs 36%）和食管可见性（47% vs 42%）。临床扫描中显示更锐利的动态结构和更少的运动条纹伪影。

Conclusion: 该非患者特异的CNN能从单次自由呼吸扫描中预测静态体积和完整4D呼吸运动模型，无需呼吸替代信号或投影分箱，在减少运动伪影的同时增加了运动建模能力。

Abstract: Four-dimensional cone beam CT (4D CBCT) is important for image-guided radiation therapy of thoracic cancers, but its use is limited by long scan times, causing high patient dose and motion/sparse-sampling artifacts.
