### [246] [Making AI Visible, Not Vanished: How AI Policies Reshape Developer Experience on GitHub](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03329)
*Yunqi Chen,Thomas Zimmermann,Bianca Trinkenreich*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文首次大规模实证研究开源软件（OSS）中的人工智能治理政策。通过分析29,624个GitHub仓库，识别出385个采用AI政策的项目，提出TRACE框架（涵盖透明度、责任、归属、约束和执行五个治理维度），将政策分为五种治理家族，并使用倾向性评分匹配和纵向双重差分分析评估影响。研究发现AI治理主要规范而非禁止AI辅助开发，政策采纳带来维护者参与度提升、AI披露增加、审查互动更丰富和代码质量改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI正在迅速改变开源软件开发方式，促使项目引入治理AI辅助贡献的政策。然而，目前对这些政策的差异及其对开发者体验的影响知之甚少，缺乏大规模实证研究。

Method: 分析29,624个GitHub仓库，识别385个采用AI政策的项目；提出TRACE框架（Transparency, Responsibility, Attribution, Constraints, Enforcement）对政策进行分类；使用倾向性评分匹配（propensity-score matching）和纵向双重差分分析（difference-in-differences）估计政策效果。

Result: AI治理主要规范而非禁止AI辅助开发；政策采纳带来维护者参与度提升、AI披露增加、更丰富的审查互动和代码质量改善；强调透明度和责任的政策比单纯限制性方法产生更强的社区和质量成果。

Conclusion: 不同的AI治理策略会以不同方式影响开发者体验，研究结果为开源社区设计有效的AI政策提供了实证证据支持。

Abstract: Generative AI is rapidly reshaping Open Source Software (OSS) software development,prompting projects to introduce policies governing AI-assisted contributions. However, little is known about how these policies differ or whether they influence developer experience. We present the first large-scale empirical study of AI governance policies in OSS. Analyzing 29,624 GitHub repositories, we identify 385 projects that adopted AI policies and derive TRACE, a framework capturing five governance dimensions: Transparency, Responsibility, Attribution, Constraints, and Enforcement. We further classify policies into five governance families and estimate their effects using propensity-score matching and longitudinal difference-in-differences analysis. Our results show that AI governance primarily regulates rather than prohibits AI-assisted development. Policy adoption brings maintainer engagement, increased AI disclosure, richer review interactions, and improved code quality while AI-assisted contributions continue to grow. Governance design matters: policies emphasizing transparency and responsibility produced stronger community and quality outcomes than restrictive approaches alone. Our findings show how different AI governance strategies shape developer experience and provide evidence to help OSS communities design effective AI policies.

</details>


### [247] [Assessing Behavioral Validation in UI Component Test Suites Using Inferred Metamorphic Relations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03337)
*Yu Pei,Cunming Zhang,Jeongju Sohn,Mike Papadakis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于变异关系(MR)的框架，用于评估UI组件测试套件的行为验证质量，通过推断组件特定的MR、将测试与MR对齐并计算MR覆盖率指标，弥补传统基于执行的覆盖率指标的不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的UI组件库评估依赖语句覆盖率和分支覆盖率等基于执行的指标，但这些指标无法揭示测试是否验证了组件API和文档所隐含的行为关系，缺少对行为验证质量的评估视角。

Method: 该框架从组件的源代码、文档和测试中，利用UI特定的分类法推断组件特定的变异关系(MRs)，通过混合确定性分析和语义分析将测试与推断的MR对齐，并计算关系级MR覆盖率指标(MR Cover和MR Touch)。

Result: 实验表明：现有测试套件在三个LLM配置下MR Cover保持在42.5%-47.6%之间，且始终低于MR Touch；大多数未覆盖的关系是弱oracle案例（行为被执行但缺乏显式行为验证）；MR覆盖率能补充基于执行的覆盖率，揭示语句/分支覆盖率无法反映的行为缺口；大多数issue描述可映射到推断的MR关系类型。

Conclusion: MR覆盖率提供了一种互补的关系级视角，用于评估现代UI组件测试中的行为验证质量，能够揭示传统基于执行的覆盖率指标所遗漏的行为验证缺口。

Abstract: UI component libraries are commonly assessed using execution-based metrics such as statement and branch coverage, yet these metrics provide limited insight into whether tests verify the behavioral relations implied by component APIs and documentation. This paper presents an MR-based framework that uses inferred metamorphic relations (MRs) as an empirical behavioral reference, rather than a complete specification, for assessing UI component test suites. Given a component's source, documentation, and tests, the framework infers component-specific MRs using a UI-specific taxonomy, aligns tests with the inferred relations through hybrid deterministic and semantic analysis, and computes relation-level MR coverage metrics. We manually validate both the inferred MR space and the test--MR alignment. Our evaluation shows that existing test suites exercise substantially more behavioral relations than they explicitly validate: MR Cover remains between 42.5% and 47.6% across three LLM configurations and consistently below MR Touch. Most uncovered relations are weak-oracle cases, where behaviors are exercised but lack explicit behavioral validation. MR coverage also complements execution-based coverage by revealing behavioral gaps not reflected by statement or branch coverage alone. We further assess practical relevance through issue-description mapping, oracle strengthening, and MR-relevant injected faults. Most reported issue descriptions can be mapped to inferred MR relation types; weak-oracle relations often expose missing validation evidence; and MR labels show a trend in MR-relevant fault detection. Overall, MR coverage provides a complementary relation-level perspective for assessing behavioral validation in modern UI component testing.

</details>


### [248] [Route-Align-Verify for Functional Correctness in Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03341)
*Erxue Zhou,Jingxiang Meng,Aofan Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出RAV框架，通过三个协调阶段（Route路由、Align对齐、Verify验证）在不修改骨干模型架构的情况下提升代码生成的功能正确性，在MBPP基准上取得显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在代码生成方面已有显著进步，但在异构编程任务上实现强功能正确性仍然困难，单一提示策略和单一直接生成输出往往不足，需要更系统的方法来提升代码生成的鲁棒性。

Method: RAV框架包含三个协调阶段：（1）Route—在生成前进行任务感知的提示路由；（2）Align—通过对齐的LoRA适配减少微调提示与推理提示之间的不匹配；（3）Verify—通过执行多个候选输出对照可见公共测试来选择最终输出。

Result: 在MBPP基准的Sanitized和Full两种设置下评估，完整RAV管线分别达到0.8911和0.8520的最佳性能，相比基础模型分别提升6.35和9.92个百分点。消融实验表明任务感知路由和对齐适配在与基于执行的验证结合时效果显著增强。鲁棒性和污染分析支持了改进的可靠性。

Conclusion: 代码生成的功能正确性可以通过联合优化任务提示方式、模型适配方式和最终输出选择方式得到有意义提升，无需修改骨干架构。RAV展示了轻量级模块化框架在代码生成任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have substantially improved code generation, yet achieving strong functional correctness remains difficult, especially for heterogeneous programming tasks where a single prompting strategy and a single directly generated output are often insufficient. In this paper, we present RAV, a lightweight and modular framework that improves code generation with a fixed backbone model through three coordinated stages: Route, which applies task-aware prompt routing before generation; Align, which reduces the mismatch between fine-tuning prompts and inference-time prompts through aligned LoRA adaptation; and Verify, which selects the final output by executing multiple candidates against visible public tests.
  We evaluate RAV on the MBPP benchmark under both the sanitized and full settings. The complete RAV pipeline achieves the best performance among all evaluated configurations, reaching 0.8911 on MBPP Sanitized and 0.8520 on MBPP Full. Compared with the base model, these results represent improvements of 6.35 and 9.92 percentage points, respectively. Component-wise ablation experiments further show that task-aware routing and aligned adaptation become substantially more effective when combined with execution-based verification. Additional robustness and contamination analyses support the reliability of the observed improvements. Overall, the results indicate that functional correctness in code generation can be meaningfully improved without modifying the backbone architecture, by jointly optimizing how tasks are prompted, how the model is adapted, and how final outputs are selected.

</details>


### [249] [Self-Evolving Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03392)
*Hao Zhou,Haichuan Hu,Ye Shang,Quanjun Zhang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是一篇针对"自进化编码代理"（self-evolving coding agents）这一新兴领域的系统性综述。这类代理能够在部署后通过更新框架、记忆、技能、工具、模型或协作结构来改进未来行为，以应对软件开发动态变化的特性。文章提出了对象中心分类法（object-centered taxonomy）来刻画什么在进化，并辅以"何时进化"和"什么软件特定证据驱动进化"两个正交视角，最后总结了该领域面临的关键挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地被嵌入到软件工程工作流中作为编码代理，但大多数现有代理在部署后保持静态，无法适应软件开发的动态特性——仓库会演化、依赖会变化、测试会失败。这种"静态代理"与"动态开发过程"之间的张力，催生了自进化编码代理这一新兴研究方向，但目前缺乏系统性的综述来整合和梳理该领域。

Method: 本文采用系统综述的方法：(1) 首先定义自进化编码代理，并将其与常规编码代理和一般自进化代理区分；(2) 构建一个对象中心分类法（object-centered taxonomy），描述系统中"什么"在进化；(3) 补充两个正交视角：进化发生的时机（when）以及驱动进化的软件特定证据（what evidence）；(4) 基于这些维度对现有文献进行系统组织和分析。

Result: 研究发现：(1) 可执行反馈、仓库级上下文和编码轨迹使软件工程成为代理自进化的天然领域；(2) 但同时也引入了新挑战，包括反馈可靠性、基准过拟合、安全性、可维护性、成本和泛化能力等问题；(3) 通过组织现有工作，澄清了自进化编码代理的概念边界，并为设计更自适应、可靠和软件感知的代理系统提供了基础。

Conclusion: 本文系统性地综述了自进化编码代理领域，通过多维度分类框架（什么进化、何时进化、什么证据驱动进化）为理解该领域提供了清晰的概念框架，同时指出了该领域面临的核心挑战和未来研究方向，为该领域的发展奠定了结构化基础。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly embedded in software engineering workflows as coding agents that can inspect repositories, invoke tools, execute tests, debug failures, and generate patches. Yet most existing agents remain largely static after deployment, even though software development is a dynamic, feedback-rich process in which repositories evolve, dependencies change, tests fail, and repair attempts leave reusable experience. This tension has motivated a growing body of work on self-evolving coding agents, where the agent improves its future behavior by updating its framework, memory, skills, tools, models, or collaboration structures from prior coding interactions. In this survey, we provide a systematic synthesis of this emerging area. We first define self-evolving coding agents and distinguish them from conventional coding agents and general self-evolving agents. We then develop an object-centered taxonomy that characterizes what evolves in these systems, and complement it with two orthogonal perspectives: when evolution occurs and what software-specific evidence drives it. Across the literature, we find that executable feedback, repository-level context, and coding trajectories give software engineering a distinctive role as a natural domain for agent self-evolution, but also introduce new challenges in feedback reliability, benchmark overfitting, safety, maintainability, cost, and generalization. By organizing existing work around these dimensions, this survey aims to clarify the conceptual boundaries of self-evolving coding agents and provide a foundation for designing more adaptive, reliable, and software-aware agentic systems. The papers we collect can be found at https://github.com/zhouhao1024/Awesome-Self-Evolving-Coding-Agents.

</details>


### [250] [When AI Joins the Team! A Model of How AI Adoption Relates To Social Patterns in Software Engineering Teams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03462)
*Giusy Annunziata,Rudrajit Choudhuri,Anita Sarma,Gemma Catolino,Filomena Ferrucci*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本研究基于Transactive Memory Systems (TMS)理论，通过152名软件专业人员的调查数据，验证了AI工具的采用与社区气味（community smells）之间的关系并非单一方向，而是取决于工作类型：在专业化工作中，AI通过促进知识共享的同伴互动减少社区气味；在协调工作中，AI直接提升沟通质量，补充而非替代人类互动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助开发工具的广泛采用正在改变软件团队的协作、知识共享和协调方式，但其对团队社会动态的影响尚不明确。现有研究缺乏对AI采用与社区气味（反映协调和沟通障碍的社会技术反模式）之间关系及其作用机制的深入理解。

Method: 基于TMS理论，验证了Human-AI和Human-Human交互在专业化和协调两个TMS维度上的测量工具；从文献中提取社区气味构念，通过专家调查和因子分析进行验证；在152名使用AI工具的软件专业人员调查数据上测试了五个PLS-SEM模型。

Result: AI采用与社区气味的关系并非单一的，而是通过取决于工作性质的机制产生作用。在专业化工作中，AI与更高的知识共享同伴互动相关，进而与更少的社区气味相关；在协调工作中，AI直接与更高的沟通质量相关，补充而非替代人类互动。

Conclusion: 提供了一个经验验证的、基于TMS的模型，表明AI与社区气味之间的关系取决于协作类型；提供了可复用的测量工具，并为研究和实践提供了基于证据的启示。

Abstract: Context: The growing adoption of AI-assisted development tools is changing how software teams collaborate, share knowledge, and coordinate, yet its consequences for team social dynamics remain largely unexplored. Gap: It is unclear whether AI adoption is associated with an increase or reduction in community smells,socio-technical anti-patterns reflecting coordination and communication breakdowns,and through which mechanisms. Method: Grounded in Transactive Memory Systems (TMS) theory, we validate instruments for HumanAI and HumanHuman interaction along two TMS dimensions, Specialization and Coordination, and test five PLS-SEM models on survey data from 152 software professionals using AI tools. Community smell constructs were derived from the literature and validated through expert surveys and factor analysis. Results: AI adoption relates to community smells not in a single way, but through mechanisms depending on the work. In specialization work, AI is associated with higher knowledge-sharing peer interaction, which is in turn associated with fewer smells. In coordination work, AI is directly associated with higher communication quality, complementing rather than replacing human interaction. Contributions: We provide an empirically validated, TMS-grounded model showing that the AIcommunity-smell relationship is contingent on the type of collaboration, with a reusable instrument and evidence-based implications for research and practice.

</details>


### [251] [Leveraging System-Level Observations to Inform Bayesian Learning of Model Parameters for Quantitative Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03489)
*Simos Gerasimou,Xingyu Zhao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: EPIK是一种结合贝叶斯学习与定量验证的新方法，通过利用系统级可观测属性来获取和嵌入先验知识，从而提升定量验证的准确性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯学习与定量验证结合时，验证结果的准确性和鲁棒性高度依赖于贝叶斯推断中的先验知识。而先验知识通常需要领域专业知识，使用不准确或信息量不足的先验知识会导致错误的验证结果。现有方法要求先验知识基于正式的模型转移参数，这在实际中往往难以获得。因此需要一种更实用、更灵活的先验知识获取与嵌入方法。

Method: EPIK方法利用系统级可观测属性（与真实世界语义相关）来获取先验知识，而非依赖形式化的模型转移参数。它通过构建一个双重优化问题来推导未知转移参数的分布，然后将这些分布嵌入到定量验证中，用于验证新的或难以直接测量的属性。

Result: 通过使用多个真实世界案例研究的变体和多种EPIK实例化方式进行详细实验评估，证明了该方法在有效性、灵活性和通用性方面的优势。

Conclusion: EPIK提供了一种更实用且通用的框架，能够从系统级可观测属性中提取先验知识并嵌入定量验证过程，有效解决了先验知识获取困难的问题，提高了定量验证结果的准确性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Combining Bayesian learning and quantitative verification is a powerful toolset for analysing key quantitative properties of software systems, like reliability and response time. However, the accuracy and robustness of verification results strongly depend on the prior knowledge (PK) underlying Bayesian inference. This knowledge reflects original beliefs about the probability of events and typically depends on domain expertise. Using inaccurate or uninformative PK can negatively affect quantitative analysis, yielding incorrect verification results. Our EPIK approach tackles this important challenge by eliciting and embedding PK in quantitative verification equipped with Bayesian estimators. Unlike existing approaches that require PK on formal model transition parameters, EPIK leverages system-level properties that are directly observable and are linked to real-world semantics. EPIK formulates a twofold optimisation problem to derive the distributions of unknown transition parameters and then embeds these distributions to verify new or difficult-to-measure (elusive) properties. The detailed experimental evaluation using multiple variants of real-world case studies and diverse EPIK instantiations shows its effectiveness, flexibility and generality.

</details>


### [252] [CodeAssay: A Multi-Metric Benchmark with Audited Ground Truth for LLM Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03535)
*Shahbaz Siddeeq,Muhammad Waseem,Umar Subhan Malhi,Pekka Abrahamsson*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出CodeAssay，一个基于分类学的基准测试，包含185个Python任务，覆盖10个软件工程类别。它结合了审计过的真实标签、公共/隐藏测试、变异测试验证和代码属性度量。通过重新评分发现，审计后9.0%的正确性标签发生改变，最佳与最差模型间的差距从11.9扩大到23.7个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型的代码生成评估常依赖基于测试的基准，但这类评估的有效性取决于参考实现和测试的可靠性。此外，基于测试的正确性只能捕捉生成代码可观察属性的一部分，无法全面反映代码质量。现有评估缺乏对真实标签的系统审计、对测试套件的验证，以及多维度的代码属性度量。

Method: 构建CodeAssay基准：包含185个Python任务、10个软件工程类别；采用审计过的ground truth、公共测试（用于生成和修复）、隐藏测试（用于评分）、基于变异的测试套件验证（mutation testing），以及选定的代码属性度量。对7个专有LLM和14个模型-提示配置进行评估。

Result: 审计后170/1890个正确性标签（9.0%）被改变，最佳与最差模型差距从11.9%扩大到23.7%。完整和隐藏测试套件的变异分数分别为82.6%和74.8%。7个LLM的标准提示正确率范围为77.3%-98.9%，21对模型中有12对存在显著差异。所有模型在代码属性上均未全面领先。安全提示未显著改变正确性，也未一致减少静态分析发现，反而增加了程序长度和圈复杂度。

Conclusion: 可靠的LLM代码生成评估需要：验证过的ground truth、受保护的测试（隐藏测试）以及多个明确解释的度量指标。CodeAssay为AI辅助软件开发中的基于证据的模型评估提供了可复现的基础。

Abstract: Large Language Models are increasingly evaluated for code generation using test-based benchmarks. The validity of such evaluations depends on the reliability of their references and tests, while test-based correctness captures only part of the observable properties of generated code. We present CodeAssay, a taxonomy-first benchmark of 185 Python tasks across ten software-engineering categories. It combines audited ground truth, public tests for generation and repair, hidden tests for grading, mutation-based test-suite validation, and selected code-property measures. Regrading fixed model outputs after the audit changed 170 of 1,890 correctness labels (9.0%) and increased the measured best-to-worst model spread from 11.9 to 23.7 percentage points, although aggregate correctness remained nearly unchanged. The complete and hidden test suites achieved mutation scores of 82.6% and 74.8%, respectively. Across seven proprietary LLMs, standard-prompt correctness ranged from 77.3% to 98.9%, with significant differences in 12 of 21 model pairs. On the 120 tasks solved by all 14 model-prompt configurations, no model performed best across all selected code properties. A security-focused prompt produced no significant change in correctness or consistent reduction in the selected static-analysis findings, while increasing program length and cyclomatic complexity across all models. These findings show that reliable evaluation of LLM-generated code requires validated ground truth, protected tests, and multiple explicitly interpreted measures. CodeAssay provides a reproducible basis for evidence-based model evaluation in AI-augmented software development.

</details>


### [253] [EffiHolmes: Differential Profiling-Guided Repository Level Time Inefficiency Fix Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03558)
*Haowen Yang,Yun Peng,Zishuo Ding*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出EffiHolmes，一个基于LLM的仓库级时间低效修复定位框架，通过差分剖析、紧凑执行路径提取和领域引导的LLM推理来定位低效代码位置，并引入首个仓库级低效定位基准RepoEffi-Bench。实验表明其性能优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型软件系统常存在时间低效问题，但定位修复位置非常困难。与传统功能性bug不同，时间低效不会产生测试失败或堆栈追踪线索，因此传统方法和基于LLM的故障定位方法均不适用。运行时剖析虽能提供替代证据，但在仓库级设置下面临三大挑战：单次运行剖析无法可靠区分低效热点与执行噪声；现有剖析器难以从大量后台执行中提取相关执行路径；观察到的热点与实际修复位置之间存在语义鸿沟。

Method: EffiHolmes采用三阶段方法：1) 在默认和缩放工作负载下进行差分剖析以识别低效热点；2) 提取连接热点与报告低效函数的紧凑执行路径；3) 使用领域引导的LLM推理来定位底层低效逻辑。同时引入RepoEffi-Bench基准，包含140个来自流行Python仓库的高质量问题。

Result: 实验表明EffiHolmes持续优于基于检索、基于代理和基于剖析的最先进基线：使用GPT-5.1时文件级Acc@3提升4.29个百分点，使用qwen3-4b时函数级Acc@5提升15.00个百分点，且在不同模型能力下保持稳健。

Conclusion: EffiHolmes有效解决了仓库级时间低效修复定位的难题，通过差分剖析结合LLM推理弥合了热点与修复位置之间的语义鸿沟，为时间低效代码定位提供了可行且稳健的解决方案，并贡献了首个公开基准供后续研究使用。

Abstract: Large software systems often suffer from time inefficiencies that cause excessive execution time despite functional correctness. Localizing their fix locations is difficult because, unlike functional bugs, they produce neither test failures nor stack-trace clues, making traditional and recent LLM-based fault localization methods unsuitable. Runtime profiling provides alternative evidence but faces three challenges in repository-level settings: single-run profiling cannot reliably distinguish inefficiency hotspots from execution noise; existing profilers struggle to extract relevant execution paths from extensive background execution; and a semantic gap remains between observed hotspots and actual fix locations. We propose EffiHolmes, an LLM-based framework for repository-level time inefficiency fix localization. EffiHolmes uses differential profiling under default and scaled workloads to identify inefficiency hotspots, extracts compact execution paths connecting these hotspots to the reported inefficient function, and employs domain-guided LLM reasoning to locate the underlying inefficiency logic. We also introduce RepoEffi-Bench, the first benchmark for repository-level inefficiency localization, containing 140 high-quality issues collected from popular Python repositories. Experiments show that EffiHolmes consistently outperforms state-of-the-art retrieval-, agent-, and profiling-based baselines, improving file-level Acc@3 by 4.29 percentage points with GPT-5.1 and function-level Acc@5 by 15.00 percentage points with qwen3-4b. It also remains robust across model capacities.

</details>


### [254] [From Bug Reports to Browser-Executable Procedures: An LLM-Driven Agent for Web GUI Bug Reproduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03598)
*Cunming Zhang,Yu Pei,Michail Papadakis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: ReBug是一个上下文感知的代理系统，能够从自然语言Web GUI缺陷报告中重建、执行和验证浏览器级别的复现流程，通过在真实浏览器中驱动交互来解决现有方法缺乏端到端可视执行和验证的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复现Web GUI缺陷至关重要但因报告缺少前置条件（如依赖和输入文件）而困难重重。现有缺陷复现技术主要针对代码单元或移动应用，缺乏面向Web GUI的端到端可视执行与验证能力。

Method: ReBug将复现分为两个阶段：1) 准备阶段——从报告和可用工件中重建缺失的前置条件，生成高层复现计划；2) 执行阶段——在浏览器中进行工具介导的交互，维护页面状态和动作历史的结构化摘要，并根据报告中的预期验证最终状态。

Result: 在来自四个开源Web应用的667个真实缺陷报告上评估：平均RSR为49.96%，平均任务完成率为74.96%，平均动作执行成功率为86.54%，均优于两个基线。历史回放显示成功流程通常在恢复的缺陷版本上暴露原始缺陷行为。

Conclusion: 显式的上下文重建和状态感知的浏览器执行能有效支持从报告派生的浏览器复现，验证了该方法在真实Web应用上的实用性和有效性。

Abstract: Reproducing web GUI bugs from natural-language bug reports is critical for software maintenance, but remains difficult because reports often lack prerequisites such as dependencies and input files. Existing bug reproduction techniques mainly target code units or mobile applications and lack end-to-end visual execution and validation for web GUIs. We present ReBug, a context-aware agent system that reconstructs, executes, and validates browser-level reproduction procedures from web GUI bug reports by driving a real browser. ReBug separates reproduction into two stages. In the preparation stage, ReBug reconstructs missing prerequisites from the report and available artifacts, and it produces a high-level reproduction plan. In the execution stage, it performs tool-mediated interactions in the browser, maintains structured summaries of page state and action history, and validates the final state against expectations derived from the report. We evaluate ReBug on 667 real-world bug reports from four open-source web applications. On controlled current deployments, ReBug outperforms both baselines, achieving an average RSR of 49.96%, a mean task completion rate of 74.96%, and a mean action execution success rate of 86.54%. Our results show that explicit context reconstruction and state-aware browser execution effectively support report-derived browser reproduction, while historical replay shows that successful procedures often expose the original bug-present behavior on restored buggy versions.

</details>


### [255] [Pattern over Pixels: Measuring Pattern Completion Bias in Multimodal Code Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03691)
*Khai-Nguyen Nguyen,Oscar Chaparro,Antonio Mastropaolo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个视觉模式完成偏差基准测试，通过补全任务（隐藏UI元素宽度或字体大小）评估MLLMs在网页截图转代码时受重复UI模式影响的程度。实验发现5个前沿MLLM的平均偏差率高达69.78%（卡片宽度）和80.22%（文本字体大小），准确率仅为21.17%和7.89%，表明模型严重倾向于输出与重复模式一致但视觉上错误的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）被越来越多地用于将网页截图翻译为前端代码，但重复的UI模式可能会使模型倾向于输出视觉上不正确但与模式一致的答案。这一问题此前未被系统性研究，缺乏专门的基准测试来量化这种偏差。

Method: 构建视觉模式完成偏差基准：从Design2Code数据集中精选30个网页，构建1,440张评估截图，涵盖结构卡片和文本样式两类模式，并在标准条件和噪声叠加条件下测试。任务设计为补全式（fill-in-the-blank），将重复UI模式中一个局部元素的宽度或字体大小遮蔽，要求模型从截图和HTML上下文中恢复该值。评估5个前沿MLLMs。

Result: 所有5个MLLM均强烈偏向重复基线。卡片宽度扰动平均偏差率69.78%，文本字体大小扰动平均偏差率80.22%；平均准确率分别为21.17%和7.89%。Codex-5.3表现最佳，但从卡片68.61%准确率降至文本13.89%；Flash-3.0在文本上偏差率达96.11%。噪声、更微妙的扰动和边界位置进一步增加偏差率。推理分析显示更大推理努力与更低偏差相关，但定性证据表明模型即使能识别异常元素，仍可能用模式一致的答案覆盖它。

Conclusion: 该研究识别出多模态代码生成中的一个具体失败模式，并表明其严重性与视觉显著性密切相关。即使模型能发现视觉异常元素，仍可能被重复模式压倒，这揭示了MLLMs在视觉-文本推理中的系统性偏差及其与视觉显著性的关联。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to translate webpage screenshots into front-end code, but repeated UI patterns may sway them toward visually incorrect yet pattern-consistent outputs. In this work, we test how repeated webpage patterns hurt MLLM accuracy on an objective screenshot-to-code fill-in-the-blank task. We introduce the first benchmark for visual pattern-completion bias, where one localized element in a repeated UI pattern is perturbed and the model must recover the masked width or font-size value from the screenshot and HTML context. Starting from 30 webpages curated from the Design2Code dataset, we build 1,440 evaluated screenshots spanning structural card and text-style patterns under standard and noise-overlaid conditions. We evaluate five frontier MLLMs and find that all are strongly biased toward the repeated baseline. Mean bias rate reaches 69.78% on card-width perturbations and 80.22% on text font-size perturbations, while mean accuracy is only 21.17% and 7.89%, respectively. Codex-5.3 performs best but still drops from 68.61% accuracy on cards to 13.89% on text, while Flash-3.0 reaches 96.11% bias on text. Noise, subtler perturbations, and boundary positions further increase bias rate. Reasoning analysis further shows that greater reasoning effort correlates with lower bias, yet qualitative evidence reveals that models can identify the anomalous element and still override it with the pattern-consistent answer. Our results identify a concrete failure mode in multimodal code generation and show that its severity is strongly associated with visual saliency

</details>


### [256] [We Must Have Missed This Comment: Detecting and Repairing Stale Function References in Linux Kernel Comments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03734)
*Kexin Sun,Yunbo Lyu,Xutong Ma,Hongyu Kuang,Ratnadira Widyasari,He Zhang,Xiaoxing Ma,Julia Lawall,David Lo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: ReCite是一个三阶段方法，用于检测和修复Linux内核中注释过期函数引用的问题。它通过符号检测、Git历史追踪和LLM修复建议生成，在Linux内核v6.18-rc1上检测到869个过期引用，人工评估中89.0%的修复建议有用，提交的75个补丁中有50个被接受。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Linux内核演化过程中，代码注释可能过期，因为注释中引用的函数可能在重构或删除时未被同步更新。这类过期的函数引用会误导维护者并阻碍代码理解。现有工作主要关注Javadoc注释与其直接注解函数之间的语义不一致，无法处理这种由外部变更导致的过期引用问题。

Method: ReCite采用三阶段方法：(1) 检测未解析的函数形式符号——识别注释中看似引用函数但在当前代码库中找不到匹配函数的符号；(2) 通过Git历史追踪每个未解析符号的演化历程；(3) 基于演化历史和当前代码上下文生成基于LLM的修复建议。

Result: 在Linux内核v6.18-rc1上，ReCite检测到869个过期引用并生成修复建议。对200个采样修复的人工评估显示，178个（89.0%）提供有用的修复指导，其中85个（42.5%）可直接应用。提交的75个补丁中有50个已被接受。

Conclusion: ReCite有效解决了Linux内核中由外部变更引起的注释过期引用问题，其LLM生成的修复建议具有较高的实用性和可接受率，验证了结合Git历史演进信息与LLM推理来修复代码注释的一致性是可行的。

Abstract: As the Linux kernel evolves, code comments may become outdated, as the functions they reference can be refactored or removed independently without corresponding updates to the comments. Such stale function references can mislead maintainers and thus hinder code comprehension. Prior work on detecting code-comment inconsistency mainly focused on addressing semantic misalignment between Javadoc comments and their directly annotated functions, making them inapplicable to this type of externally induced staleness in the Linux kernel. Therefore, we propose ReCite, a three-stage approach to identify and repair such stale references: (1) detecting unresolved function-form symbols -- symbols in comments that appear to reference functions but for which no matching function can be found in the current codebase, (2) tracing the evolution history of each unresolved symbol through the Git history, and (3) generating LLM-based repair suggestions grounded in the evolution history and current code context. On Linux kernel v6.18-rc1, ReCite detects 869 stale references with generated repair suggestions. A manual evaluation on 200 sampled repairs shows that 178 (89.0%) provide useful repair guidance, with 85 (42.5%) directly applicable. Of our 75 submitted patches, 50 have been accepted. We also empirically study all unresolved function-form symbols.

</details>


### [257] [Can LLMs Test Terminal User Interfaces?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03743)
*Chao Peng,Ruida Hu,Ajitha Rajan,Tegawendé F Bissyandé,Jacques Klein,Cuiyun Gao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文系统调查研究了197个真实世界的TUI应用，发现现有测试代码很少真正交互界面。作者构建了跨四种框架的无头基准测试平台，对比了四个前沿LLM与随机探索，发现随机探索在时间预算下是强基线，LLM引导在单次交互中更高效且能触达输入门控故障，但没有模型完全占优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TUI（终端用户界面）在开发者工具中已无处不在，融合了GUI的有状态、屏幕导向行为与终端部署方式，但缺乏专门的测试方法论。现有测试实践中只有极少数真正驱动界面交互，需要系统性研究TUI自动化测试的可行性与方法。

Method: 作者调查197个真实TUI应用（覆盖ratatui/Rust、bubbletea/Go、textual/Python、ink/TypeScript四种框架），将应用转化为打包为可插桩Docker镜像的headless基准测试。在等量墙钟时间预算下，对比四种前沿LLM与随机探索，记录行/组件覆盖率、渲染终端状态和崩溃。还实现并发布了覆盖工具tuicov和测试框架tuibot。

Result: 仅有12%的测试代码真正驱动界面，其中45%从不发送输入。没有单一模型全面占优；随机探索是高吞吐量的强时间预算基线，但LLM引导按交互计更高效且能更独特地发现输入门控故障；自动推导启动输入带来最大的实际收益；行覆盖率无法很好预测崩溃发现。

Conclusion: 自动化TUI测试是可行的但远未解决；诚实的基线对比比模型选择更重要。研究贡献包括系统性基准、可复现工具链（tuicov与tuibot），以及对覆盖率指标作为测试有效性代理的批判性发现。

Abstract: Terminal User Interfaces (TUIs) combine the stateful, screen-oriented behaviour of GUIs with terminal deployment and are now common in developer tools. Yet they lack a dedicated testing methodology. We survey 197 real-world TUI applications: only 12% of test code exercises the interface, and 45% of those tests never send input, checking a static frame instead. We turn these applications into a headless benchmark spanning ratatui/Rust, bubbletea/Go, textual/Python, and ink/TypeScript, packaging each as an instrumented Docker image. We record line and widget coverage where reliable, rendered terminal states, and crashes. Under equal wall-clock budgets, we compare four frontier LLMs with random exploration. No model dominates. Random is a strong time-budgeted baseline, but its crash advantage comes from higher throughput: per interaction, LLM guidance is more efficient and uniquely reaches input-gated faults. Automatically deriving launch inputs yields the largest practical gain, enabling applications that otherwise never start. Line coverage poorly predicts crash discovery, weakening it as a proxy for test effectiveness. Automated TUI testing is feasible but far from solved, and honest baselines matter more than model choice. We release the coverage tool tuicov at https://github.com/tui-testing/tuicov and the testing framework tuibot at https://github.com/tui-testing/tuibot.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [258] [Deep Divide-and-Reduce in Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02628)
*Yusong Deng,Yanjie Li,Weijun Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DDRSR方法，通过严格的数学推导和证明，扩展了符号回归中表达式分解与约简的适用范围，避免了暴力搜索子表达式，在保持理论正确性的同时提升了实用性和回归性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有符号回归的机器学习方法缺乏对表达式内在数学和物理原理的深刻理解。AI Feynman方法虽然利用了数据的数学性质，但其表达式简化机制适用范围窄、复杂方程易失败，且依赖暴力搜索子表达式，严重限制了实际应用。

Method: 通过严格的数学推导和证明，提出DDRSR（Deep Divide and Reduce in Symbolic Regression）方法。该方法从根本上拓宽了表达式分解与约简的适用范围，避免了对子结构的暴力搜索，同时保证了更广泛的通用性和严格的理论正确性。

Result: 经验评估表明，DDRSR在表达式分解和数值回归任务中均展现出显著优势。

Conclusion: 作者讨论了该范式的适用场景和固有局限性，并提出了未来研究的有前景方向。

Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) is the task of discovering underlying patterns from data and representing them using mathematical expressions. Current machine learning approaches to SR often lack a profound understanding of the intrinsic mathematical and physical principles governing these expressions. While the pioneering AI Feynman method leverages the mathematical properties underlying the data, its expression simplification mechanism suffers from a narrow scope of applicability and is prone to failure on complex equations. Furthermore, its underlying mechanisms rely heavily on brute-force searches for sub-expressions, severely limiting its practical utility. Through rigorous mathematical deduction and proofs, we propose our method, Deep Divide and Reduce in Symbolic Regression (DDRSR). DDRSR fundamentally broadens the applicability of expression decomposition and reduction, circumvents the need for brute-force sub-structure searches, and ensures both wider versatility and strict theoretical correctness. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that these theoretical principles yield significant advantages in both expression decomposition and numerical regression tasks. Finally, we discuss the applicable scenarios and inherent limitations of this paradigm, alongside promising directions for future research.

</details>


### [259] [Multimodal Auto-regressive Transformer Surrogate for Modeling Variable Operations and Quantifying Uncertainty in Geological Carbon Storage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02629)
*Yifu Han,Louis J. Durlofsky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文开发了一种新型多模态自回归Transformer代理模型，用于在地质不确定性下模拟CO2地质封存操作（可变射孔与注入策略），并通过分层MCMC数据同化实现关键参数（如断层渗透率）的不确定性大幅降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地质碳封存（GCS）操作的效率可通过可变井射孔和注入策略提高，但在地质不确定性下准确模拟这些复杂操作（多模态输入、多阶段射孔、时变控制）需要高效且精准的代理模型，以替代昂贵的全物理仿真。

Method: 开发多模态自回归Transformer代理模型：分别编码3D地质模型、相对渗透率标量参数和控制变量三个输入模态，通过自注意力融合，再利用编码器-解码器交叉注意力以自回归方式生成时序预测。使用4000次GEOS流动模拟训练，预测饱和度、压力、CO2注入总量/可动质量及饱和度足迹。

Result: 在测试集上获得中位数饱和度MAE为0.028，其他目标量中位相对误差为0.2-5%；能捕捉速率控制向井底压力控制的切换。在分层MCMC数据同化中显著降低关键元参数（尤其断层渗透率）的不确定性，后验预测与真实模型结果一致。

Conclusion: 该多模态Transformer代理模型在模拟复杂CO2封存操作中兼顾高精度与低误差，并在数据同化框架下有效进行不确定性量化，为地质碳封存的实际部署提供了可靠的决策支持工具。

Abstract: The use of variable well perforation and injection strategies can improve the efficiency of geological carbon storage operations. We develop a new multimodal auto-regressive transformer surrogate to model these operations under geological uncertainty. A modified SEAM CO2 geomodel, which involves a faulted system with three stacked aquifers, is considered. The two injection wells are perforated in stages, from bottom to top, with the stage durations and individual well injection rates treated as control variables. The surrogate model processes three input modalities - the 3D geomodel, scalar parameters characterizing relative permeability functions, and control variables - through separate encoders. These are fused via self-attention in a transformer encoder, and a temporal decoder generates predictions auto-regressively through encoder-decoder cross-attention. The surrogate is trained, using 4000 GEOS flow simulations, to predict saturation and pressure at monitoring locations, total injected and mobile CO2 mass, and saturation footprints. For a new test set, involving randomly sampled geomodels and control variables, the surrogate achieves a median saturation MAE of 0.028 and median relative errors of 0.2-5% for the other quantities of interest. Importantly, it captures the switch from rate to bottom-hole-pressure control. The surrogate model is used within a hierarchical Markov chain Monte Carlo data assimilation procedure for a synthetic true model under three operational strategies. Substantial uncertainty reduction is achieved for key metaparameters, particularly the fault permeabilities. Posterior predictions for saturation footprints and total injected and mobile CO2 mass are also shown to be generally consistent with true model results.

</details>


### [260] [AS-FedBridge: Pseudo-Spike Bridge Distillation for Heterogeneous ANN-SNN Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03324)
*Shengyang Li,Yiting Dong,Liuyang Song,Ximing Wang,Luyuan Xie,Cong Li,Qingni Shen,Zhaofei Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AS-FedBridge，一种面向混合ANN-SNN客户端的联邦学习框架，通过轻量级Bridge和Pseudo-Spike接口解决连续激活与离散脉冲之间的表征错位问题，在四个数据集上超越多种异构联邦学习方法，同时仅引入微小计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中引入SNN可提升边缘设备能效，但混合ANN-SNN客户端训练存在表征错位问题——ANN的连续实值激活与SNN的离散时空脉冲之间存在语义鸿沟，缺乏有效的对齐机制，且尚无成熟的混合ANN-SNN联邦学习框架。

Method: 提出AS-FedBridge框架，包含一个轻量级Bridge模块，通过Pseudo-Spike接口将连续信号投影到与脉冲兼容的空间，实现ANN与SNN之间的表征对齐。同时建立首个混合ANN-SNN联邦学习的综合基准，用于对比多种异构联邦学习方法。

Result: 实验证明ANN-SNN对齐程度与协作联邦性能呈正相关。在四个数据集上，AS-FedBridge在准确性上持续领先，有效缓解了极端规模、架构和客户端异构性带来的挑战，且只需极小的额外计算开销。

Conclusion: AS-FedBridge实现了模型性能与资源效率之间高度可控的权衡，为混合ANN-SNN联邦学习系统提供了稳健且实用的基础框架。

Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative model training across distributed edge devices while strictly preserving data privacy. To facilitate practical deployment on resource-constrained edge devices, Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have emerged as a promising alternative to traditional Artificial Neural Networks (ANNs) due to their sparse computing mechanisms and high energy efficiency. However, jointly training ANNs and SNNs exposes a challenge of representational misalignment, which is intrinsically caused by differences in information representation, specifically the semantic gap between continuous real-valued activations in ANNs and discrete spatio-temporal spikes in SNNs. To overcome this barrier, we propose AS-FedBridge, a novel federated learning framework tailored for mixed ANN-SNN clients. AS-FedBridge features a lightweight Bridge equipped with a Pseudo-Spike Interface, which effectively projects continuous signals into a spike-compatible space to facilitate ANN-SNN alignment. Given the absence of existing mixed ANN-SNN federated frameworks, we establish a comprehensive benchmark to evaluate against multiple advanced heterogeneous FL methods. Our empirical analysis demonstrates a positive correlation between the degree of ANN-SNN alignment and the collaborative FL performance. Across four datasets, AS-FedBridge consistently demonstrates advanced accuracy while mitigating extreme scale, architecture, and client heterogeneity challenge. Furthermore, our framework enables a highly controllable trade-off between model performance and resource efficiency. AS-FedBridge accomplishes these robust performance gains while introducing only marginal computational overhead, establishing a robust and practical foundation for mixed ANN-SNN federated learning systems.

</details>


### [261] [LLMs Can Annotate Attribution Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02632)
*Ameen Patel,Max Zhang,Nathan Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自动化电路追踪（circuit tracing）管道，通过让语言模型直接对特征描述进行分组生成supernode，无需人工手动分组。实验表明该管道生成的supernode与人工标注的同样可解释，在两跳Capitals任务中97/100的提示能恢复中间跳的supernode，并展示了在开放探索场景中的概念验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电路追踪是揭示语言模型内部计算的关键技术，但现有方法需要耗时耗力的人工步骤来将单个特征或MLP神经元分组为supernode。这一手动步骤严重限制了电路追踪的可扩展性和广泛应用，因此需要自动化解决方案。

Method: 提出一个简单管道：直接将特征描述（feature descriptions）提供给语言模型，由语言模型自动将它们分组为supernode。通过自动化可解释性指标验证分组质量，并运用该管道处理两跳Capitals任务和Wikipedia提示补全的1000个归因图（attribution graphs），最后用LLM法官标记值得人工审查的图。

Result: 1) 自动化管道生成的supernode与人工标注的可解释性相当；2) 在两跳Capitals任务中，97/100个提示能成功恢复中间跳对应的supernode；3) 在开放探索场景中，成功自动标注1000个归因图并利用LLM法官筛选出有趣的图。

Conclusion: 即使简单的自动化方案也能产生有意义的归因图标注，为自动化电路追踪的进一步研究提供了基础。这项工作表明将该手动步骤自动化是可行且有效的，有望推动电路追踪技术的规模化应用。

Abstract: Circuit tracing is an exciting technique for revealing the internal computation of language models, but it requires a time-intensive manual step of grouping individual features or MLP neurons into supernodes. We present a simple pipeline for automating this step: directly presenting feature descriptions to a language model that groups them into supernodes. Using automated interpretability metrics, we confirm that supernodes generated by our pipeline are as interpretable as those generated by human annotators. On a two-hop Capitals task, our pipeline recovers a supernode corresponding to the intermediate hop in 97 of 100 prompts. Finally, we present a simple proof of concept using our pipeline for open-ended exploration, where we automatically annotate 1000 attribution graphs from Wikipedia prompt completions and then use an LLM judge to flag interesting graphs worth human review. We hope this work demonstrates that even simple automation can produce meaningful attribution graph annotations, motivating further work on automated circuit tracing.

</details>


### [262] [Omega-S: A Functional Resilience Index for LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03887)
*Alberto Acedo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Omega-S是一种仅从权重矩阵计算的drop-in惩罚项，无需先前任务数据、Fisher矩阵或旧权重副本，只需三行代码且增加不到4%的计算开销。在Llama-3-8B的LoRA微调（代码→散文）中，相比无正则化、调优的权重衰减和EWC，显著提升了原始能力的保留（保留率从62.9%提升到84.1%）。论文还通过测量证明其实际机制是节点度的方差惩罚（而非声称的拓扑构造），并量化了低秩微调中罕见的重复实验标准差（0.104），为种子配对比较提供了置信边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在新数据上微调会遗忘先前学到的知识（灾难性遗忘）。现有解决方案需要先前任务数据、Fisher矩阵或旧权重副本，成本高且不实用。作者希望设计一个轻量、即插即用的正则化方法，仅需权重矩阵即可在微调时保留模型原有能力。

Method: Omega-S是一个从权重矩阵单独计算的惩罚项，插入现有训练循环仅需三行代码。其目标函数基于Tr(A^3)的拓扑构造，但作者通过弹性分析测量发现，四个因子中只有度方差项实际发挥作用（弹性9e-3，其余≤1e-4）。因此在实现层面，它等价于对节点度方差的惩罚——方阵模块惩罚行幅值，非方阵模块惩罚方向对齐。论文还枚举了开放设计选择，包括一个对比保留构造（虽按设计工作但使保留效果变差）。

Result: 在Llama-3-8B上从代码微调到散文，使用LoRA和HumanEval指标：1) 10个种子中9个超过无正则化（0.173→0.238 pass@1，符号检验p=0.011，Wilcoxon p=0.006），保留率62.9%→84.1%；2) 10/10种子胜过调优的权重衰减（p=0.002），8/10胜过调优的EWC（p=0.014）。重复相同配置在不同种子的保留率标准差为0.104，为文献中所有种子配对比较提供了误差边界。

Conclusion: Omega-S提供了一种极简、低成本且有效的保留正则化方案。论文强调了机制透明性——诚实报告方法的宣称机制与实际梯度行为可能不一致；同时量化了低秩语言模型微调中此前未报告的重复实验变异性（SD=0.104），这对整个种子配对比较文献都具有重要意义。代码、逐种子结果和完整负面结果均已公开。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a large language model on new data degrades what it previously learned. We present Omega-S, a drop-in penalty computed from the weight matrix alone: it needs no previous-task data, no Fisher matrix and no stored copy of the old weights. It is three lines in an existing training loop and adds under 4% to the cost of a step.
  Retention. On Llama-3-8B with LoRA, fine-tuned from code to prose and measured by HumanEval over ten seeds, Omega-S retains more of the original capability than no regularisation on 9 of 10 seeds (0.173 -> 0.238 absolute pass@1; sign test one-sided p=0.011, Wilcoxon p=0.006), as a retention ratio, 62.9% -> 84.1%. It also beats tuned weight decay on 10 of 10 seeds (p=0.002) and tuned EWC on 8 of 10 (p=0.014), every arm re-measured in the same session.
  Mechanism, measured rather than asserted. Omega-S is topological by construction, its objective built from Tr(A^3), but we measured which of its four factors actually moves and three do not: their elasticity with respect to the weights is at or below 1e-4, against 9e-3 for the degree-variance term. As implemented, the composite reduces to a penalty on the variance of node degrees, which means row magnitude in square modules and directional alignment in non-square ones. We report this because a method whose name promises one thing and whose gradient does another should say so. We also enumerate the open design choices, including a contrast-preserving construction that does what it was designed to do and makes retention worse on all ten seeds.
  Repeating an identical configuration, same seed and same hardware, gives a standard deviation of 0.104 in retention ratio. We have not found this quantified for low-rank fine-tuning of language models, and it bounds every seed-paired comparison in this literature, ours included.
  Code, per-seed results and the full record of negative results are available.

</details>


### [263] [GeoID-PINN: Identifiability-Aware Regional Epidemic Inference with Geographic Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02633)
*Weixiong Hua,Fan Bu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GeoID-PINN，一种用于SIRD动力学的物理信息神经网络，通过行随机源组成矩阵建模区域间空间依赖关系，并利用距离、邻接、通勤或领先-滞后信息构造空间先验进行正则化。模拟实验表明先验与真实结构匹配时效果好，误设先验则误差显著增大；路易斯安那州64县COVID-19数据验证中，该模型在点预测精度上优于自回归负二项基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 区域监测数据同时反映本地传播、报告、输入病例和外部感染压力等多重因素，这些因素难以单独识别。需要一种能够区分区域间依赖结构与单区域传播动力学的方法。

Method: 提出GeoID-PINN，物理信息神经网络（PINN）用于SIRD动力学建模。空间依赖通过行随机源组成矩阵表示（每行元素非负且和为1），并用空间先验（距离、邻接、通勤、领先-滞后等）进行正则化。通过回归训练估计模型参数。

Result: 四区域模拟中，匹配的距离先验源组成误差为0.099，无正则化时为0.159，强误设先验时升至0.577，但轨迹拟合和传播尺度估计变化不大，说明准确轨迹不能保证区域依赖结构恢复。路易斯安那州64县COVID-19回顾性评估中，Geo-PINN将MSE从32,957降至11,468，MAE从70.60降至57.73，但基线NLL更低（5.158 vs 5.346）。15县对照中，县邻接先验使MSE降低6.85%，MAE降低3.1%。

Conclusion: 结构化正则化能在不同先验下保持稳定性能，但无法唯一恢复区域间边结构。模型结果需进行先验敏感性和观测模型检验后才能解释。

Abstract: Regional surveillance data reflect local transmission, reporting, seeding, and external infection pressure, which are difficult to identify separately. We introduce GeoID-PINN, a physics-informed neural network (PINN) for susceptible-infectious-recovered-deceased (SIRD) dynamics. The model represents spatial dependence with a row-stochastic source-composition matrix whose rows assign nonnegative source weights that sum to one. We regularize this matrix toward a spatial prior constructed from distance, adjacency, commuting, or lead-lag information. In a four-region simulation with known truth, a compatible distance prior gives source-composition error 0.099. The error rises to 0.159 without regularization and 0.577 under a strongly misspecified prior, while trajectory fit and transmission-scale estimates remain similar. Accurate trajectories therefore do not guarantee recovery of the regional dependence structure. We also evaluate GeoID-PINN retrospectively using COVID-19 data from 64 Louisiana counties. Relative to an autoregressive negative-binomial baseline, Forecast-Trained Geo-PINN reduces mean squared error (MSE) from 32,957 to 11,468 and mean absolute error (MAE) from 70.60 to 57.73. The baseline has lower negative log likelihood (NLL), 5.158 versus 5.346, indicating better distributional fit but worse point accuracy. In a controlled 15-county comparison, county adjacency reduces MSE by 6.85 percent and MAE by 3.1 percent. Similar performance across plausible priors supports structured regularization but not unique edge recovery. These results require prior-sensitivity and observation-model checks before interpretation.

</details>


### [264] [Verifier-Guided Model Discovery for Physical Dynamical Systems with Pretrained Symbolic Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02662)
*Farbod Faraji,Francesco Belardinelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种验证器引导（Verifier-Guided, VG）的工作流程，利用预训练的ODEFormer作为符号骨干，通过动力学和物理可容许性标准从多轨迹候选方程池中筛选方程，实现将符号回归可靠迁移到高维物理数据上的可解释预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高保真物理系统仿真成本过高，机器学习替代模型不透明且依赖系统动力学假设，预训练Transformer虽然能实现可解释的符号发现，但将其可靠迁移到高维物理数据仍是一个未解决的挑战。

Method: 提出验证器引导（VG）工作流：以ODEFormer作为符号骨架，利用动力学和物理可容许性（admissibility）标准作为验证器，从多轨迹候选方程池中筛选出最优方程，实现跨系统迁移。在涡脱落问题中结合坐标降维和符号发现，处理固定及变化Reynolds数场景。

Result: 在Van der Pol振荡器上，VG方法在未见初始条件下优于原始ODEFormer流程。在涡脱落场景中，VG发现了能恢复基本脱落振荡器及高次谐波的固定参数降阶方程，且不需要尾流特定的候选库或预设Navier-Stokes结构；跨参数模型能泛化到未训练的Reynolds数区域。研究发现重建保真度本身并不决定符号可发现性，潜在动力学与骨干模型预训练分布的兼容性至关重要。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了一种验证器引导的神经到符号（neural-to-symbolic）方法论，为自然科学中可解释且物理可审计的预测提供了新途径。

Abstract: Reliable forecasting of nonlinear physical systems underpins scientific discovery and engineering decision-making. Yet high-fidelity simulations are prohibitively costly, and machine-learning surrogates can be opaque and encode assumptions about system dynamics, limiting generalizability. Pretrained transformers mapping synthetic ODE trajectories to equations offer interpretable alternatives, promising transfer without system-specific equation knowledge. Transferring them reliably to high-dimensional physical data, however, remains an open challenge. We develop a verifier-guided (VG) workflow around ODEFormer as a symbolic backbone, using dynamical and physical-admissibility criteria to select from a multi-trajectory candidate equation pool, enabling transfer. On canonical Van der Pol oscillators, VG outperforms the original ODEFormer workflow across held-out initial conditions. We then address vortex shedding, a phenomenon occurring in atmospheric and plasma systems of societal relevance, through coordinate reduction and symbolic discovery at fixed and varying Reynolds numbers. VG discovers fixed-parameter reduced-order equations that recover the fundamental shedding oscillator and higher harmonics without a wake-specific candidate library or prescribed Navier-Stokes structure, while the cross-parameter model generalizes to withheld regimes. Reconstruction fidelity alone did not determine symbolic discoverability, highlighting the importance of compatibility between latent dynamics and the backbone's pretraining distribution. This work establishes a verifier-guided neural-to-symbolic methodology for interpretable and physically auditable forecasting in the natural sciences.

</details>


### [265] [CT-HEG: A Bidirectional, Timestamp-Attributed Event Graph for ICU In-Hospital Mortality Prediction - An Architectural Ablation Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02663)
*Mohammad Nasir Uddin,Rahnuma Tabassum Orpita,Asaduzzaman Anik,Eklachur Rahman Bhuiyan,Marjahan Risalat,SM Wali Ullah,Asif Ahamed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出连续时间异质电子健康记录图（CT-HEG）模式，将ICU住院表示为带类型和2D边属性的时间戳图（三类节点：就诊、生命体征、实验室事件），并实例化为CHIRP-Net（四层异质GATv2Conv网络）。在MIMIC-IV v3.1上（31,142例ICU住院，13.4%死亡率）实现5种子平均AUROC 0.8449±0.0071，集成AUROC达0.8618。关键发现：双向连通性对模型至关重要（移除后AUROC下降0.1968），折叠异质边类型反而表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有序列模型能处理不规则采样但忽略类型化关系结构；现有图模型假设固定间隔输入。ICU死亡率预测需要同时建模不规则临床观测的时序特征与异质实体间的类型化关系，现有方法无法同时满足这两个需求。

Method: 提出CT-HEG模式：将每个ICU住院编码为类型化、带时间戳的图，包含三种节点类型（visit、vital、lab_event）和2D边属性（t_hours/48时间归一化、value_norm数值归一化），无需插补。实例化为CHIRP-Net，采用四层异质GATv2Conv网络。在MIMIC-IV v3.1上与逻辑回归、mTAND、Transformer、GRU-D对比，并进行消融实验。

Result: CHIRP-Net的5种子平均AUROC为0.8449±0.0071（AUPRC 0.4958±0.0209），集成AUROC达0.8618（95% CI: 0.8485-0.8745）。去除反向边使AUROC下降0.1968±0.0073；时间注意边特征贡献0.0247±0.0093 AUROC；折叠异质边类型（参数减少7倍）在所有种子上优于完整模型。校准后ECE为0.0307。

Conclusion: CT-HEG方案适用于不规则EHR数据，双向连通性是模型能利用输入的必要条件，模型在校准后表现良好。但外部验证、预设时间评估和人口统计学公平性审计仍不可或缺，才能确认模型的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Accurate ICU mortality prediction requires modeling irregular clinical observations across heterogeneous entity types. Existing sequence models handle irregular sampling but ignore typed relational structure; existing graph models assume fixed-interval inputs. We introduce the Continuous-Time Heterogeneous EHR Graph (CT-HEG) schema and evaluate which architectural choices drive predictive performance. CT-HEG encodes each ICU stay as a typed, timestamped graph with three node types (visit, vital, lab_event) and 2D edge attributes (t_hours/48, value_norm) encoding timing and value without imputation. We instantiate CT-HEG as CHIRP-Net, a four-layer heterogeneous GATv2Conv network, evaluated on MIMIC-IV v3.1 (31,142 ICU stays, LOS>=48h, 13.4% mortality) with five seeds and bootstrapped confidence intervals, against logistic regression, mTAND, a Transformer, and GRU-D, plus an ablation study. CHIRP-Net achieved 5-seed mean AUROC 0.8449+/-0.0071 (AUPRC 0.4958+/-0.0209); the ensemble achieved AUROC 0.8618 (95% CI: 0.8485-0.8745). Removing reverse edges disconnected observation nodes from the visit readout, cutting AUROC by 0.1968+/-0.0073. Time-attentive edge features contributed 0.0247+/-0.0093 AUROC. Collapsing heterogeneous edge types into one relation (7x fewer parameters) outperformed the full model on all seeds. Post-calibration ECE was 0.0307. Temporal and demographic subgroup analyses were explored but not reported here, pending follow-up work. Bidirectional connectivity was necessary for the model to use its inputs at all, and CT-HEG was reasonably well calibrated after validation-fitted temperature scaling. These results support CT-HEG for irregular EHR data, while external validation, a pre-specified temporal evaluation, and a demographic fairness audit remain necessary before any claim of robustness. Code: https://github.com/nasiruddinstudents-ctrl/chirp-net-mimic-iv.

</details>


### [266] [Sphere Retraction Normalizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02668)
*Jie Zhang,Cheng-Fang Su,Yi-Jui Huang,Min-Te Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种统一的视角，将欧几里得残差连接和GeoNorm归一化方法置于同一框架下。通过在超球面上研究一般测度收缩映射（retraction map），作者发现该族映射可归结为单个标量设计选择——即更新幅度如何转换为旋转角度。基于此，作者提出了p-SpheretNorm这一单参数族方法，其中度量投影收缩和Cayley收缩分别对应于p=1和p=2的实例，而恒等映射和GeoNorm仅作为极限情况出现。在nanoGPT上的实验表明，所有提出的方法均优于现有的轻量级深层连接方案，且最优验证损失出现在有限的p值处，说明指数映射并非球形残差流的首选收缩方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 残差连接是训练深层神经网络的标准机制，GeoNorm通过黎曼流形上的测地线归一化将残差流限制在超球面上。然而，指数映射只是众多收缩映射（retraction）中的一种，现有研究缺乏对超球面上不同收缩映射的系统性理解，以及这些选择对网络训练效果的影响。

Method: 作者从理论上证明，在超球面上所有收缩映射族可归约为单一标量设计选择——即更新幅度到旋转角度的转换方式。基于这一统一框架，提出p-SpheretNorm单参数族方法。度量投影收缩（p=1）和Cayley收缩（p=2）都是精确保范的且仅需代数运算，而恒等映射和GeoNorm分别在参数趋于两端时作为极限恢复。

Result: 在nanoGPT上，所提出的三种方法（Proj-SpheretNorm、Cay-SpheretNorm和有限p的p-SpheretNorm）均优于现有的轻量级深层连接方案。最佳验证损失在有限的p值处取得，表明指数映射（即GeoNorm所采用的收缩）并非球形残差流的最优选择。

Conclusion: 该工作将欧几里得残差连接与GeoNorm统一到同一理论框架中，揭示了超球面上收缩映射族的结构化特性。实验结果表明，指数映射只是p-SpheretNorm谱系的一个端点，而非最优选择，为深度网络中的残差流设计提供了新的理论指导和实践方向。

Abstract: Residual connections are the de facto mechanism for training deep neural networks stably. Geodesic Normalization (GeoNorm) recasts them on a Riemannian manifold, orthogonalizing each layer output against the current hidden state and applying the resulting update through the Riemannian exponential map. Every hidden state thus keeps a constant $\ell_{2}$-norm, confining the residual stream to a hypersphere. The exponential map, however, is only one member of a broad family of retraction maps. We show that on the hypersphere this entire family collapses to a single scalar design choice. What distinguishes one retraction from another is only how the magnitude of an update is converted into a rotation angle within the plane spanned by the hidden state and the update. This view places Euclidean residual connections and GeoNorm in one framework. Instantiating it with the metric projection retraction and the Cayley retraction yields Proj-SpheretNorm and Cay-SpheretNorm, which are exactly norm-preserving yet require only algebraic operations. Both prove to be members of a one-parameter family of angular retractions, $p$-SpheretNorm, whose rotation angle saturates rather than growing without bound. The two methods above are recovered exactly at $p = 1$ and $p = 2$, while the identity map and GeoNorm arise only as limits at either end. On nanoGPT, all three methods outperform existing lightweight deep connection schemes, and the best validation loss is attained at finite $p$, indicating that the exponential map is not the preferred retraction for spherical residual streams but merely one end of a spectrum.

</details>


### [267] [Learning Molecular Representations from Cellular Phenotypes with Structure Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02688)
*Xuan Lin,Jingyu Sheng,Tengfei Ma,Li Sun,Dapeng Xiong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PhenMol，一个保结构的表型感知分子表示学习框架。该框架将分子和细胞表征解耦为共享和私有成分，在表型引导对齐的同时通过专门的分子分支保留化学结构信息。实验表明PhenMol在分子性质预测、分子-表型检索和临床试验结果预测等任务上表现优异，并且更好地保留了分子邻域结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多模态表示学习方法在优化跨模态对齐时，往往忽略了化学空间的固有组织结构，导致分子表示发生扭曲并丢失结构信息。这限制了表型药物发现中分子结构与细胞响应之间功能关系的准确建模。

Method: PhenMol采用解耦策略，将分子和细胞表示分别分解为共享组件和私有组件。通过共享组件实现表型引导的对齐，同时利用专门的分子分支保留化学结构的邻域组织，从而在整合细胞表型信息的同时避免破坏分子结构。

Result: 在约3.04×10^4个分子-细胞形态对上，PhenMol在270个生物活性任务的分子性质预测、分子-表型检索和临床试验结果预测中均取得改进。ECFP4结构分析表明，相比现有多模态对齐方法，PhenMol更好地保留了分子邻域并减少了嵌入扭曲。

Conclusion: 结构感知约束在多模态分子表示学习中至关重要，PhenMol提供了一种有效整合细胞表型与化学知识的方法，对药物发现具有重要价值。

Abstract: Phenotypic drug discovery enables the discovery of functional relationships between molecular structures and cellular responses. However, existing multimodal representation learning methods often optimize cross-modal alignment without considering the intrinsic organization of chemical space, resulting in distorted molecular representations and loss of structural information. We propose \textbf{PhenMol}, a structure-preserving framework for phenotype-aware molecular representation learning. PhenMol disentangles molecular and cellular representations into shared and private components, enabling phenotype-guided alignment while preserving chemical structures through a dedicated molecular branch. This design integrates cellular phenotype information without disrupting molecular neighborhood organization. Experiments on approximately $3.04 \times 10^{4}$ molecule--cell morphology pairs demonstrate that PhenMol improves molecular property prediction across 270 bioactivity tasks, molecule--phenotype retrieval, and clinical trial outcome prediction. Moreover, ECFP4-based structural analysis shows that PhenMol better preserves molecular neighborhoods and reduces embedding distortion compared with existing multimodal alignment methods. These results highlight the importance of structure-aware constraints in multimodal molecular representation learning and provide an effective approach for integrating cellular phenotypes with chemical knowledge for drug discovery.

</details>


### [268] [GLOBE: Trajectory-Aligned Gradient Matching with Structured SparseOptimization for Coreset Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02690)
*Hetian Liu,Jin Cui,Mengcheng Shi,Yanbin Hu,Xinyue Long,Boran Zhao,Pengju Pen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GLOBE是一个基于梯度轨迹的coreset选择框架，通过多检查点的梯度轨迹表示样本，结合多阶匹配目标和结构化稀疏正则化，在低保留率下显著提升下游测试准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于梯度的方法仅使用单一模型快照的梯度，且采用贪心或追踪式选择策略，无法捕捉优化动态变化，也难以处理强相关样本，限制了coreset选择的性能。

Method: GLOBE将样本选择建模为全局优化的稀疏加权问题。每个样本用跨多个训练检查点的梯度轨迹表示；引入多阶匹配目标对齐一阶均值和投影非中心二阶矩；结合Group LASSO、Elastic Net正则化和非负预算约束实现组级和样本级稀疏性；最后通过类平衡Top-K选择保证类别覆盖。

Result: 在六个基准和五种评估架构上，GLOBE一致优于现有coreset选择方法，尤其在低保留率下表现突出。

Conclusion: 结合动态梯度信息、多阶分布匹配和结构化稀疏性能有效提升数据高效学习的coreset选择效果。

Abstract: On-device training of deep neural networks is fundamentally constrained by the computational and memory costs of large-scale datasets. Coreset selection offers a practical solution by retaining only a compact subset of real training samples. However, existing gradient-based methods commonly rely on gradients computed at a single model snapshot and employ greedy or pursuit-based selection procedures, limiting their ability to capture evolving optimization dynamics and handle strongly correlated samples. We propose GLOBE (Gradient Local-Balanced Extraction), a trajectory-aligned coreset selection framework that formulates sample selection as a globally optimized sparse weighting problem. GLOBE represents each sample by a gradient trajectory constructed across multiple training checkpoints, thereby capturing its influence throughout different stages of optimization. To preserve the training behavior of the full dataset, we introduce a multi-order matching objective that jointly aligns the first-order mean and projected uncentered second-order moments of gradient trajectories. GLOBE further combines Group LASSO, Elastic Net regularization, and nonnegative budget constraints to induce group- and sample-level sparsity while stabilizing the weights of correlated trajectories. Finally, class-balanced Top-K selection maintains adequate category coverage under limited sampling budgets. Experiments across six benchmarks and five evaluation architectures demonstrate that GLOBE consistently outperforms existing coreset selection methods in downstream test accuracy, particularly at low retention ratios. These results highlight the effectiveness of combining dynamic gradient information, multi-order distribution matching, and structured sparsity for data-efficient learning.

</details>


### [269] [Output-Aware Rotation for INT2 KV-Cache Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02691)
*Vincent-Daniel Yun,Woosang Lim,Minsoo Cheong,Sunwoo Lee,Murali Annavaram,Sai Praneeth Karimireddy,Sungjoo Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OptR是一种输出感知的旋转方法，用于长上下文大语言模型推理中的超低位（INT2）KV缓存量化，通过最小化经过输出投影W_O后的注意力输出误差来优化旋转矩阵，同时保持分页KV缓存格式且推理开销可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于旋转的INT2量化方法优化的是缓存统计量或代理误差，而非模型最终受影响的通过注意力和输出投影W_O传播的误差，导致优化目标与模型实际性能之间存在失配。

Method: OptR将经过W_O后的注意力输出误差分解为键诱导项和值诱导项，通过完整的INT2量化和注意力路径学习每个注意力头的正交校正；同时采用注意力等价的键重参数化来减少大通道偏移而不改变softmax分布。

Result: 在三个模型和五个推理与编码基准上，OptR一致地改进了QuaRot和OSCAR，增强了长上下文检索能力，同时保持了分页KV缓存格式且推理开销可忽略不计。

Conclusion: OptR通过将旋转优化目标直接对齐到post-W_O的注意力输出误差，有效解决了现有量化方法优化目标与模型实际受影响误差之间的失配问题，在多种基准上取得了一致改进。

Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache has become a major memory and bandwidth bottleneck in long-context large language model inference, making ultra-low-bit quantization increasingly important. However, existing rotation-based INT2 methods optimize cache statistics or proxy errors before the complete attention readout, even though the model is ultimately affected by the error propagated through attention and the output projection $W_O$. To address this mismatch, we propose \textit{OptR}, an output-aware rotation method that minimizes post-$W_O$ attention-output error. OptR decomposes the post-$W_O$ attention-output error into key- and value-induced terms and learns per-head orthogonal corrections through the full INT2 quantization and attention path. OptR further applies an attention-equivalent key reparameterization to reduce large channel-wise offsets without changing the softmax distribution. Across three models and five reasoning and coding benchmarks, OptR consistently improves both QuaRot and OSCAR and strengthens long-context retrieval, while preserving the paged KV-cache format with negligible inference overhead.

</details>


### [270] [PatTree: a novel approach for automated creation of multimodal, graph-based patient representations for medical classification tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02692)
*Julia Gehrmann,Lars Quakulinski,Hamza Naseem,Oya Beyan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PatTree，一种基于图的患者整体表示方法，可通过自动化结构化多模态临床数据生成，无需预先标准化输入，实现早期数据集成。在ADNI-1队列（n=763）上，三分类任务（阿尔茨海默病、轻度认知障碍、认知正常）达到98.5%的平衡准确率和0.987的F1分数，达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态临床数据虽能提升AI分类性能，但真实世界临床数据的高度异质性（缺失值、多时间点、多样模态、格式和语义不一致）为结构化分析和AI应用带来巨大挑战。传统的数据协调方法资源密集且易出错，限制了可扩展性和可复现性。

Method: 提出PatTree，一种基于知识图谱的患者整体表示方法。通过自动化结构化多模态临床数据，在不依赖预标准化输入的前提下实现早期数据集成。PatTree将异构临床数据统一表示为知识图谱，同时保留跨模态和数据源的数据元素间的语义关系，促进互操作性和机器可解释的数据访问。

Result: 在ADNI-1队列子集（n=763）上验证，患者分类可直接在PatTree上进行，达到最先进性能。三分类任务（区分阿尔茨海默病、轻度认知障碍和认知正常个体）中，在留出测试集上取得98.5%的平衡准确率和0.987的F1分数。

Conclusion: 无假设的自动化多模态医学数据结构化可作为临床AI管线的可扩展基础，绕过繁琐的数据准备和标准化步骤。PatTree展示了图结构表示在克服真实世界临床数据异质性方面的潜力，为可扩展、可复现的AI驱动临床决策支持提供了新路径。

Abstract: Access to holistic, multimodal data improves the performance of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in medical classification tasks compared to utilizing single modalities or data sources. However, the inherent heterogeneity and complexity of clinical real-world data pose significant challenges to structured data analysis and AI application. This heterogeneity includes missing values, multiple time points, diverse modalities, and inconsistent formats and semantics. Data harmonization prior to data integration tackles this challenge but remains resource-intensive and error-prone, limiting the scalability and reproducibility of holistic, AI-driven decision support on clinical real-world data. We therefore propose PatTree, a graph-based, holistic representation of patients that can be derived from real-world clinical data through the automated structuring of multimodal clinical data. PatTree enables early-stage data integration without relying on pre-standardized inputs. While representing heterogeneous clinical data within a unified knowledge graph, PatTree preserves the semantic relationships between data elements across modalities and data sources, facilitating interoperability and machine-interpretable data access. Using a subset of the ADNI-1 cohort (n = 763), we demonstrate that classification of patients is directly feasible on PatTree reaching state-of-the-art classification performance. In the three-class classification task distinguishing Alzheimer's disease, mild cognitive impairment, and cognitively normal individuals, we achieve a balanced accuracy of 98.5% and an F$_1$ score of 0.987 on the held-out test set. Our results show that assumption-free, automated structuring of multimodal medical data can serve as a scalable foundation for clinical AI pipelines bypassing tedious data preparation and standardization.

</details>


### [271] [Measuring Explainer Stability via Attribution Separability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02697)
*Eddie Conti,Álvaro Parafita,Axel Brando*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于分布的框架来捕捉归因方法（AMs）的稳定性。该方法能够理解排名归因向量的可分离程度，并获取特征排名保持可靠的最大索引。框架还扩展到在数据集层面比较不同归因方法的排名鲁棒性，为评估解释器稳定性提供了补充标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 归因方法广泛用于解释黑盒模型，但由于定义中的随机成分，许多方法会产生可变的归因分数，导致解释结果不稳定。现有方法缺乏系统性的框架来量化和评估这种不稳定性。

Method: 提出一种基于分布的框架，通过分析归因分数的分布特征来理解排名归因向量的可分离程度，并确定特征排名保持可靠的最大索引。同时将该框架扩展用于跨数据集比较不同归因方法的排名鲁棒性。

Result: 通过实验展示了如何应用该方法评估解释器的稳定性，证明该方法能为评估归因方法的稳定性提供有效且互补的准则。

Conclusion: 该方法为评估归因方法的稳定性提供了一个补充标准，使研究者能够更好地理解和比较不同解释方法在排名稳定性方面的表现。

Abstract: Attribution methods (AMs) assign an importance score to each feature and are widely adopted to explain black-box models. However, most methods can produce variable attribution scores due to stochastic components in their definition. In this paper, we propose a distribution-based framework to capture the stability of attribution scores. In particular, our approach allows to understand the degree of separability in the ranked attribution vector and obtain the largest index for which a feature ranking remains reliable. We further extend this framework to compare AMs based on the robustness of their rankings across a dataset. Through experiments, we demonstrate how to apply our method to evaluate explainer stability. Overall, our approach provides a complementary criterion for evaluating the stability of AMs.

</details>


### [272] [NANQ: Noise-Floor-Aware Mixed-Precision Non-Uniform Quantization for Analog Compute-in-Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02700)
*Yizhe Chen,Wenshuai Yao,Saiya Wang,Yuannuo Feng,Wenbo Qi,Kechao Tang,Ngai Wong,Wenyong Zhou,Wang Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NANQ是一个面向模拟CIM的噪声感知混合精度非均匀量化框架，通过将硬件噪声分布转化为自适应量化密度并识别各层精度饱和点，在eFlash CIM芯片上实现了对视觉模型8.05个百分点、语言模型54.7%困惑度降低的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟CIM虽然能实现高能效神经网络推理，但器件变异和读取噪声会严重恶化低比特量化模型。现有面向CIM的量化方法仅最小化理想量化误差，忽略了硬件噪声底限，导致精度分配效率低下。

Method: NANQ从eFlash CIM阵列的实测响应中建模与幅值相关的权重噪声，将噪声分布转化为自适应量化密度——在低噪声区域分配更精细的分辨率，避免在噪声主导区域浪费精度。同时通过统一阈值识别每层在硬件噪声下的精度饱和点，进行层间比特位宽分配。

Result: 在eFlash CIM SoC上，2比特权重幅值量化下，NANQ相比PowerQuant使视觉模型准确率平均提升8.05个百分点，语言模型困惑度平均降低54.7%。混合精度NANQ仅用3.2-3.8等效比特即捕获了额外量化资源的大部分增益。

Conclusion: NANQ证明了在模拟CIM中，将硬件噪声感知融入量化设计而非仅最小化理想量化误差，可以在极低比特下实现显著的精度提升，且混合精度方案能以更少的资源获得接近全精度的收益。

Abstract: Analog compute-in-memory (CIM) enables energy-efficient neural network inference, but device variation and read noise can severely degrade low-bit quantized models. Existing CIM-oriented quantization methods mainly minimize ideal quantization error, ignoring the hardware noise floor and thus causing inefficient precision allocation. We propose NANQ, a noise-aware mixed-precision non-uniform quantization framework for analog CIM. NANQ models magnitude-dependent weight noise from measured responses of an eFlash CIM array and converts the noise profile into an adaptive quantization density, assigning finer resolution to low-noise regions while avoiding ineffective precision in noise-dominated regions. It further assigns layer-wise bit-widths by identifying each layer's precision saturation point under hardware noise using a unified threshold. On-chip experiments on an eFlash CIM SoC show that, under 2-bit weight-magnitude quantization, NANQ improves vision-model accuracy by 8.05 percentage points and reduces language-model PPL by 54.7% on average over PowerQuant. Mixed-precision NANQ captures most of the gains obtainable from additional quantization resources with only 3.2-3.8 equivalent bits.

</details>


### [273] [Can Training Logs Make Model Comparisons More Precise?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02705)
*Wei-Jung Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究能否利用训练日志（training logs）作为协变量来提高随机训练模型比较的精度。研究发现，使用arm-specific协变量调整（仅用自身运行的统计量来调整每个模型）能在视觉任务的多架构、多数据集实验中减少模型比较的不确定性。但主要限制在于协变量选择——过度搜索日志池中最相关的统计量会引入比消除更多的噪声。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机训练的模型进行比较时，需要估计性能差异及其不确定性。标准做法依赖多次重复运行，但重复运行成本高昂。作者希望探索是否可以利用这些运行过程中天然产生的训练日志数据（而非训练前测量的特征）作为协变量，来提高比较的统计功效和精度，从而减少所需的重复运行次数。

Method: 采用arm-specific协变量调整方法：每个模型仅用其自身运行的训练日志统计量进行回归调整，但报告的效应量仍是未经调整的原始均值差异。在包含三种架构（architectures）和三个数据集（datasets）的视觉任务研究中，基于早期训练日志的简单调整被系统地评估其对模型比较不确定性的影响。同时也考察了从日志池中广泛搜索最相关统计量进行选择的策略。

Result: 简单基于早期训练日志的协变量调整通常在多个架构和数据集上减少了模型比较的不确定性。然而，广泛搜索日志池中与性能最相关的统计量来进行协变量选择时，往往引入的选择噪声（selection noise）超过了其带来的精度收益，即使事后看来确实存在有用的统计量。

Conclusion: 训练日志对提高模型比较的精度是有价值的，但前提是协变量调整必须避免大的选择噪声。这一发现为实践者提供了指导：应谨慎选择调整用的协变量，避免过度搜索，否则可能适得其反。

Abstract: Comparing stochastically trained models requires estimating both a performance difference and its uncertainty from repeated runs. We study whether training logs from those same runs can make such comparisons more precise. Because training-log covariates are produced during training rather than measured before it, we use arm-specific covariate adjustment: each model is adjusted only with statistics from its own runs, and the raw mean difference remains the reported effect. In a vision study spanning three architectures and three datasets, simple adjustments based on early training logs often reduce uncertainty in model comparisons. The main limitation is covariate selection. Broadly searching the log pool for the most correlated statistic often adds more noise than it removes, even when useful statistics exist in hindsight. Training logs therefore appear useful for more precise model comparisons, but only when the adjustment avoids large selection noise.

</details>


### [274] [Designing a Good Virtual Node: Addressable and Cardinality-Preserving Global Memory for Message Passing Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02709)
*Félix Marcoccia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种可寻址且保基数（cardinality-preserving）的虚拟内存机制，用于消息传递神经网络（MPNN），克服标准虚拟节点（VN）将图压缩为单一均匀状态的有限容量瓶颈，且无需自注意力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准虚拟节点通过"节点→VN→节点"流水线传播全局信息，但将图压缩为单一同质状态并均匀广播给所有节点，存在有限容量瓶颈。作者基于Two-Radius分析，探索如何用辅助虚拟内存缓解该瓶颈。

Method: 提出两个核心要求：(1) 全局内存需分解为可独立读写状态的因子化槽位，可通过可寻址的交叉注意力槽实现；(2) 由于softmax注意力对均匀复制不变，单纯可寻址性无法保持多重性（multiplicity），因此将每个槽位查询作为私有键/值锚点插入，以恢复被丢弃的归一化质量，从而在有限颜色域上实现单射多重集表示及1-WL细化。

Result: 在多重性感知的Two-Radius、子图计数（motif counting）以及受限链路集预测任务上的实验表明，该可寻址且保基数的虚拟内存机制有效，计算复杂度为O(nMd)。

Conclusion: 可寻址且保基数的虚拟内存能够在不依赖自注意力的情况下有效缓解虚拟节点的容量瓶颈，为MPNN提供更强的全局信息表达能力。

Abstract: Virtual nodes give message-passing neural networks a simple global communication route, but the standard node--VN--node pipeline compresses the graph into one homogeneous state and broadcasts it identically to every node. Building on the Two-Radius analysis of Mishayev et al., we ask how auxiliary virtual memory can relieve this finite-capacity bottleneck without self-attention. We identify two requirements. First, the global memory should be factorized into independently writable and readable states: this can be achieved using addressable cross-attention slots. Second, addressability alone does not preserve multiplicity, because softmax attention is invariant to uniform replication. Inserting each slot query as a private key/value anchor recovers the discarded normalization mass and yields, on bounded color domains, an injective multiset representation able to implement a 1-WL refinement. Experiments on multiplicity-aware Two-Radius, motif counting, and constrained link-set prediction support this addressable and cardinality-preserving virtual memory at (O(nMd)) arithmetic cost.

</details>


### [275] [Neural Networks with Local Converging Inputs for Efficient Options Pricing Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02778)
*Harris Cobb,Wenbo Hao,Yingjie Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将神经网络与局部收敛输入（NNLCI）相结合的方法，用于提升多资产期权定价数值方法的效率。NNLCI通过神经网络对粗网格和细网格的解进行局部校正，仅需少量高保真训练数据，即可将细网格数值解的均方根误差降低4-12倍，适用于Black-Scholes模型（1-3维）和Heston随机波动率模型下的期权定价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多资产期权定价的传统数值方法（如有限差分）在高维问题中计算成本极高，难以满足实时期权交易和风险管理的需求。现有的加速方法往往需要大量训练数据或复杂的设计，缺乏高效且通用的解决方案。

Method: NNLCI方法的核心思想是：1）同时使用粗网格和细网格（相对于粗网格）的数值解作为神经网络输入；2）神经网络学习局部校正项，以修正细网格解与精确解之间的误差；3）采用最简洁的输入格式来降低网络复杂度和计算开销；4）训练所需的高保真数据量极小，仅需少量参数组合即可完成训练。

Result: 在Black-Scholes方程下的一、二、三维现金或无现金期权，以及Heston随机波动率模型下的单资产向下敲出障碍看涨期权（二维PDE）上进行了验证。所有测试案例中，NNLCI将细网格数值解的RMSE降低了约4-12倍，且神经网络仅需在少量参数组合子集上训练即可获得该性能。

Conclusion: NNLCI显著降低了高维期权定价问题的计算需求，具有低训练成本和强泛化能力，为实时期权交易和风险管理提供了一种高效且有前景的加速方案。

Abstract: We present a novel application of Neural Networks with Local Converging Inputs (NNLCI) to improve the efficiency of existing numerical methods for pricing multi-asset options. The most concise input format for NNLCI has been introduced, offering substantial convenience and efficiency. NNLCI uses a neural network to locally correct solutions from a coarse mesh and a refined mesh (relative to the coarse one), requiring only a minimal amount of high-fidelity training data. We demonstrate this approach on cash-or-nothing options under the Black-Scholes equation in one, two, and three spatial dimensions, and on single-asset down-and-out barrier call options under the Heston stochastic-volatility model (whose pricing PDE is two-dimensional in the spot price $S$ and the instantaneous variance $v$). In each case, NNLCI reduces the root-mean-square error (RMSE) of the refined-mesh numerical solution by a factor of approximately 4-12 on test sets, even when the neural network is trained on only a small subset of parameter combinations. These results demonstrate that NNLCI significantly reduces computational requirements for high-dimensional problems in real-time options trading and risk management, offering low training costs and strong generalization ability.

</details>


### [276] [Evaluation Blindness: How Silent Measurement Failures Corrupt AI Systems from Training to Deployment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02786)
*Priyanka Bajaj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了"评估盲区"（evaluation blindness）的概念，指测量函数在系统实际故障时仍产生与健康状态无法区分的读数。论文将训练阶段和部署阶段的静默失败统一到同一个可检测性框架下，通过四个训练时的案例研究和基于50个真实事故的六类分类法，发现53%的可验证公开故障是静默的，并提出了失败预算框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统可能静默失败，错误会穿过训练循环、评估管道和生产监控栈，直到下游危害显现才被发现。现有文献将训练时和部署时的失败分开处理，缺乏统一的检测框架，导致许多故障在无辅助信号的情况下无法被识别。

Method: 1) 形式化定义评估盲区的可检测性谓词，统一训练与部署两个阶段；2) 通过四个训练时案例研究（包括TRL PR #6594中的梯度损坏bug）追踪具体故障；3) 构建六类故障分类法，基于50个来自法庭文件和监管文件的真实事故进行验证；4) 提出失败预算框架，将可接受失败率与用例风险等级关联。

Result: 50个真实事故中53%的可验证公开故障是静默的；发现Operational类别在结构定义上100%静默；识别出训练时的奖励模型博弈、重要性采样校正错误、基准数据污染等盲区；发现TRL PR #6594中损失正常下降但梯度被损坏的真实实现bug。

Conclusion: 测量基础设施是AI全生命周期中的正确性问题，而非仅在评估阶段。需要将失败预算纳入系统设计，并将静默失败检测视为核心工程实践。

Abstract: AI systems can fail silently. The failure propagates through training loops, evaluation pipelines, and production monitoring stacks until downstream harm makes it visible. This paper introduces evaluation blindness: a measurement function M exhibits evaluation blindness with respect to failure class F when it produces readings indistinguishable from a healthy state while the system is actually failing, with no auxiliary signal flagging the gap.
  The problem surfaces at two lifecycle stages the literature has treated separately. At training time, reward models are gamed, importance-sampling corrections are silently miscalculated, and benchmark contamination inflates fine-tuning evaluations, all while loss curves look healthy and gradient updates proceed normally. At deployment time, monitoring fails to catch six classes of production failure, including an Operational category that is 100% silent by structural definition.
  We provide a formal detectability predicate unifying both stages. Four training-time case studies trace concrete breakdowns, including a real implementation bug in TRL PR #6594 where gradients are corrupted as loss decreases normally. A six-class taxonomy validated against 50 real-world incidents from court documents and regulatory filings finds that 53% of verifiable public failures were silent. A failure budget framework ties acceptable failure rates to use-case risk class.
  The implication is direct: measurement infrastructure is a correctness concern across the full AI lifecycle, not just at evaluation time. Data, code, and taxonomy schema are at https://github.com/priyanka25aug/llm-failure-taxonomy.

</details>


### [277] [Topological Simplification in Predictive Coding Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02816)
*Adam Shaw,Jiayu Li,Michael Sperling,Michael Kim,Alvin Jin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文使用逐层持久同调分析研究预测编码网络（PCN）中学习表示的拓扑结构。研究发现：较小的PCN在更浅的层中压缩连通分量；拓扑简化发生的深度与重建误差负相关；与标准MLP相比，PCN一致地在更晚的层中压缩表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测编码网络是一种神经启发式的双向架构，但其学习表示的拓扑结构特征尚不清楚。通过定量分析表示拓扑如何随层变化，可以更好地理解PCN的压缩-重建权衡机制。

Method: 在合成分类数据集（测试准确率≥99.9%）和MNIST（≥95%）上训练PCN，使用逐层持久同调分析测量不同架构和激活函数下拓扑特征随层的变化。通过Spearman相关系数、种子级bootstrap比较等方法进行分析。

Result: 较小的PCN在更浅层就发生连通分量坍塌（Spearman ρ∈[0.72,0.79]）；简化深度与重建误差呈强负相关（ρ=-0.58）；PCN比相匹配的MLP平均晚3.6层压缩连通分量。

Conclusion: 持久同调为PCN的压缩-重建权衡提供了有效的定量视角，模型容量和预测编码推断的循环双向动力学共同影响该权衡在层间的解决方式。

Abstract: We study the topology of learned representations in predictive coding networks (PCNs), a neuro-inspired bidirectional architecture, using a quantitative layer-wise persistent homology analysis. We train well-performing PCNs on a synthetic classification dataset ($\geq 99.9\%$ test accuracy) and on MNIST ($\geq 95\%$ test accuracy), and measure how topological features change across layers for different architectures and activation functions. We find that smaller PCNs collapse connected components across layers earlier than larger models (Spearman $\unicode{x1D70C} \in [0.72, 0.79]$ across activations), with model size measured as the sum of hidden-layer widths. We also observe a strong negative correlation ($\unicode{x1D70C} = -0.58$) between the depth at which simplification occurs and reconstruction error; i.e., architectures that simplify later reconstruct better. Finally, a seed-level bootstrap comparison across architectures and activations shows that PCNs consistently collapse connected components later than matched MLPs, with an average difference of $3.6$ layers. These results suggest that persistent homology offers a useful quantitative lens on the compression--reconstruction tradeoff in PCNs, and that both model capacity and the recurrent, bidirectional dynamics of predictive coding inference shape when this tradeoff is resolved across layers.

</details>


### [278] [Wiring Beats Blending: What Transfers Between Transformer Sizes -- and What Doesn't](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02829)
*Ravi Satya Durga Prasad Yenugula*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了Pythia模型族中1.4B→410M的模型压缩转换（将预训练大模型转换为更小的模型），发现表示层跨尺寸强对齐但权重参数弱对齐，最佳线性投影后权重残差与噪声无异，转换价值在于初始化而非权重本身。在匹配预算的持续预训练中，将转换解耦为两个独立杠杆（最小二乘补偿和保方差重缩放），补偿在低预算下高效但非普适最优，预算增大时两者趋同；在大规模压缩（6.9B→1.4B）时叠加两个杠杆会过度校正，归因于补偿求解在大宽度下的病态性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统模型族训练需要从头训练每个尺寸的模型，成本高昂。作者探索是否可以将预训练的大模型直接转换为更小的"兄弟"模型，以节省计算资源并加速小模型的训练。

Method: 作者对Pythia模型族1.4B→410M转换进行端到端表征分析：1) 对比表示层和参数层的对齐程度；2) 验证密集权重投影的功能破坏性（排除组装伪影）；3) 通过shuffle对照验证权重残差的统计特性；4) 将转换解耦为最小二乘补偿（优化零样本性能）和保方差重缩放（优化动态收敛）两个独立杠杆，在匹配预算的持续预训练中分别评估。

Result: 表示层跨尺寸强对齐（ridge R²=0.84）而参数层弱对齐；密集投影因基混合破坏结构而功能上有害；最佳线性算子后权重残差与噪声不可区分。补偿在30M token低预算下胜过各种子克隆变体（宽度缩减对84.0±1.8 vs 89.7±3.7，深度缩减对109.3 vs 117.9），但33倍预算下两者趋同（40.0 vs 40.0）。迁移初始化在低预算下比从头训练最多快18倍，优势随收敛和规模增大而收窄。在6.9B→1.4B大规模下叠加两杠杆过度校正，归因于大宽度下补偿求解的病态性。

Conclusion: 大模型→小模型的转换价值本质上来自初始化而非权重复制；最小二乘补偿在低预算下是token高效的低成本获胜策略但非普适最优；大规模压缩需要维度感知的正则化来解决补偿求解的病态性问题。

Abstract: Model families train every size from scratch. Can a pretrained large model be converted into a smaller sibling? We characterize the 1.4B->410M conversion in the Pythia family end-to-end: (i) representations align strongly across sizes (ridge R^2=0.84) while parameters align weakly; (ii) dense weight projection is functionally destructive -- provably not an assembly artifact -- because basis mixing breaks rotary, per-head, GELU, and LayerNorm structure; (iii) after the best-fit linear operator, weight residuals are statistically indistinguishable from noise under shuffle controls; (iv) conversion value therefore lives in initialization. In matched-budget continued pre-training we decompose conversion into two independent levers -- least-squares compensation (function: best zero-shot) and variance-preserving rescale (dynamics: best endpoints). Compensation is a token-efficient, low-budget win rather than a universal one: at 30M tokens it beats the strongest subcloning variant on both a width-reduced pair (84.0 +/- 1.8 vs. 89.7 +/- 3.7, 3/3 seeds) and a held-out depth-reduced pair (109.3 vs. 117.9, 3/3 seeds), reaching a given quality with fewer tokens; at a 33x larger budget the two converge to parity (40.0 vs. 40.0), both far ahead of from-scratch, which transfer initialization always beats -- by up to 18x at low budget, the margin narrowing at convergence and at the largest scale. We further map the method's boundary: at ~5x the donor scale (6.9B->1.4B) stacking both levers over-corrects, which we trace to ill-conditioning of the compensation solve at large width, pointing to dimension-aware regularization as the fix. Code, checkpoints, and the frozen evaluation corpus are released.

</details>


### [279] [NOMADD: Numerical Optimization of Models Adapting to Data Drift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02845)
*Swapn Shah,Keith Burghardt*

Main category: cs.LG
