Furthermore, through a simulation study, we show that UNVaMP yields well-behaved knowledge state estimates under controlled measurement conditions. In total, these results indicate that UNVaMP is both useful for real-world education systems and capable of recovering underlying structure from student-item interactions.

</details>


### [346] [FedCritic-MIMO: Communication-Efficient Serverless Federated Critic Learning for Massive-MIMO Resource Control in Open and Disaggregated 6G RANs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03852)
*Amin Farajzadeh,Melike Erol-Kantarci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedCritic-MIMO，一种通信高效的Serverless联邦多智能体强化学习框架，用于6G开放和解聚RAN中的AI原生资源控制。该框架让各基站控制器独立执行本地actor，仅通过干扰感知图进行共享critic参数的peer-to-peer交换，并通过无线感知事件触发、自适应层式top-k稀疏critic交换与误差反馈、以及平衡的干扰感知融合来实现协作。实验表明其在吞吐量、QoS满意度和通信开销上均优于多种基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在开放、解聚的6G RAN中，RAN控制器需要在不共享训练器、无集中式训练的条件下协作管理资源。传统集中式训练（CTDE）和参数服务器聚合方式面临通信开销大、隐私/部署限制等问题，因此需要一种既能协调多小区动作、又保持通信高效的Serverless联邦多智能体强化学习方案。

Method: FedCritic-MIMO框架包含三个核心机制：(1) 无线感知事件触发（wireless-aware event triggering），决定何时触发critic参数交换；(2) 自适应层式top-k稀疏critic交换与误差反馈（adaptive layer-wise top-k sparse exchange with error feedback），压缩通信量；(3) 平衡的干扰感知融合（balanced interference-aware fusion），根据小区间干扰关系加权合并critic参数。每个基站本地执行actor，仅交换兼容的共享critic参数，不进行actor联邦或集中训练。

Result: 在强干扰耦合的reuse-1 MIMO OFDMA仿真中，FedCritic-MIMO在性能-通信权衡上优于启发式、独立学习、集中训练和通信消融等基线。它获得最高保留测试吞吐量，改善了用户速率分布和平均SINR，提高了QoS满意度，并在学习基线上获得最低的单位比特干扰成本。相比未压缩的分布式critic交换，通信开销降低76%。此外，文章还提供了固定策略、冻结target的critic回归模型下的条件有限时间平稳性和共识性保证。

Conclusion: Serverless的兼容共享critic参数交换能够有效协调RAN控制器，而不需要集中式轨迹收集或参数服务器聚合。FedCritic-MIMO证明了在通信受限条件下，通过精心设计的压缩与融合机制，联邦多智能体强化学习可以在6G RAN资源控制中实现接近集中训练的性能，同时显著降低通信开销。

Abstract: This paper proposes FedCritic-MIMO, a communication-efficient serverless federated multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for AI-native resource control across independently deployable cell-level controllers in open and disaggregated 6G RANs. Controllers share no trainer, retain local actors and personalized critic components, and exchange only compatible shared critic parameters. FedCritic-MIMO targets reuse-$1$ multi-cell massive-MIMO OFDMA deployments, where RAN controllers jointly manage user scheduling, per-stream power allocation, beamforming, interference, and long-term QoS with limited inter-controller signaling. Each base station locally executes its actor without centralized training or actor federation, while critic knowledge is exchanged peer-to-peer over an interference-aware graph. It enables this collaboration through wireless-aware event triggering, adaptive layer-wise top-$k$ sparse critic exchange with error feedback, and balanced interference-aware fusion. We establish conditional finite-time stationarity and consensus guarantees for the balanced, compressed peer-to-peer critic recursion under a fixed-policy, frozen-target critic-regression model. In strongly interference-coupled reuse-$1$ simulations, FedCritic-MIMO achieves the best performance-communication tradeoff among heuristic, independent-learning, centralized-training, and communication-ablation baselines. It achieves the highest held-out throughput, improves user-rate distribution and mean SINR, increases QoS satisfaction, and attains the lowest interference cost per delivered bit among learning baselines. It reduces critic-communication overhead by $76\%$ relative to uncompressed distributed critic exchange. These results demonstrate that serverless exchange of compatible shared critic parameters can coordinate RAN controllers without centralized trajectory collection or parameter-server aggregation.

</details>


### [347] [Quantization Effects on Biomedical LLM Reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03854)
*Anton Rasmussen,Hong Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了Mistral-7B三种变体（Base、BioMistral、Instruct）在PubMed RCT句子分类任务上的实现选择影响，发现概率提取协议（评分规则）对校准度影响最大，提示模板带来的精度差异（7-24个百分点）与模型级效应相当甚至更大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解码器语言模型用作分类器时，预测类别概率高度依赖提示模板、标签映射和评分规则等实现选择，但这些变量很少被当作实验变量系统研究，导致评估结果可能被误导。

Method: 对三个Mistral-7B变体在FP16/INT8/INT4精度下，使用四种答案文本提示模板，在PubMed RCT句子分类（n=2000）上进行受控评估，比较求和与均值token对数似然评分规则、温度缩放等校准方法。

Result: 切换评分规则（求和→均值）可使BioMistral的ECE从0.097升至0.289、Instruct从0.237降至0.096，而精度变化小于1-6个百分点。提示模板引起7-24个百分点精度差异。INT8量化对性能影响有限（1-2个百分点），温度缩放仅在求和评分下有效。

Conclusion: 提示模板设计和评分归一化是评估解码器LM校准的首要考虑因素，实现选择可能完全颠倒模型校准排名。

Abstract: When decoder language models are used as classifiers, predicted class probabilities depend on implementation choices, including the prompt template, verbalizer (label-to-token mapping), and scoring rule, that are rarely treated as experimental variables. We present a controlled evaluation of three Mistral-7B variants (Base, BioMistral, and Instruct) on PubMed RCT sentence classification (n=2000) under FP16, INT8, and INT4 precision using four answer-text prompt templates. Our primary finding is that the probability extraction protocol dominates apparent calibration. Switching from summed to mean token log-likelihood scoring reverses the calibration ranking between models: BioMistral average expected calibration error increases from 0.097 to 0.289, whereas Instruct decreases from 0.237 to 0.096, while accuracy changes by less than 1 percentage point for the specialized models but 4-6 percentage points for the base model. Prompt template choice produces accuracy differences of 7-24 percentage points, comparable to or larger than model-level effects. On one template, BioMistral outperforms Instruct although the overall mean favors Instruct by only 1.3 percentage points. For BioMistral and Instruct, INT8 quantization changes accuracy and F1 by only 1-2 percentage points relative to FP16, whereas the base model shows larger INT8 effects on some templates (up to +4.2 percentage points). INT4 produces heterogeneous but non-catastrophic effects. Temperature scaling reduces expected calibration error under summed scoring for both models but only for that scoring rule. A fine-tuned PubMedBERT reference achieves 82.7% accuracy but uses about 176000 labeled training examples, precluding direct comparison. These results demonstrate that prompt template design and scoring normalization are first-order experimental decisions when evaluating decoder language model calibration.

</details>


### [348] [Bi-semantic Chemical Embedder for Joint Representation Learning of SMILES and Natural Language](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03855)
*David Ming Segura,Jeremy Goumaz,Joshua W. Sin,Bojana Ranković,Philippe Schwaller*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CheMatE，一种基于ModernBERT的化学嵌入模型，通过两阶段训练（持续掩码语言建模+Matryoshka对比学习）联合捕获分子结构和化学领域自然语言语义，在分子性质预测和科学语言理解任务中取得竞争性表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer模型在NLP和化学分子表示（如SMILES）上取得了成功，但领域自适应的预训练常导致模型对化学语法过拟合，灾难性遗忘其基础语义能力。作者希望解决这一挑战，构建一个既能理解分子结构又能保留语言语义能力的统一模型。

Method: 基于ModernBERT架构，采用两阶段训练：(1) 在构建的大规模SMILES注释长文本科学语料（FineWeb和ChemPile，分别104亿和115亿token）上进行持续掩码语言建模(MLM)；(2) 使用从训练语料中算法生成的SMILES-文本对合成数据集，通过Multiple Negative Ranking Loss (MNRL)进行Matryoshka对比学习。

Result: 在分子性质预测和科学语言理解等多个下游任务上，CheMatE展现出与传统专用化学模型和通用语言模型基线相当或更优的性能，证明其表征具有很强的可迁移性和鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过将自建精选数据集与顺序训练策略相结合，CheMatE有效统一了分子结构和上下文语义信号于单一文本框架中，实现了对化学和语言双语义的强大理解，为化学领域的嵌入模型提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Transformer models have revolutionized natural language processing (NLP), and text-based molecular representations like SMILES have successfully extended these architectures to chemistry. However, domain-adaptive pre-training often causes models to overfit to chemical syntax, catastrophically forgetting their foundational semantic capabilities. To address this challenge, we introduce CheMatE, a chemistry-oriented embedding model that jointly captures molecular structure and domain-specific natural language within the same representation space. Built on a ModernBERT backbone, CheMatE learns bi-semantic representations through a two-stage training procedure: continued masked language modeling (MLM) followed by a Matryoshka contrastive learning stage via Multiple Negative Ranking Loss (MNRL). First, we train the model using MLM on a novel, large-scale corpus of SMILES-annotated, long-context scientific documents that were constructed and curated from FineWeb and ChemPile (comprising 10.4B and 11.5B tokens, respectively). Subsequently, the model undergoes contrastive learning using a synthetic dataset of SMILES-text pairs algorithmically derived from our original training corpus. This design exposes the model to SMILES-enriched scientific literature, enabling bi-semantic understanding. We evaluate CheMatE across a range of downstream tasks covering molecular property prediction and scientific language understanding. Our results demonstrate that coupling our custom-curated datasets with this sequential training strategy yields robust, highly transferable representations. By effectively unifying structural and contextual signals within a single text-based framework, CheMatE achieves competitive performance across both specialized chemistry models and general-purpose language model baselines.

</details>


### [349] [CRS-Triage: Confidence- and Reliability-Aware Selective Triage under Incomplete Clinical Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03862)
*Guan Qiang,Yushen Chen,Tianlong Liu,David Rotenberg,Ethan H. Kim,Fang Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CRS-Triage，一种基于置信度和可靠性感知的选择性分诊（triage）预测方法。它针对急诊分诊中EHR数据不完整、不可靠、不一致的问题，分别评估结构化数据和临床文本的可靠性，并联合考虑两种模态间的一致性来估计预测置信度。通过将置信度与阈值比较，模型可以决定是自己预测还是延迟决策。同时通过惩罚低估（under-triage）错误，倾向于将患者分配到略高的危重等级。实验表明在MIMIC-IV-ED数据集上取得良好性能，并在数据不完整、退化或模态不一致时保持良好的风险-覆盖率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急诊分诊要求短时间内做出可靠决策，但可用的EHR数据（结构化数据和临床文本）常常不完整、不可靠且不一致。现有ML模型通常依赖完整可靠的数据，难以应对实际临床场景中的数据质量问题，因此需要一种能在数据质量不佳时仍然可靠进行分诊预测的方法。

Method: CRS-Triage包含三个关键组件：(1) 分别评估结构化数据和临床文本的可靠性；(2) 联合考虑两种模态间的一致性以估计每次预测的置信度；(3) 通过选择性预测机制，将置信度与预设阈值比较，决定模型自行决策还是推迟案例。此外，通过惩罚低估（under-triage）误差来偏好过度分诊（over-triage），降低漏诊高风险患者的风险。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV-ED数据集上的实验表明，CRS-Triage取得了强大的预测性能，提供了更好的风险-覆盖率权衡，并且在EHR数据不完整、退化或模态间不一致的情况下仍能保持可靠性。

Conclusion: CRS-Triage通过多模态可靠性评估和选择性预测机制，有效解决了急诊分诊中数据质量问题带来的挑战，在保证预测性能的同时提高了模型在实际临床环境中的可靠性。

Abstract: Emergency triage requires reliable decisions within a short time period. However, the available electronic health record (EHR) data, including structured data and clinical text, are often incomplete, unreliable, and inconsistent. This makes machine learning (ML)-based triage prediction more challenging, as existing ML models typically rely on complete and reliable EHR data to accurately predict patients' acuity levels. To address this, we propose confidence- and reliability-aware selective triage (CRS-Triage) to predict patients' acuity levels with a confidence score. By comparing the confidence score with a predefined threshold, CRS-Triage can selectively determine whether the model should make the decision or defer the case. Specifically, CRS-Triage separately evaluates the reliability of structured data and clinical text and then jointly considers the consistency between the two modalities to estimate the confidence of each prediction. Moreover, to reduce the risk of missing high-acuity patients, namely under-triage, CRS-Triage prefers to assign patients slightly higher acuity levels, namely over-triage, by penalizing under-triage errors. Experiments on the MIMIC-IV-ED dataset show that CRS-Triage achieves strong predictive performance. It also provides a better risk-coverage trade-off and remains reliable when the available EHR data are incomplete, degraded, or inconsistent across modalities.

</details>


### [350] [GENESIS: Towards Explainable Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03868)
*Abhinav Thorat,Ravi Kumar Kolla,Vishak K Bhat,Harsh Vardhan Singh Chauhan,Niranjan Pedanekar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GENESIS，一个可解释的混合因果发现框架，将图构建分解为可审计的决策点，实现100%决策可追溯性，同时性能优于纯统计方法且与先进的LLM辅助方法相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法存在两个关键问题：纯统计方法在低样本量下缺乏能力解决结构歧义；LLM辅助混合方法虽然通过语义推理改善结构恢复，但推理过程对边决策的影响不透明，无法解释为什么包含或排除某条边。这在无真实DAG的真实应用中至关重要，每个结构决策都必须能独立证明。

Method: GENESIS框架将图构建分解为可解释的决策点：首先识别并对三节点结构基元（链、叉、碰撞器）进行评分，建立透明的结构先验；然后逐步将先验与观测证据整合来精化图结构，仅在统计证据不足时调用领域知识。每个边决策通过可审计的证据来源（统计证据、马尔可夫毯一致性或显式领域推理）解决。

Result: GENESIS在所有设置下实现100%决策可追溯性。尽管有额外的可解释性要求，它在大多数基准数据集和各样本量场景下的结构汉明距离（SHD）上持续优于纯统计因果发现方法，同时达到与先进的LLM辅助方法相当的性能。

Conclusion: GENESIS首次将可解释性确立为因果发现的一等目标，证明解释能力与性能可以兼得，为实际应用中需要独立验证每个结构决策的场景提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: Causal Discovery (CD) from observational data faces two fundamental challenges. First, purely statistical methods often lack the power to resolve structural ambiguities in low-sample regimes. Second, although LLM-assisted hybrid approaches improve structure recovery through semantic reasoning, the influence of that reasoning on individual edge decisions remains largely opaque. Consequently, existing hybrid methods fail to satisfy a fundamental requirement: explaining why a particular edge is included or excluded in the learned directed acyclic graph (DAG). This is critical in real-world applications, where no ground-truth DAG exists and every structural decision must be independently justified. We formalize this requirement as decision traceability, requiring every inferred edge to be supported by auditable statistical evidence, Markov Blanket consistency, or explicit domain reasoning. We propose GENESIS, an explainable hybrid CD framework that decomposes graph construction into interpretable decision points. GENESIS first identifies and scores three-node structural motifs, including chains, forks, and colliders, to establish transparent structural priors, then progressively refines the graph by integrating these priors with observational evidence, invoking domain knowledge only when statistical evidence is insufficient. By design, every edge decision is resolved through an auditable source of evidence. Experiments show that GENESIS achieves 100% decision traceability across all settings, establishing explainability as a first-class objective in causal discovery. Despite this additional requirement, GENESIS consistently outperforms purely statistical CD methods on the majority of benchmark datasets across all sample regimes in terms of Structural Hamming Distance (SHD), while achieving performance comparable to state-of-the-art LLM-assisted approaches.

</details>


### [351] [Enhancing VLM Reward Models Through Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03875)
*Pyrros Koussios,Chenhao Li,Xin Chen,Andreas Krause*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAFT是一种自监督方法，通过LoRA适配器利用任务固有的结构先验来正则化VLM的潜在空间，从而在线精炼噪声较大的基于VLM的奖励信号，无需人工标注或地面真值监督，显著提升策略收敛速度和奖励对齐质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于VLM的奖励模型虽然能绕过人工奖励工程，但其奖励信号往往噪声大且不可靠，限制了实际部署中的直接使用效果。现有方法缺乏一种无需地面真值监督、能在线精炼这些不完美奖励信号的手段。

Method: SAFT通过LoRA适配器对VLM的潜在空间进行正则化，利用任务固有的结构先验来约束和精炼VLM产生的奖励信号。该方法完全自监督，不依赖任何地面真值标注，可在在线部署过程中持续适配。

Result: 实验跨多种基础模型能力进行了严格评估。SAFT一致地减少了奖励景观中的噪声，使策略收敛更快，并显著改善了EPIC距离（对齐指标）。结果表明许多失败源于结构脆弱性而非语义误解。

Conclusion: SAFT用任务固有的结构归纳偏置替代大量人工偏好标注，为稳定的文本条件RL提供了一条可扩展的路径，强调将任务结构作为通用归纳偏置的广泛价值。

Abstract: Designing effective reward functions remains a major bottleneck in Reinforcement Learning (RL). Recent work uses large foundation Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as reward models, computing text-observation similarity to bypass manual reward engineering. Although promising, these rewards are often noisy and unreliable, limiting their direct utility during deployment. We present Structure-Aware Fine-Tuning (SAFT), a simple, self-supervised method that refines these imperfect reward signals online without access to ground-truth supervision. SAFT leverages intrinsic structural priors to regularize the VLM's latent space via LoRA adapters. We rigorously evaluate SAFT across a spectrum of base model capabilities to demonstrate its versatility. Our results show that SAFT consistently denoises the reward landscape, yielding faster policy convergence and substantially improved alignment (EPIC distance) relative to the underlying base model, suggesting that failures can often be attributed to structural brittleness rather than semantic misunderstanding. By replacing extensive human preference annotation with structural inductive biases inherent to the task, SAFT offers a scalable path for stabilizing text-conditioned RL and underscores the broader value of incorporating task structure as a general inductive bias.

</details>


### [352] [Operationally Feasible Synthetic Power-Grid Scenarios via Learning the AC-Operable Joint Distribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03878)
*Chenhan Xiao,Xinyu He,Haoran Li,Hanghang Tong,Yang Weng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种可行性感知的分布学习框架，通过分层扩散模型学习AC可运行的电力网格联合分布（拓扑、支路参数、负荷曲线），在生成过程中直接融入AC潮流收敛与运行约束，避免事后优化修正，显著提升生成场景的运行可行性与故障稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成电网生成方法虽通过事后验证、优化或物理感知生成提升了结构真实性与运行可行性，但生成场景仍存在AC可行性低和鲁棒性不足的问题，限制了其在下游电力系统研究中的实际应用价值。

Method: 提出可行性感知的分布学习框架，将AC潮流收敛与运行约束直接融入分层扩散模型的分布学习中，而非生成后再强制可行性。分层架构将高维生成任务分解为三个工程驱动的阶段：1) 拓扑与母线属性生成；2) 基于生成结构的支路参数生成；3) 基于网络结构与电气特性的负荷曲线生成。通过高效扩散采样使生成器自身产生运行可行的电网场景。

Result: 在基准系统上的实验表明，该框架显著提升了运行可行性与故障（事故）稳健性，同时保持了较强的统计保真度，并消除了基于优化的事后处理步骤。

Conclusion: 该研究证明将物理可行性约束内嵌于生成模型的分布学习过程中，是提升合成电网场景实用价值的有效途径，为数据驱动的电力系统研究提供了更可靠的数据生成工具。

Abstract: Synthetic power-grid scenarios are essential for planning, resilience assessment, contingency analysis, and data-driven power-system applications. Recent synthetic grid generation methods have improved structural realism and operational feasibility by incorporating engineering knowledge through post-generation validation, optimization, or physics-aware generation. However, generated scenarios may still exhibit low AC feasibility and robustness, limiting their practical value for downstream power-system studies. This paper proposes a feasibility-aware distribution-learning framework that learns the AC-operable joint distribution of network topology, branch electrical parameters, and time-varying load profiles. Instead of enforcing feasibility after generation, the proposed framework incorporates AC power-flow convergence and operational constraints into hierarchical diffusion-based distribution learning. This enables the generator itself to produce operationally feasible grid scenarios through efficient diffusion sampling. The hierarchical architecture decomposes the high-dimensional generation task into three engineering-motivated stages: topology and bus-attribute generation, branch-parameter generation conditioned on the generated structure, and load-profile generation conditioned on both network structure and electrical characteristics. Experiments on benchmark systems demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly improves operational feasibility and contingency robustness while maintaining strong statistical fidelity and eliminating optimization-based post-processing.

</details>


### [353] [Cross-Model KV Cache Transfer in LLM Families: A Closed-Form Linear Mapping for Prefill Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03893)
*Taekyung Heo,Rasoul Shafipour,Ritchie Zhao,Maximilian Golub,Mohammad Mahdi Kamani,Ritika Borkar,Makesh Tarun Chandran,Pantea Zardoshti,Bita Darvish Rouhani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出跨模型KV缓存迁移方法，使不同规模的模型在切换时可以复用源模型的KV缓存，跳过预填充阶段。作者发现跨模型KV对之间存在显著的线性结构，设计了一个逐头封闭式岭回归映射器，在最小校准集上拟合线性映射，在六个模型对中保留73-98%的准确率，运行速度比重新预填充快2.7-25倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产部署中经常在不同规模的模型族之间切换（如成本-质量级联、对话中途切换、路由），但每次切换都迫使接收模型从头开始执行预填充，造成巨大的计算开销。作者希望让接收模型复用源模型的KV缓存以跳过预填充，从而显著降低切换成本。

Method: 1) 发现跨模型KV存在线性结构，使用匹配的KV对（相同的KV头数和每头维度）；2) 设计逐头封闭式岭回归映射器，三步流程：a) 为每个目标层选择top-k最预测力的源层并拼接KV；b) 在映射前剥离RoPE，使拟合与位置无关，可跨上下文长度复用；c) 在500条FineWeb-Edu序列（各1024 token）的小型校准集上拟合岭回归。

Result: 在三个模型族的六个模型对上，线性映射器在四个模型对上保留了73-98%的接收模型独立预填充准确率，两个模型对则严重下降。非线性MLP在失败案例上恢复高达+37个百分点（HellaSwag）。映射器运行速度比重新预填充快2.7-25倍，在多轮切换中保持稳定。

Conclusion: 跨模型KV缓存迁移是可行的，线性映射在多数情况下有效（Qwen3 14B到32B单层可解释目标键56%方差、值32%方差，多层可达79%和65%），但对某些模型对需要非线性方法。该方法实用性强，速度快且稳定，使跨模型KV迁移成为生产部署中可行的优化方案。

Abstract: Production deployments often swap between different-sized models in a family for cost-quality cascading, mid-conversation switching, and routing, and each swap forces the receiver to repay the prefill from scratch. We propose cross-model KV cache transfer, where the receiver reuses the source's KV cache, skipping prefill. We find that cross-model KV has substantial linear structure across matched-KV pairs, where source and target share KV head count and per-head dimension. On Qwen3 14B->32B, one source layer explains 56% of variance in the target's keys and 32% in values, rising to 79% and 65% with multiple source layers. Building on this, we design a closed-form ridge mapper that operates per head and proceeds in three steps. First, for each target layer we select the top-k most predictive source layers and concatenate their KV as input. Second, we strip RoPE from the keys before mapping, so the fit is position-free and reusable across context lengths. Third, we fit ridge regression on a small calibration set of 500 FineWeb-Edu sequences of 1,024 tokens each. Surprisingly, across six pairs in three families, this linear mapper retains 73-98% of the receiver's standalone-prefill accuracy on four pairs, while two degrade sharply. A nonlinear MLP recovers up to +37 pp HellaSwag retention on the failures. The mapper runs 2.7-25x faster than re-prefill and remains stable across multi-turn handoff, making cross-model KV cache transfer practical.

</details>


### [354] [Sparse Weight Decomposition for Efficient Circuit Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03913)
*Chuanhao Yan,Xuhan Huang,Yawen Duan,Zhenfei Yin,Hang Zhao,Bryan Dai,Jie Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出稀疏权重分解（SWD），通过将预训练线性投影的权重矩阵分解为两个稀疏因子，其共享中间坐标作为可寻址的电路单元，无需训练替代网络即可支持电路提取。SWD在保真度上匹配甚至超越强基线，且仅需不到1%的训练数据，并能扩展到全模型替换及零数据变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集预训练Transformer不自然暴露可解释单元用于电路提取。现有方法通过学习辅助稀疏表示或训练稀疏模型来获得这些单元，但代价是额外的大量计算，且可能在所分析的表示与原始预训练模型之间引入保真度差距。

Method: SWD将每个权重矩阵分解为两个稀疏因子，使共享的中间坐标可作为独立寻址的电路单元。该参数化表示无需训练独立的替代网络，即可支持与学习稀疏特征方法相同的评分、选择和剪除电路提取流程。还包括全模型替换（微调非零因子值）和零数据变体。

Result: 在单矩阵替换中，SWD匹配甚至超越Transcoder等强基线的保真度，且仅使用不到1%的训练数据。在匹配保真度下，SWD在GPT-2、Qwen2.5和Qwen3.5-27B上以更少的活跃读写边和选定单元达到相同的电路充分性和必要性目标。全模型替换同样有效，零数据变体也支持更广泛的机制可解释性分析。

Conclusion: SWD提供了一种高效、高保真的替代方案，无需训练替代网络即可提取可解释电路单元，显著降低数据和计算成本，同时保持甚至提升电路提取质量，具有广泛适用性。

Abstract: Dense pretrained transformers do not naturally expose interpretable units for circuit extraction. Existing approaches obtain such units by learning auxiliary sparse representations or training sparse models, incurring substantial additional computation while potentially introducing a fidelity gap between the representation being analyzed and the original pretrained model. We propose Sparse Weight Decomposition (SWD), which reparameterizes pretrained linear projections by factorizing each weight matrix into two sparse factors whose shared intermediate coordinates serve as individually addressable circuit units. Without training a separate replacement network, this parametric representation supports the same scoring, selection, and ablation circuit extraction workflow used for methods that learn sparse features. Across single-matrix replacements, SWD matches the held-out fidelity achieved by Transcoder and other strong baselines while using less than 1% of the data that those baselines use to train their replacements. For matched replacement fidelity, SWD reaches the same circuit sufficiency and necessity targets with fewer active read/write edges and selected units across tasks on GPT-2, Qwen2.5, and Qwen3.5-27B. We further show that SWD remains effective for full-model replacement of all attention and MLP weight matrices after fine-tuning the nonzero factor values. Finally, SWD also features a zero-data variant, allowing broader use of mechanistic interpretability analysis (e.g., per-step analysis).

</details>


### [355] [Trajectory inference via Acceleration Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03916)
*Bartolo Dazzini,Giovanni Conforti,Alain Durmus,Aram-Alexandre Pooladian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种称为Acceleration Matching (AM)的新算法，用于解决轨迹推断问题。AM通过将插值问题提升到相空间，并回归到一个显式的条件加速度场，从而生成平滑的随机轨迹。该方法训练时仅需位置数据，无需轨迹仿真或昂贵的预处理，在多个基准问题上表现优于或与现有算法相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轨迹推断是在许多科学领域中的基本问题：给定离散时间点的未配对观测快照，目标是生成最接近并插值数据的平滑轨迹。现有算法存在计算挑战：要么依赖预处理子程序来强制平滑性，要么依赖基于仿真的训练目标，这些方法都可能非常昂贵。

Method: 提出Acceleration Matching (AM)算法。核心思想是将原始插值问题提升到相空间（相位空间），然后回归到一个显式的条件加速度场，该场能够生成与给定边缘分布一致的随机平滑轨迹。训练过程仅需位置数据，避免训练期间的轨迹仿真，且无需昂贵的预处理步骤。

Result: 通过大量数值实验表明，AM算法在多个来自现有文献的基准问题上与现有算法相比具有竞争力或表现更优。

Conclusion: AM算法通过相空间提升和显式条件加速度场回归，有效克服了现有轨迹推断算法的计算瓶颈，提供了一种高效且强大的替代方案。

Abstract: Trajectory inference is a fundamental problem in many scientific domains: given a collection of unpaired snapshots of observations at discrete time points, the goal is to generate smooth trajectories that best resemble and interpolate the data. Existing algorithms exhibit computational challenges: they either rely on preprocessing subroutines to enforce smoothness or on simulation-based training objectives, both of which can be expensive. In order to overcome these limitations, we propose a new algorithm called Acceleration Matching (\texttt{AM}). Our approach consists of lifting the original interpolation problem to phase space and then regressing onto an explicit conditional acceleration field that induces random, smooth trajectories that agree with the prescribed marginals. Importantly, our resulting training algorithm only requires positional data, avoids trajectory simulation during training, and is devoid of expensive preprocessing. We provide ample numerical evidence suggesting that \texttt{AM} is competitive with or superior to existing algorithms on several benchmark problems from the existing literature.

</details>


### [356] [PRISM: Powerful Time Series to Image (TS2I) Representations for Multivariate Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03926)
*Mateusz Smendowski,Kamil Faber,Piotr Nawrocki,Nathalie Japkowicz,Roberto Corizzo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRISM是一个即插即用的元工作流，用于系统性地构建和评估基于图像的多元时间序列异常检测表示方法。在超过7000个实验中证明其配置竞争力强，并发现通道化（channelization）是关键设计维度，提出MSM方案提升11-27%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列异常检测(TSAD)在预测维护、金融和云计算等领域至关重要，但其性能对表示选择极为敏感，尤其在多元场景下。虽然将时间序列转换为图像在预测和分类任务中已取得成功，但如何将多元高维序列映射为多通道图像，以及视觉骨干网络能否匹配时域基线在TSAD中的表现，这些问题仍不清楚。

Method: 提出PRISM（plug-and-play meta-workflow），一种即插即用的元工作流，用于系统性地构建和评估多元时间序列异常检测的图像表示。通过超过7000个实验进行大规模评估，并识别出通道化（channelization）——即多通道图像通道维度的构建方式——作为关键设计维度，提出基于统计的MSM方案。

Result: 在14个数据集中的10个上取得最优VUS-PR，平均比最优竞争方法提升41%。MSM方案相比PCA替代方案获得11-27%的提升。ImageNet预训练编码器可有效迁移，冻结编码器保留92%微调性能，同时训练速度快1.8倍。

Conclusion: 精心设计的PRISM图像配置能够与24个时域基线竞争并胜出，通道化是一个此前未被充分研究的关键设计维度，ImageNet预训练编码器在TSAD中具有良好的迁移能力和效率。

Abstract: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) underpins applications in predictive maintenance, finance, and cloud computing, however performance remains sensitive to representation choices, especially in multivariate settings. While transforming time series into images has shown success in forecasting and classification, it remains unclear how multivariate, high-dimensional series should be mapped to multi-channel images and whether vision backbones can match time-domain baselines in TSAD. We introduce PRISM, a plug-and-play meta-workflow enabling systematic construction and evaluation of image-based representations for multivariate TSAD. Our evaluation spanning over 7,000 experiments shows that well-designed PRISM configurations are competitive with 24 time-domain baselines, achieving the best VUS-PR on 10 of 14 datasets, with an average improvement of 41% over the best competing method on those datasets. Further, we identify channelization - how the channel dimension of multi-channel images is constructed - as a critical and previously understudied design dimension, and introduce MSM, a novel statistics-based scheme achieving 11-27% gains over PCA-based alternatives. Finally, ImageNet-pretrained encoders transfer effectively to TSAD, with frozen encoders retaining 92% of fine-tuned performance while training 1.8 times faster. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Smendowski/PRISM.

</details>


### [357] [A Physics-Flavored Transformer Network for Parametrizing Contraction Dynamics of Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03927)
*Mattias Luber,Timo Betz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种物理增强神经网络（PFNN），将拉伸指数物理模型集成到CNN-Transformer架构中，用于从力-时间曲线中自动提取工程化骨骼肌组织（ESMs）的动力学表型参数。通过合成数据训练"物理直觉"并配合无监督自我对齐进行混合训练，解决了标注生物数据稀缺的问题，在包括杜氏肌营养不良模型在内的多种收缩表型和细胞系上实现了高保真参数化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程化骨骼肌组织的功能表征通常依赖峰值力等简单指标，丢弃了关键的动力学信息。原因是机械模型虽然能捕捉这些动力学特征但数学复杂度高，阻碍了其规模化应用和广泛采用。

Method: 提出PFNN架构，将拉伸指数物理模型嵌入CNN-Transformer中，直接从力-时间曲线提取物理有意义的参数。采用混合训练范式：先在合成数据上发展"物理直觉"，再通过无监督自我对齐在未标注的真实数据上微调。

Result: 物理增强方法在多种收缩表型和细胞系（包括杜氏肌营养不良模型）上实现了高保真的参数化，验证了方法的有效性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 该可扩展、自我优化的pipeline弥合了理想化生物物理与噪声体外数据之间的差距，为高通量生物物理研究提供了稳健工具。

Abstract: Engineered Skeletal Muscle Tissues (ESMs) have become a key structure for biomedical disease modeling and pharmacological screening, yet their functional characterization often relies on simplistic metrics like peak force, discarding critical kinetic information. This is partially due to the high level of mathematical complexity which mechanistic models introduce to capture these dynamics. Hence, exactly the complexity prevents scalable application and widespread adaptation in the field. Here we present a Physics-Flavored Neural Network (PFNN) that automates the kinetic phenotyping of ESMs. Our architecture integrates a stretched-exponential physical model into a CNN-Transformer, enabling the extraction of physically meaningful parameters directly from force-time profiles. To address the scarcity of labeled biological data, we employ a hybrid training paradigm: the model develops a "physical intuition" on synthetic data before undergoing unsupervised self-alignment on unlabeled real-world measurements. Our results demonstrate that this physics-flavored approach achieves high-fidelity parameterization across diverse contractile phenotypes and cell lines, including Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy models. Our scalable, self-improving pipeline bridges the gap between idealized biophysics and noisy \emph{in vitro} data, providing a robust tool for high-throughput biophysical research.

</details>


### [358] [Latent Reward Registers for Diffusion Preference Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03929)
*Yuanshen Guan,Zipeng Feng,Zhiwei Xiong,Peiqin Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Latent Reward Registers机制，通过在冻结的Diffusion Transformer中输入序列前添加可学习的、位置无关的寄存器token，直接从中间含噪隐变量中估计终端偏好奖励，从而解决扩散模型与人类偏好对齐中的时序信用分配问题，并支持训练（RG-OPD）和推理（RGS）两种对齐策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型与人类偏好对齐方法通常依赖最终生成样本上的稀疏终端奖励，在多步去噪过程中面临严重的时间信用分配挑战，难以在中间步骤提供有效的奖励信号。

Method: 1) 在冻结的DiT输入序列前添加可学习的、位置无关的寄存器token，作为独立读出机制直接从中间含噪隐变量估计奖励，不改变生成器的隐藏状态或速度场；2) 训练策略RG-OPD：沿on-policy轨迹蒸馏奖励引导的更新，避免标准策略梯度的昂贵rollout；3) 推理策略RGS：通过幅度匹配的奖励梯度引导采样轨迹，无需参数更新。

Result: 在高噪声水平(u=0.8)下，寄存器在评估的潜在奖励模型中达到最高成对准确率；RG-OPD在超越在线强化学习基线的同时将GPU时间减少最高33倍；RGS在无训练方法中达到新SOTA，同时提升对齐和感知指标。

Conclusion: Latent Reward Registers提供了一种高效、密集且可微的奖励信号机制，有效解决了扩散模型对齐中的时序信用分配问题，在训练效率和推理性能上均取得了显著改进。

Abstract: Aligning diffusion models with human preferences usually relies on a sparse terminal reward evaluated on the final generated samples, presenting a severe temporal credit-assignment challenge across the multi-step denoising process. We propose Latent Reward Registers, a mechanism that estimates terminal preference directly from intermediate noisy latents by prepending learnable, position-free register tokens to the input sequence of a frozen Diffusion Transformer (DiT). This independent readout mechanism extracts latent reward evidence without altering the generator's hidden states or velocity field. The resulting dense, differentiable reward signal throughout the full denoising process facilitates two alignment strategies. For training, Reward-Gradient On-Policy Distillation (RG-OPD) distills reward-guided updates along on-policy trajectories, bypassing the computationally expensive rollouts of standard policy gradients. For inference, Reward-Guided Sampling (RGS) steers trajectories via magnitude-matched reward gradients without parameter updates. Empirically, at high noise levels (u = 0.8), the registers reach the highest pairwise accuracy among the evaluated latent reward models. Furthermore, RG-OPD outperforms online reinforcement learning baselines while reducing GPU hours by up to 33x, and RGS establishes a new state-of-the-art among training-free methods, strictly enhancing both alignment and perceptual metrics. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/Guanys-dar/latent-reward-register

</details>


### [359] [Muon Meets Mamba: Spectral Optimization for State Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03941)
*Arslan Battalov,Karim Kramin,Alexander Markotenko,Sofia Sinitsina*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了Muon优化器与AdamW在Mamba-2 130M状态空间模型上的表现，发现Muon的优势具有局部性：仅在输出投影层使用Muon效果最佳，优于在输入投影或两者同时使用；优势主要体现在token效率上，并且与条件数改善无关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon优化器在Transformer模型上表现优异，但其在状态空间模型（如Mamba-2）上的行为鲜有研究。作者希望通过控制变量的实验协议，探究Muon在不同权重组上的效果。

Method: 采用控制实验协议，在Mamba-2 130M模型上比较Muon与AdamW，仅变化的变量是哪些权重组使用Muon训练（输入投影、输出投影或两者）。在两个语料库和两个token预算下进行验证，并考察训练超过计算最优点的表现。

Result: Muon的优势具有局部性：仅在输出投影上使用Muon优于在输入投影或两者同时使用；优势主要体现为token效率提升，跨两个语料库和两个token预算稳定存在，且持续训练过计算最优点后依然保持；条件数改善不能解释该增益——Muon确实降低了所训练投影的条件数，但条件数更好的输入投影并未带来帮助。

Conclusion: Muon在状态空间模型上的收益是局部的而非全局的，主要来自输出投影层。其效果与条件数改善无因果关系，提示需要重新审视Muon在SSM上有效性的机制解释。

Abstract: Muon is a recent optimizer that orthogonalizes the update to each weight matrix with a Newton-Schulz iteration, which performs steepest descent under the spectral norm. Almost all the evidence for it comes from Transformer models, and its behavior on state-space models is largely unreported. We compare Muon with AdamW on Mamba-2 130M under a controlled protocol that varies only which weight groups are trained with Muon. The benefit is localized. Muon on the output projection alone beats Muon on the input projection or on both. The advantage is mainly one of token efficiency. It holds on two corpora and two token budgets, and persists when training continues well past the compute-optimal point. Conditioning does not explain the gain. Muon lowers the condition number of whichever projection it trains, but the better-conditioned input projection is not the one that helps.

</details>


### [360] [Assessment of Conditional Diffusion Model for Synthetic Histopathology Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03990)
*Seyed Kahaki,Shijie Li,Weijie Chen,Nicholas Petrick*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究探讨合成组织病理学图像的质量评估方法，指出现有指标（FID、IS）因依赖ImageNet预训练特征提取器而存在局限性。作者提出使用病理学预训练基础模型改进的FID和IS指标，并通过核分割下游任务验证指标有效性。结果表明病理特异性指标与下游任务性能相关性更高（改良IS与AJI+的r=0.6096），且合成数据多样性比视觉保真度对分割模型性能影响更大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成组织病理学图像生成是解决计算病理学中数据稀缺问题的潜在方法，但现有评估方法未能充分评估合成数据的医学应用质量。传统指标（FID、IS）依赖ImageNet预训练特征提取器，可能不适用于病理学图像的特殊特征分布，因此需要开发领域专用的评估指标。

Method: 1）提出使用病理学数据集预训练的基础模型来改进FID和IS指标；2）补充基于precision-recall的评估指标；3）使用条件去噪扩散模型在四个基准数据集上训练，采用两步训练方法生成具有系统性质量差异的合成数据集；4）测量合成数据质量指标与下游核分割性能（AJI+和Dice系数）之间的相关性。

Result: 病理特异性指标具有更好的区分能力。改良IS与分割性能（AJI+）相关系数r=0.6096（p=0.0122），显著优于原始IS（r=0.0708，p=0.7944）。此外，增加合成训练数据的多样性比提高单个图像的视觉保真度对分割模型性能的正相关性更高。

Conclusion: 病理学专用的合成图像质量评估指标比传统通用指标更有效，而合成数据的多样性是影响下游任务性能的关键因素，而非单纯的视觉逼真度。

Abstract: Synthetic histopathology image generation has emerged as an approach that may address data scarcity in computational pathology, yet current evaluation methodologies may not fully assess synthetic data quality for medical applications. This work investigates and addresses limitations in existing evaluation metrics, investigating an approach for assessing synthetic histopathology image quality through domain-specific metrics and downstream task validation. We show that conventional synthetic data evaluation metrics such as Frechet Inception Distance (FID) and Inception Score (IS) may have limitations when applied to histopathology images due to their reliance on ImageNet-pretrained feature extractors. To address these limitations, we propose for consideration modified FID and IS approaches utilizing foundation models pretrained on digital pathology datasets, supplemented by precision-recall based metrics as part of an additional quality assessment. Using conditional denoising diffusion models trained on four benchmark datasets, with a two-step training approach, we generated synthetic datasets with systematically varied quality characteristics. We also measured the correlation between the synthetic data quality metrics with downstream nuclei segmentation performance using common metrics including the aggregated Jaccard index (AJI+) and the Dice coefficient. The study results suggest that pathology-specific metrics may provide improved discriminative power. Specifically, the modified Inception Score indicates higher correlation with downstream task performance (r=0.6096 with AJI+, p=0.0122), compared to the original IS (r=0.0708, p=0.7944). Our observations indicate that increasing the variety of generated training data has a higher positive correlation with segmentation model performance than improving the visual fidelity of individual generated images.

</details>


### [361] [Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning LLMs: Inference Regimes, Evaluation, and Reproducibility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.04001)
*Mohsen Hariri,Weicong Chen,Nahal Shahini,Vikash Singh,Kai Ye,Amirhossein Samandar,Debargha Ganguly,Sreehari Sankar,Yanyan Zhang,Shouren Wang,Jerry Peng,Biyao Zhang,Michael Hinczewski,Vipin Chaudhary*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统性地建立了一个关于测试时扩展（test-time scaling）的严谨框架，沿三个轴展开：形式化三种推理结构（单轨迹顺序扩展、叶级扩展、前缀级扩展）、提出将整个推理系统作为评估对象的评估原则（区分端到端系统性能与候选库诊断），并明确推理协议的可复现性要求（区分精确重放与分布可复现性）。作者还组织了开放权重推理生态系统，在若干基准上验证了这些原则，并发布了超过20亿条完整推理轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前"测试时扩展"这一术语涵盖了多种本质上不同的推理算法（单轨迹扩展、采样并投票/验证、对不完整状态搜索），它们在统计结构、计算核算和失败模式上存在根本差异。然而许多研究将这些过程混为一谈，用单一标量"预算"来对待，或在报告准确率时不说明所用的推理协议，导致不同研究之间的结果难以比较。

Method: 作者从三个层面构建系统性框架：(1) 将测试时扩展形式化为自回归模型隐式前缀树上的预算推理，并区分三种结构机制； (2) 将评估对象视为整个推理系统，开发评估剖面（evaluation profile），其坐标和简单泛函可恢复或界定常见的重复采样指标，并提出协议匹配的计算与不确定性报告规范； (3) 规定推理协议的可复现性要求，区分精确重放与分布可复现性。此外，按模型侧和接口机制组织开放权重推理生态系统，并在广泛知识、符号推理和竞赛数学基准上应用这些原则。

Result: 作者在多种基准（广泛知识、符号推理、竞争数学）上应用了所提出的评估原则，并组装了超过20亿条完整推理轨迹数据集，附带逐步丰富的验证器和token级信号，供研究社区发布使用。

Conclusion: 测试时扩展的各算法不应被当作可互换的单一"预算"过程，需要按结构机制、整个推理系统的评估视角以及可复现性要求三个维度来加以形式化和区分，才能实现跨研究的有意义比较。

Abstract: Large language models can solve substantially harder reasoning problems with more inference-time compute. The term "test-time scaling," however, now covers diverse inference algorithms that extend deliberation along a single trajectory, sample completed candidates and aggregate them through voting or verification, or search over unfinished partial states. These algorithms differ in their statistical structure, compute accounting, and failure modes. Treating these procedures as interchangeable under a single scalar "budget," or reporting accuracy without the inference protocol that produced it, makes results difficult to compare across studies. We develop a systematic account of test-time scaling along three axes. First, we formalize test-time scaling as budgeted inference over the implicit prefix tree of an autoregressive model and distinguish three structural regimes: single-trajectory sequential scaling, leaf-level scaling with terminal reduction, and prefix-level scaling. Second, we treat the evaluated object as the entire inference system and develop evaluation principles that separate end-to-end system performance from candidate-bank diagnostics. We introduce an evaluation profile whose coordinates and simple functionals recover or bound common repeated-sampling metrics, and prescribe protocol-matched reporting of compute and uncertainty. Third, we specify reproducibility requirements for inference protocols, distinguishing exact replay from distributional reproducibility and identifying the artifacts needed to support each. We also organize the open-weight reasoning ecosystem by model-side and interface mechanisms, apply these principles to broad-knowledge, symbolic-reasoning, and competition-mathematics benchmarks, and assemble over 2 billion full reasoning traces for release with progressively richer verifier and token-level signals.

</details>


<div id='cs.NE'></div>

# cs.NE [[Back]](#toc)

### [362] [NeuroMosaic: Anatomically Grounded Multimodal Large Language Modeling for Molecularly Aware Glioma Reasoning from 3D MRI and Clinical Narratives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03187)
*Yantong Liu,Zheyu Zhang,Runpeng Liu,Mu Xitang,Seong-Yoon Shin,Hyun-Ae Lee*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: NeuroMosaic 是一种针对神经肿瘤学的3D多模态医学大语言模型，通过解剖索引的区域化标记将多序列脑MRI转化为可审计的医学证据，实现精确、可解释的容积医学语言推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态医学大语言模型在神经肿瘤学应用中存在两个结构性问题：(1) 三维容积证据被压缩成通用视觉token，丢失了空间解剖信息；(2) 诊断结论缺乏与MRI区域的关联性，无法审计验证。这些问题限制了模型在需要精确定位和可解释性的神经肿瘤诊断中的应用。

Method: NeuroMosaic采用四组核心组件：多分辨率容积分词器（multi-resolution volumetric tokenizer）用于提取三维MRI特征；神经解剖图路由（neuroanatomical graph router）将token与解剖结构关联；分子概念记忆（molecular concept memory）对齐临床叙事与分子层面的信息；选择性风险控制（selective risk control）确保输出安全可靠。

Result: 在四个胶质瘤队列中，NeuroMosaic内部亚型macro-F1达0.827，外部队列macro-F1分别为0.784、0.761和0.742。在UPenn-GBM上比最强匹配输入基线提升3.6个百分点。IDH、1p/19q和MGMT的AUROC分别达0.918、0.861和0.781。证据指向准确率0.703，靶向证据删除将正确回答概率降低0.187（随机删除仅0.046），验证了解剖索引路由的有效性。

Conclusion: 解剖索引路由被证明是一种可测量的机制，能够实现准确、有据可依、校准良好的容积医学-语言推理，为神经肿瘤学的多模态AI诊断提供了可审计的解决方案。

Abstract: Multimodal medical large language models remain structurally weak for neuro-oncology because volumetric evidence is compressed into generic visual tokens and diagnostic conclusions often lack an auditable link to MRI regions. We present NeuroMosaic, a 3D multimodal language model that converts multi-sequence brain MRI into anatomy-indexed regional tokens, aligns them with clinical narrative and molecular concepts, and generates evidence-linked outputs. The architecture combines a multi-resolution volumetric tokenizer, a neuroanatomical graph router, a molecular concept memory, and selective risk control. Across four glioma cohorts, NeuroMosaic achieved an internal subtype macro-F1 of 0.827 and external macro-F1 values of 0.784, 0.761, and 0.742. On UPenn-GBM, it improved over the strongest matched-input baseline by 3.6 percentage points (95% CI: 1.8 to 5.4, adjusted p = 0.0018), with IDH, 1p/19q, and MGMT AUROCs of 0.918, 0.861, and 0.781. Evidence pointing accuracy reached 0.703, and targeted evidence deletion reduced correct-answer probability by 0.187, compared with 0.046 for random deletion. These results establish anatomy-indexed routing as a measurable mechanism for accurate, grounded, and calibrated volumetric medical-language reasoning.

</details>


### [363] [Impacts of Single-objective Landscapes on Multi-objective Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03266)
*Shoichiro Tanaka,Keiki Takadama,Hiroyuki Sato*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: 本文揭示了多目标优化问题与其内部单目标优化问题之间的关系，通过比较局部最优网络与Pareto最优网络的结构，发现大多数Pareto最优解可从单目标局部最优解到达，且这种趋势随着目标数量和目标相关性的增加而增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索多目标优化问题与其包含的单目标优化问题之间的内在联系，特别是通过局部最优网络和Pareto最优网络的图结构关系来理解这一联系，为多目标优化提供新的求解思路。

Method: 针对组合优化问题，分别构建单目标问题的局部最优网络和多目标问题的Pareto最优网络。将整个网络划分为子图（组件），通过对单目标局部最优网络与多目标Pareto最优网络之间的重叠关系进行表征和分析，研究两类网络之间的关联。

Result: 在多目标景观问题中，大多数Pareto最优解可从单目标局部最优解到达；增加目标数量和目标相关性会强化这一趋势；协变量数量影响两类网络之间的交叉连接关系数量。

Conclusion: 搜索单目标问题可以作为多目标优化的一种线索，即通过求解单目标问题的局部最优来引导多目标优化，为多目标优化算法设计提供了新视角。

Abstract: This work revealed a relationship between a multi-objective optimization problem and single-objective optimization problems that exist in the multi-objective problem. This work focused on combinatorial problems and investigated the relations between the local optima networks of the single-objective problems and the Pareto optima network of the multi-objective problem. Each of their networks has a graph structure. We divided the entire network into subgraphs. Each subgraph was called a component and characterized by overlapping relations between the single-objective local optima networks and the multi-objective Pareto optima network. Results on multi-objective landscape problems showed that most Pareto optimal solutions were reachable from the single-objective local optimal solutions. This tendency was emphasized by increasing the number of objectives and the objective correlation. The number of co-variables impacted the number of cross-link relations between the single-objective local optima networks and the multi-objective Pareto optima network. The results suggested that searching for single-objective problems is a clue to multi-objective optimization.

</details>


### [364] [MuEvo: LLM-Driven Evolution of Multi-Heuristic Ensemble](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03636)
*Haoze Lv,Ning Lu,Shengcai Liu,Shaofeng Zhang,Ke Tang*

Main category: cs.NE

TL;DR: MuEvo是一个基于LLM的框架，用于演化启发式集成（heuristic ensembles），通过整体级反馈协调多个启发式组件的协同进化，在组合优化问题中表现出优于现有方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM-AHD方法主要优化单一启发式，但实际优化框架往往依赖多个相互作用的组件。直接扩展单一启发式方法存在两个挑战：早期组件选择可能忽略具有后期潜力的组件，而独立演化则忽略了组件间的依赖关系。

Method: MuEvo结合两大核心机制：(1) 动态组件管理（Dynamic Component Management），通过短预算探测和可逆生命周期在搜索过程中修正组件优先级；(2) LLM驱动的协同演化（LLM-Driven Co-Evolution），通过多集成评估、跨组件信息共享、关系引导的配对演化和自适应预算分配来协调组件种群。

Result: 在四个组合优化领域的选择性超启发式和组件化蚁群优化上进行了评估。MuEvo一致性地提升了人工设计的框架，并优于现有的最先进LLM-AHD方法的多组件扩展版本。

Conclusion: MuEvo展示了在控制器介导的启发式池和功能差异化的算法组件中均具有有效性，证明了LLM驱动的启发式集成演化是提升组合优化框架性能的有效途径。

Abstract: Large language model-based automated heuristic design (LLM-AHD) has shown strong potential in discovering effective heuristics for combinatorial optimization problems. However, existing methods primarily optimize a single heuristic, whereas practical optimization frameworks often rely on multiple interacting components. Directly extending single-heuristic methods is challenging because early component selection can overlook components with late potential, while independent evolution ignores inter-component dependencies. We propose MuEvo, an LLM-driven framework for evolving heuristic ensembles under ensemble-level feedback. MuEvo combines Dynamic Component Management, which uses short-budget probing and a reversible lifecycle to revise component priorities throughout the search, with LLM-Driven Co-Evolution, which coordinates component populations through Multi-Ensemble Evaluation, Cross-Component Information Sharing, Relation-Guided Pair Evolution, and Adaptive Budget Allocation. We evaluate MuEvo on selection hyper-heuristics and componentized ant colony optimization across four combinatorial optimization domains. Results show that MuEvo consistently improves human-designed frameworks and outperforms representative multi-component extensions of state-of-the-art LLM-AHD methods, demonstrating its effectiveness across both controller-mediated heuristic pools and functionally differentiated algorithmic components.

</details>

### [365] [Knowledge-Geometry Decoupling: Refreshable Pretrained Transfer for Streaming Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02738)
*Zixuan Wang,Yuhong Chen,Yuxuan Zhu,Guidong Lei,Zhiluohan Guo,Yu Zhao,Kun Wang,Bangyang Hong,Kangle Wu,Yabo Ni,Anxiang Zeng,Cong Fu,Hui Li*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出知识-几何解耦（KGD）框架，解决工业推荐系统中预训练-迁移范式的两大问题：从行为序列中学什么（通过行为多令牌预测BMTP只保留有协作或语义关联的未来项作为监督），以及如何迁移（将预训练知识与任务特定几何解耦到独立参数集：可刷新的编码器拥有行为知识，任务学习者通过只读交叉注意力读取编码器状态，并通过锚定校准残差ACR写入任务几何）。KGD在8个公开基准上较强基线提升4-12%，在90天生产流中持续保持优势，已全面部署于Shopee首页搜索，A/B测试中GMV/用户提升1.75%，广告收入提升1.53%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业推荐系统日益采用预训练-再迁移（pretrain-then-transfer）范式，但行为分布漂移带来两个关键问题：1）从行为序列中应该学习什么——传统next-token预测将相邻视为依赖关系，可能编码跨不相关会话的虚假转换；2）如何迁移学习到的知识——因为预训练模型会不断刷新，需要解决知识持续更新时下游任务适应不被破坏的问题。

Method: KGD包含两大核心组件：1）行为多令牌预测（BMTP）：只保留协作或语义相关的未来项作为监督信号，避免编码虚假的跨会话转换，从而获得更干净、更可迁移的行为知识；2）解耦所有权：将预训练知识与任务特定几何分配至独立参数集。可刷新编码器负责行为知识，任务学习者通过只读交叉注意力读取上下文编码器状态，并通过锚定校准残差（ACR）写入与预训练嵌入正交的任务几何。这种解耦所有权使得持续知识刷新不受任务梯度干扰，且不使下游适配失效。

Result: KGD在8个公开基准上比强预训练-迁移基线提升4-12%；在90天生产流中持续保持优势，而基线无提升。已在Shopee全面部署，在Shopee首页搜索的线上A/B测试中，GMV/用户提升1.75%，广告收入提升1.53%。

Conclusion: KGD通过回答"学什么"（BMTP过滤虚假行为关联）和"如何迁移"（参数解耦实现持续刷新的兼容性）两大问题，为工业推荐系统的预训练-迁移范式提供了有效的解决方案，并在公开基准和真实生产环境中均验证了其显著价值。

Abstract: Industrial recommenders increasingly adopt the pretrain-then-transfer paradigm, yet behavioral distribution drift raises two questions: what to learn from behavior sequences, and how to transfer the learned knowledge while the pretrained model is continually refreshed. To resolve them, we propose Knowledge-Geometry Decoupling (KGD). For what to learn, conventional next-token prediction treats adjacency as dependency and may encode spurious transitions across unrelated sessions. We introduce Behavioral Multi-Token Prediction (BMTP) to retain only collaboratively or semantically related future items as supervision, yielding cleaner and more transferable behavioral knowledge. For how to transfer, pretrained knowledge and task-specific geometry impose conflicting optimization demands on shared parameters. To handle it, KGD assigns them to separate parameter sets: a refreshable encoder owns behavioral knowledge, while a task learner reads contextualized encoder states through read-only cross-attention and writes task-specific geometry through Anchored Calibration Residual (ACR) orthogonal to the pretrained embedding. The decoupled ownership enables continual knowledge refresh without task-gradient interference or invalidating downstream adaptation. KGD improves over strong pretrain-transfer baselines by 4-12% on eight public benchmarks and sustains its advantage over a 90-day production stream where baselines show no gains. KGD has been fully deployed in Shopee. In a live A/B test on Shopee Homepage Search, it increases GMV per user by 1.75% and advertising revenue by 1.53%, demonstrating its high practical value. We provide the core implementation of KGD at https://github.com/FuCongResearchSquad/KGD4REC.

</details>


### [366] [Search, Inspect, Fetch: Exploiting Boolean Retrieval for Deep-Research Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02751)
*Shuai Wang,Haodong Chen,Yu Yin,Shengyao Zhuang,Bevan Koopman,Guido Zuccon*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 提出SIEVE搜索-检视-获取接口，利用基于字段的布尔检索（BQL）实现结构化文档检索，相比传统搜索-浏览工作流在三个QA数据集上获得更高准确率且节省20.7-50.6%的token。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度研究智能体采用搜索-浏览工作流，检索并读取整页内容，未利用网页通过标题、标题头、章节和元数据暴露的可寻址结构。这导致智能体无法将检索约束到文档字段，且常将无关页面内容带入上下文。

Method: 提出SIEVE接口，包括三个步骤：1) 基于字段的布尔检索（BQL）过滤候选文档；2) 对候选集排序；3) 呈现结构丰富的结果卡片供检视，并仅获取选定的章节内容。

Result: 在三个QA数据集上，SIEVE比最准确的传统搜索-浏览配置获得更高准确率，同时减少20.7-50.6%的token使用。进一步分析表明BQL过滤改善所有测试的排序器，且准确率-上下文优势在不同检索器和智能体骨干上均保持。

Conclusion: SIEVE通过结构化字段检索有效减少了无关上下文，在提升准确率的同时大幅节省token消耗，展示了利用网页结构化信息对深度研究智能体的重要价值。

Abstract: Existing deep-research agents use a search-visit workflow that retrieves and reads whole pages, without considering the addressable structure that web sources expose through titles, headings, sections, and metadata. This prevents agents from directly constraining retrieval to document fields and often carries irrelevant page content into their context. We introduce SIEVE, a search-inspect-fetch interface driven by fielded Boolean retrieval (BQL). SIEVE filters candidates over document fields, ranks the admitted set, presents structure-rich result cards for inspection, and fetches only selected sections. Across three QA collections, SIEVE achieves higher accuracy than the most accurate conventional Search-Visit configuration on each collection while using 20.7-50.6% fewer tokens. Further analyses show that BQL filtering improves all tested rankers and that the accuracy-context advantage persists across retriever choices and agent backbones. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ielab/skim-search-agent.

</details>


### [367] [Field Aware Agent Skill Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02880)
*Paimon Goulart,Liang Wu,Kelly Wan,Evangelos E. Papalexakis,Liangjie Hong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究终身学习中技能库的检索问题，提出将技能视为多字段结构化对象而非扁平文档，通过逐字段独立计算稀疏和稠密相似度形成张量化表示，再以均匀权重或小型MLP融合字段级分数。实验表明字段感知的MLP方法在SkillRet和SRA-Bench上均取得最优结果，且技能库越大优势越明显。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着终身学习智能体累积不断增长的技能库，正确检索技能成为关键瓶颈。现有方法将每个技能视为扁平文档（拼接名称、描述和正文等字段），忽视了技能天然具有的结构化、多字段特性，不同字段提供了关于何时及如何使用技能的不同信息。

Method: 将每个技能表示为独立组件，对每个字段分别计算稀疏和稠密相似度，从而获得张量化、字段感知的技能库表示；然后通过均匀权重或小型学习型MLP融合各字段级别的分数。

Result: 在SkillRet和SRA-Bench两个基准上，保持字段分离可提升混合检索性能，而学习型MLP方法效果最强且最稳定。字段感知MLP在SkillRet上达到77.95 Recall@10，在SRA-Bench上达到83.78 Recall@10，均优于对应的拼接式学习基线。技能库越大，优势越显著。

Conclusion: 技能表示本身对检索很重要，简单保留技能文件中已有的结构即可显著改善检索效果，尤其是在检索最困难的大规模技能库场景下，字段感知检索尤为有效。

Abstract: As lifelong learning agents accumulate lifelong growing skill banks, retrieving the correct skill becomes an increasingly important bottleneck. Most current skill retrieval methods treat each skill as one flat document by concatenating fields such as the name, description, and body. However, skills are naturally structured, multi-field objects, where each field provides different information about when and how the skill should be used. In this work, we study whether preserving this structure improves skill retrieval. We represent each skill as its separate components, and compute sparse and dense similarities for each field independently, exposing a naturally tensorized, field-aware representation of the skill bank. We then combine these field-level scores either with uniform weights or with a small learned MLP. Across two different skill retrieval benchmarks, SkillRet and SRA-Bench, we find that keeping fields separate improves hybrid retrieval, and learning over the field-level scores gives the strongest and most consistent results. Our field-aware MLP reaches $77.95$ Recall@10 on SkillRet and $83.78$ Recall@10 on SRA-Bench, outperforming the corresponding concatenated learned baselines. We also find that the advantage grows as the skill bank becomes larger, suggesting that field-aware skill retrieval becomes especially useful in the setting where retrieval is most difficult. Our results show that skill representation itself matters, and that simply preserving the structure already present in skill files can substantially improve retrieval.

</details>


### [368] [Coverage Matters: MarginMerge for Compressing Multi-Vector Visual Document Retrievers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02969)
*Ailar Mahdizadeh,Aria Salari,Sohail Rajabi,Shahriar Mirabbasi,Panos Nasiopoulos,Alireza Morsali*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: MarginMerge是一种针对多向量视觉文档检索器（如ColPali、ColQwen）的压缩方法。它通过覆盖感知的锚点选择、聚类文档patch，并用轻量共享网络为每个聚类合成代表性向量，在保持标准MaxSim检索接口的同时，实现5%-10%的向量保留率下仍保留97%-99%的检索性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多向量视觉文档检索器（ColPali、ColQwen）虽然检索性能强，但存储大量细粒度patch嵌入会导致索引体积巨大，且late-interaction评分计算成本高昂。作者认为有效的压缩应保留"查询相关覆盖"（query-relevant coverage），即保留可能在不同查询下成为最强MaxSim匹配的多样化文档区域，而不是独立按显著性选择patch。这也解释了为什么密集渲染页面比自然图像更容易压缩。

Method: MarginMerge包括三个步骤：(1) 覆盖感知锚点选择（coverage-aware anchors selection），选择能够代表多样化文档区域的锚点；(2) 对文档patch进行聚类；(3) 使用轻量共享网络为每个聚类合成一个代表性向量。压缩在索引阶段一次性完成，检索阶段保持标准MaxSim接口不变。

Result: 在ColQwen2.5和ColPali上跨越六个数据集，MarginMerge在5%和10%向量保留率下达到了最高的查询无关平均匹配度。与未压缩索引相比，保留了97%-99%的平均nDCG@5，同时减少了90%-95%的存储文档向量。在5%保留率下，与几何合并方法相比，六个ColQwen2.5数据集上的排名翻转平均减少约41%。模型无需重新训练即可迁移到未见数据集和保留率。

Conclusion: MarginMerge通过覆盖感知的压缩策略，在显著减小索引规模的同时保持了极高的检索性能，且具有良好的泛化能力（可迁移到未见数据集和不同保留率），为多向量视觉文档检索器的实际部署提供了高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-vector visual document retrievers such as ColPali and ColQwen achieve strong retrieval by storing fine-grained patch embeddings, but this produces large indexes and costly late-interaction scoring. We argue that effective compression should preserve query-relevant coverage, meaning the diverse document regions that may become the strongest MaxSim match across queries, rather than selecting patches independently by salience. This view also explains why dense rendered pages are easier to compress than natural images. We introduce MarginMerge, a compression method for frozen multi-vector retrievers. It selects coverage-aware anchors, clusters document patches, and uses a lightweight shared network to synthesize one representative per cluster. Compression is performed once during indexing, while retrieval keeps the standard MaxSim interface. Across six datasets on both ColQwen2.5 and ColPali, MarginMerge achieves the highest matched query-agnostic average at 5% and 10% vector retention. Compared with the uncompressed index using the same backbone, it preserves between 97% and 99% of average nDCG@5 while reducing stored document vectors by between 90% and 95%. At 5% retention, it also reduces ranking flips relative to geometric merging on all six ColQwen2.5 datasets by approximately 41% on average. The same model transfers to unseen datasets and retention ratios without retraining.

</details>


### [369] [Position Bias Undermines Preference Consistency in Listwise LLM-Based Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03091)
*Ethan Bito,Yongli Ren,Estrid He*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）作为列表式重排序器时对候选排列顺序的敏感性（位置偏差）。作者提出一个评估框架，从成对偏好不稳定、全局偏好不一致性和列表输出一致性三个层面量化LLM重排序器对候选顺序的依赖程度。实验表明这些一致性指标相互关联，但与推荐效果和边际位置暴露偏差可能脱节，说明仅减少暴露偏差不足以保证LLM重排序函数的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为列表式重排序器在推荐系统中表现优异，但推荐候选集本质上是无序集合，重排序器不应依赖序列化时的任意顺序。然而解码器架构的LLM可能受输入顺序影响模型分数、成对偏好和最终排序。现有研究大多只关注最终排序列表的变化，缺乏对重排序过程内部偏好系统稳定性的系统性评估，因此需要更细粒度的框架来衡量位置偏差的影响。

Method: 将等价候选排列下产生的排序视为对一个偏好系统的多次观测，引入三个层级的评估指标：(1)成对偏好不稳定性（衡量任意候选对之间的偏好翻转程度）；(2)全局偏好不一致性（衡量整体偏好结构是否有矛盾）；(3)列表输出一致性（衡量最终排序输出的一致性）。在多个LLM、数据集和列表长度上开展实验，并与推荐效果和边际位置暴露偏差进行对比分析。

Result: 实验发现：(1)三个一致性指标之间紧密对齐；(2)一致性指标与推荐效果和边际位置暴露偏差可能发散；(3)提升相关性或使各位置暴露平坦化并不能修复成对偏好不稳定、全局偏好结构不一致或排序输出不一致的问题。

Conclusion: 仅减少边际位置暴露偏差不足以确立LLM重排序函数在推荐系统中的有效性。需要对LLM重排序器引入更强的顺序不变性约束或开发新的校准方法，以确保重排序结果不依赖候选输入的任意排列顺序。代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising listwise rerankers for recommender systems, but their reliability under equivalent candidate permutations remains unclear. Since recommendation candidates form an unordered set, a reranker should not depend on the arbitrary order used to serialize them. However, decoder-only LLM rerankers can allow input order to affect model scores, pairwise preferences, and rankings. We study how position bias affects the ranking process induced by LLM-based rerankers. Instead of measuring only changes in final ranked lists, we treat rankings produced under equivalent candidate permutations as observations of an induced preference system. We introduce an evaluation framework measuring pairwise preference instability, global preference inconsistency, and listwise output consistency. This framework characterizes candidate-order sensitivity at the pairwise, global, and output levels. Experiments across multiple LLMs, datasets, and list lengths show that these consistency measures are closely aligned, but can diverge from recommendation effectiveness and marginal position-exposure bias. Improving relevance or flattening exposure across positions does not necessarily restore stable pairwise preferences, globally coherent preference structures, or consistent ranked outputs. These results show that reducing marginal exposure skew is insufficient to establish ranking-function validity in LLM-based reranking. Code is available at https://github.com/ejbito/InvariRank .

</details>


### [370] [Attacking and Defending Multi-Agent Collaborative Filtering Systems Through Connectivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03272)
*Anjun Hu,Hanting Xie,Saranya Govindan,Jas Kandola,Kurt Cutajar*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文研究了多智能体协同过滤（CF）系统中，系统连通性（候选数量和目录集中度）如何调制攻击与防御的效果。作者将多智能体系统（MAS）中的攻击和防御方法适配到基于AgentCF框架的CF场景，系统性地评估了连通性变化对攻击和防御结果的影响，并探索了流行病学启发的静态指标用于高效评估鲁棒性的可能性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体协同过滤系统结合了数据驱动和智能体交互的特性，继承了两种来源的漏洞，但独特的漏洞展现方式尚未被充分理解。理解连通性如何调制系统脆弱性，有助于开发更鲁棒的推荐流水线。

Method: 作者在AgentCF框架中：(1) 将通用MAS文献中的攻击和防御方法适配到智能体CF领域，验证原始发现的迁移性；(2) 沿两个连通性轴（候选数量衡量用户侧交互密度，目录集中度衡量项目目录跨用户重叠程度）系统性地变化连通性，评估攻击和防御效果；(3) 探索使用流行病学启发的静态指标来排名CF配置的预期攻击结果，以实现成本高效的鲁棒性评估。

Result: 发现了用户与项目智能体之间的角色不对称性、攻击效能的非单调时序动态，以及传播型和提取型攻击目标之间的分化模式。MAS启发的攻击和防御在CF领域部分可迁移。

Conclusion: 连通性的两个维度（候选数量和目录集中度）显著影响CF系统的攻击和防御结果，流行病学启发的静态指标有望支持低成本鲁棒性评估，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multi-agent collaborative filtering (CF) systems coordinate autonomous LLM-powered user and item agents through natural-language interaction to refine preferences and generate recommendations. These systems inherit vulnerabilities from both their data-driven nature and their multi-agent interactions, which manifest in distinct ways. Understanding how connectivity modulates vulnerability in these systems could facilitate the development of more robust recommendation pipelines.
  In this work, we adapt attacks and defenses from the general multi-agent systems (MAS) literature to the agent-based CF setting, evaluating them under systematically varied connectivity in the AgentCF framework, where CF connectivity is characterized along two axes: (i) candidate count (the number of item candidates per turn per user, measuring user-side interaction density) and (ii) catalog concentration (the degree of item catalog overlap across users).
  Our contributions include: (1) Adaptation: we reproduce MAS-inspired attacks and defenses in the agentic CF domain, confirming partial transferability of original observations. (2) Characterization: we characterize how the two aspects of connectivity shape attack and defense outcomes, revealing role asymmetries between user and item agents, non-monotonic temporal dynamics in attack efficacy, and divergent patterns across dissemination and extraction attack goals. Additionally, as an exploratory extension, we assess the applicability of epidemic-inspired static metrics in ranking CF configurations by expected attack outcome, potentially enabling cost-efficient robustness assessment. Implementation is available at https://github.com/anjunhu/ConnACF

</details>


### [371] [LLM-Derived Priors for Thompson Sampling in Cold-Start Comment Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03382)
*Eugene Lee,Oseong Choi,Byungsoo Kang,Taeyeong Jang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出利用大语言模型从用户生成的文本评论中提取语义信号，将其转化为贝叶斯先验，用于热启动多臂老虎机（特别是Thompson采样）在线推荐系统，以缓解新候选臂（文本评论）的冷启动问题。通过真实在线A/B/C测试验证了LLM先验在稀疏反馈场景下的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多臂老虎机算法（尤其是Thompson采样）虽能在线适应反馈，但新加入的候选臂缺乏交互历史时存在冷启动问题。本文场景中候选臂是用户生成的文本评论，其语义内容可以先于交互反馈揭示标题吸引力，因此可以利用LLM提取语义信号来缓解冷启动。

Method: 1) 使用LLM从评论文本中提取语义信号，转化为贝叶斯先验来热启动Thompson采样。2) 提出两种LLM先验设计：Gender Prior（人口统计亲和线索）和Content Prior（标题特定身份线索）。3) 对不同性别-年龄细分群体分别维护和更新后验分布，以捕捉聚合段间响应模式差异。4) 在真实在线A/B/C测试中与均匀先验进行比较。

Result: LLM先验在稀疏反馈场景下收益最大，尤其是在积累少量交互证据后增益最显著；不同的先验设计导致不同的漏斗层面效应。点击导向的对齐对Gender Prior最强，治疗效果在不同人口统计细分群体间差异显著。

Conclusion: LLM派生的先验可作为文本密集型老虎机推荐系统的实用热启动机制，同时揭示了部署中的权衡取舍。

Abstract: Multi-armed bandit algorithms, especially Thompson sampling, are widely used in online recommendation. Despite their ability to adapt from online feedback, these methods often suffer from cold-start limitations when newly introduced arms have little or no interaction history. In our setting, the candidate arms are user-generated textual comments, whose semantic content can reveal a title's appeal before sufficient interaction feedback is available. We therefore use large language models (LLMs) to extract semantic signals from comment text and convert them into informative Bayesian priors that warm-start Thompson sampling under sparse early-stage feedback. To account for aggregate segment-level differences in response patterns, we maintain and update posteriors separately for each gender-age segment. In a real-world online A/B/C test, we compare a uniform prior with two LLM-based designs: a Gender Prior for demographic-affinity cues and a Content Prior for title-specific identity cues. The results show that LLM-based priors are most beneficial in sparse-feedback regimes -- with the largest gains emerging once a small amount of interaction evidence has accumulated -- and that prior design leads to distinct funnel-level effects. We further analyze prior-reward alignment and demographic heterogeneity, finding that click-oriented alignment is strongest for the Gender Prior and that treatment effects vary substantially across demographic segments. These findings suggest that LLM-derived priors can serve as a practical warm-start mechanism for text-rich bandit recommendation, while also revealing deployment trade-offs.

</details>


### [372] [Training Documents Reranker with Search Rubrics for Deep Research Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03527)
*Wenhan Liu,Yu Lu,Qiaolin Xia,Hui Xu,Tong Zhao,Jian Xi,Yutao Zhu,Haijin Liang,Haibo Shi,Hao Wang,Zhicheng Dou*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出RubricRanker，一种面向搜索的文档重排序器，通过分层搜索准则（rubrics）显式定义代理查询所需的高质量文档集合应满足的要求，并采用两阶段训练框架（准则引导的监督微调+基于准则的强化学习）来提升深度研究代理的文档检索质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索器通常通过相关性匹配选择文档，但单个匹配良好的top-k文档组合起来可能无法满足代理查询的复杂信息需求（如多样性、简洁性、权威性）。因此需要一种能显式定义文档集合质量要求的检索方法。

Method: 1）提出搜索导向的准则（search rubrics），用强大LLM合成分层结构化的质量要求；2）基于这些准则训练文档重排序器RubricRanker；3）设计两阶段训练框架：准则引导的监督微调（SFT）+基于准则的强化学习（RL）。

Result: 在四个深度研究基准上，RubricRanker比最强基线高出2.6个点，并在五个RAG基准上表现出良好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 通过显式定义和利用搜索准则，可以训练出更好的文档重排序器，显著提升深度研究代理和RAG系统中的文档集合质量。

Abstract: Retrieval systems help deep research agents generate high-quality answers by providing relevant documents. However, existing retrievers typically select documents through relevance matching, while individually well-matched top-$k$ documents may not form a \textit{set} that satisfies the complex information needs of an agent query (\eg, diverse, concise and authoritative documents). In this paper, we propose search-oriented rubrics that \textit{explicitly} define the requirements that high-quality document sets should satisfy for each agent query. Our search rubrics are organized into a hierarchical structure and synthesized using a powerful LLM. Based on these search rubrics, we further train a document reranker \textbf{RubricRanker} to select a high-quality subset from retrieved documents. We design a two-stage training framework that consists of rubrics-guided supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RubricRanker outperforms the strongest baseline by 2.6 points on four deep research benchmarks and generalizes well to five RAG benchmarks.

</details>


### [373] [SITA: Semantic Interest Tokens for Target-Aware Compression in Long-Sequence Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03692)
*Rui Zhou,Bo Chen,Qinglin Jia,Jiezhou Ji,Chaoyi Ma,Ruiming Tang,Hao Wang,Enhong Chen*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出SITA框架，通过语义量化将用户长期行为压缩为语义结构化的兴趣表示，并基于目标物品的语义标识符自适应聚合对应兴趣，从而在保持压缩表示高效性和可扩展性的同时，实现目标感知的用户建模，在公开数据集和工业数据集上均优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长序列推荐方法面临两难：一种是动态检索目标相关行为，实现目标感知建模但推理开销大；另一种是将整个序列压缩为紧凑用户表示，效率高但缺乏目标特定适应性。核心挑战是如何在保持压缩表示的效率与可扩展性的同时实现目标感知建模。

Method: 提出SITA目标感知压缩框架。通过并行语义量化学习语义标识符，将压缩的兴趣组织成语义结构；根据目标物品的语义标识符，自适应聚合对应的结构化兴趣，构建目标特定的用户表示。

Result: 在公开数据集和大规模工业数据集上的大量实验表明，SITA在保持强可扩展性的同时，一致性地优于代表性基线方法，展现出在真实推荐系统中的强大潜力。

Conclusion: SITA成功弥合了目标感知建模与压缩表示高效性之间的鸿沟，为长序列推荐提供了一种兼具准确性和工业落地可行性的新方案。

Abstract: As user behavior histories continue to grow on modern Internet platforms, effectively modeling long behavior sequences has become crucial for predicting user interests in candidate items. Existing methods have evolved along two directions. One line dynamically retrieves target-relevant behaviors from long histories, enabling target-aware modeling but requiring target-dependent computation during inference. The other line compresses entire behavior sequences into compact user representations, achieving high efficiency and scalability but sacrificing target-specific adaptation due to target-independent encoding. The key challenge is therefore to enable target-aware modeling while preserving the efficiency and scalability of compressed user representations. To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{SITA}, a target-aware compression framework for long-sequence recommendation. SITA enables target-aware compression by organizing compressed interests into semantic structures through semantic identifiers learned via parallel semantic quantization. Conditioned on the semantic identifier of the target item, SITA adaptively aggregates the corresponding structured interests to construct the target-specific user representation. Extensive experiments on public datasets and a large-scale industrial dataset demonstrate that SITA consistently outperforms representative baselines while maintaining strong scalability, highlighting its strong potential for real-world recommender systems.

</details>


### [374] [LegalPincite: Multi-level Legal Information Retrieval Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03756)
*Theresia Veronika Rampisela,Henrik Palmer Olsen,Giovanni Colavizza*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个大规模法律信息检索（IR）数据集，基于欧洲法院（CJEU）判决构建，解决了现有数据集缺乏段落级引用标注、查询文本存在数据泄漏以及语料库不完整等问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律信息检索需要精确定位到具体段落（pincites），但现有公开数据集要么缺乏段落级引用标注，要么存在查询文本数据泄漏，并且排除了既未被引用也未引用其他段落的段落，导致检索设置不切实际且过于简化，可能造成性能虚高。

Method: 从欧洲法院（CJEU）判决中构建大规模法律IR数据集，包括：（i）去除引用信息的掩蔽案例/段落查询；（ii）包含所有段落的完整语料库；（iii）案例级和段落级地面真实引用标注，并经过部分人类专家验证。数据集支持多种检索粒度：案例到案例、段落到案例、段落到段落。

Result: 提供了支持多粒度法律IR检索评估的大规模数据集，涵盖案例到案例、段落到案例和段落到段落三种检索级别，并附有人类专家部分验证的标注。

Conclusion: 该数据集为法律IR方法的开发和严格评估提供了更现实、更完整的基础，克服了现有数据集的局限性，可通过Hugging Face公开获取。

Abstract: A common task in legal Information Retrieval (IR) is to find relevant legal sources from case-law collections. While legal practice often requires pinpoint citations (pincites) to specific case paragraphs, most existing public legal IR datasets lack paragraph-level citation annotations. Yet, publicly available datasets with such information contain data leakage in the query text and exclude paragraphs that are neither citing nor cited from the corpora, creating an unrealistic and oversimplified retrieval setting, potentially leading to inflated performance. To address these limitations, we contribute a large-scale legal IR dataset constructed from Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) judgments. The dataset contains: (i) masked case/paragraph queries, with removed citation information; (ii) a corpus that includes all paragraphs; and (iii) case- and paragraph-level ground-truth citations, with partial human expert validation. Our dataset supports both the development and rigorous evaluation of legal IR methods, at multiple query-document levels (case-to-case, paragraph-to-case, and paragraph-to-paragraph retrieval). Link to dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/theresiavr/legalpincite

</details>


### [375] [ATLAS: Learning to Recommend Across Unseen Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03899)
*Pervez Shaik,Prosenjit Biswas,Abhinav Thorat,Ravi Kolla,Niranjan Pedanekar*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出ATLAS框架，通过Gromov-Wasserstein对齐、对抗训练和残差向量量化，在多个异构源域上学习域不变的共享用户-物品表示，实现对完全未见目标域的零样本推荐，无需目标域适配或LLM预训练。在5个Amazon领域训练并直接应用于10个未见领域，平均HitRate相对提升24%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推荐系统受限于特定领域：在一个交互环境训练的模型无法直接部署到新目录。已有方法要么只迁移受限形式的推荐知识，要么需要目标域适配，要么依赖LLM获取可迁移表示。本文想要探索一个更根本的问题：仅从多个异构域学习到的推荐特定知识，能否不经过目标域适配或语言模型预训练，直接泛化到完全未见的领域。

Method: ATLAS框架包含三个核心组件：1) Gromov-Wasserstein对齐，保序跨域用户间关系；2) 对抗目标，使物品表示在跨域间不可区分；3) 残差向量量化（RVQ）码本，将用户和物品嵌入压缩到离散潜空间，捕获层次化交互模式同时抑制域特定变异。

Result: 在5个Amazon领域训练、直接应用于10个未见领域，ATLAS在大多数未见域上优于最先进的序列、图基、跨域、量化基和LLM基线方法，平均HitRate相对提升24%。消融实验和表示分析验证了各组件有效性，并发现源域多样性效应显著：增加源域异质性可大幅提升零样本迁移性能。

Conclusion: ATLAS证明了推荐域泛化作为零样本推荐的新范式是可行的，无需目标域适配或LLM预训练即可实现跨领域推荐，为推荐系统的可扩展性和泛化能力开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Recommender systems remain domain-bound: a model trained on one interaction environment typically requires retraining or target-domain adaptation before it can operate on a new catalogue. A recommender trained on movies cannot be directly deployed to recommend groceries or video games. Existing approaches mitigate this by transferring restricted forms of recommendation knowledge, adapting to the target domain, or leveraging large language models (LLMs) for transferable representations. We instead ask whether recommendation-specific knowledge learned solely from multiple heterogeneous domains can generalize to entirely unseen domains without target-domain adaptation or language-model pretraining. We introduce ATLAS, a multi-source recommendation domain generalization framework that learns a shared, domain-invariant user-item representation from disjoint source domains, enabling zero-shot recommendation on unseen domains. ATLAS combines a Gromov-Wasserstein alignment that preserves how users relate to one another across domains, an adversarial objective that makes item representations indistinguishable across domains, and residual vector quantization (RVQ) codebooks that compress user and item embeddings into a discrete latent space, capturing hierarchical interaction patterns while suppressing domain-specific variation. Trained on five Amazon domains and applied directly to ten unseen domains, ATLAS outperforms state-of-the-art sequential, graph-based, cross-domain, quantization-based, and LLM-based baselines on most unseen domains, with an average relative gain in HitRate of 24%. Ablations and representation analyses validate each component, and we identify a pronounced source-domain diversity effect: increasing source heterogeneity substantially improves zero-shot transfer. ATLAS establishes recommendation domain generalization as a promising paradigm for zero-shot recommendation.

</details>


### [376] [Conditionally Identifiable Latent-Environment Modeling for Out-of-Distribution Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03647)
*Qianqian Wang,Wenwu Gong,Yunshan Li,Zhenqing Wu,Ruili Wang,Lili Yang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出CILER框架，用于解决OOD推荐中潜伏环境引起的偏好漂移问题。通过用户条件指数族建模潜伏环境，用特征索引多项式刻画环境对偏好的影响，实现了条件可识别的风险感知推荐，并在三个数据集上提升了全部12项OOD排序指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OOD推荐容易受到潜伏环境引起的偏好漂移影响，现有方法虽然能从日志交互中推断潜伏状态，但潜伏环境的统计意义及其对偏好的影响机制仍未被充分定义和识别，导致模型的可解释性和泛化性受限。

Method: 1) 将任务形式化为条件可识别的风险感知推荐（CI-RR）；2) 使用用户条件指数族（user-conditioned exponential family）建模潜伏环境；3) 使用特征索引多项式（feature-indexed polynomial）刻画环境如何改变用户偏好；4) 通过在推断的环境分布上对物品概率进行边际化来预测；5) 在充分变异性、正确设定和编码器正则性条件下，实现了环境敏感表示的条件可识别。

Result: 在三个数据集上的特征漂移、时间漂移和地理漂移（共享支持范围内）实验中，CILER在全部12项OOD排序指标上均取得提升。此外，受控实验验证了充分变异性和模型设定对可识别性的影响。

Conclusion: CILER通过条件可识别的潜伏环境建模，为OOD推荐提供了坚实的统计基础，并通过理论界定了环境推断误差与部署风险之间的关系。实验证明了其在多种OOD场景下的有效性，为可解释且鲁棒的OOD推荐系统提供了新方向。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) recommendation is vulnerable to preference shifts induced by a latent environment. Existing methods can infer latent states from logged interactions, yet the statistical meaning of the latent environment and its effect on preference remain underdetermined. We formulate this task as conditionally identifiable risk-aware recommendation (CI-RR) and propose Conditionally Identifiable Latent-Environment Recommendation (CILER). CILER uses a user-conditioned exponential family to model the latent environment and a feature-indexed polynomial to specify how it changes preference. It predicts by marginalizing item probabilities over the inferred environment distribution. Under sufficient variation, correct specification, and decoder regularity, CILER identifies the environment-sensitive representation up to the stated equivalence class. We further bound excess deployment log-risk by environment-inference error. Controlled studies test the observable consequences of sufficient variation and model specification. Experiments on three datasets show that CILER improves all twelve OOD ranking metrics under feature, temporal, and geographical shifts within shared support.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [377] [Self-Organising Digital Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02606)
*Marcello Barylli,Gabriel Béna,Alexander Mordvintsev,Eleni Nisioti,Sebastian Risi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出自组织数字电路（Self-Organising Digital Circuits），将数字电路的逻辑生成与维护建模为图上的元学习问题，使用拓扑掩码Transformer配置布尔门查找表（LUT），实现电路从零自组装、硬件故障下的快速逻辑重路由以及软错误下的高精度恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统容错计算依赖静态策略（如硬件冗余、纠错码），而生物系统通过动态重组适应损伤。作者希望借鉴生物自组织原理，实现数字电路的自适应故障容错能力。

Method: 将功能逻辑生成与维护视为图上的元学习问题，采用拓扑掩码Transformer配置电路布尔门的查找表（LUT）。以神经细胞自动机（NCA）的模式生成范式为基础，但导航的是退化布尔搜索空间以完成任务，而非再生固定目标状态。

Result: 电路可从零自组装出功能电路；面对永久性未见硬件故障可快速重路由逻辑；对于软错误，在远超训练条件的损伤规模下达到>99.99%的恢复准确率；在远宽于训练图的电路规模上表现出泛化能力提升。

Conclusion: 该工作将生物自组织原理与数字硬件实践相结合，展示了自组织数字电路在自适应容错方面的潜力。

Abstract: Fault tolerance in classical computing has traditionally relied on static strategies like hardware redundancy and error-correcting codes. Biological systems, in contrast, exhibit adaptive plasticity, maintaining function through dynamic re-organisation around damage. Inspired by this principle, we introduce Self-Organising Digital Circuits, framing functional logic generation and maintenance as a meta-learning problem on graphs. Our architecture employs a topology-masked Transformer that configures the Lookup Tables (LUT) of a circuit's Boolean gates. Extending the pattern-generation paradigm of Neural Cellular Automata (NCA), it navigates the degenerate Boolean search space to satisfy a computational task, rather than regenerating a fixed target state. We demonstrate that it can self-assemble functional circuits from scratch and rapidly re-route logic around permanent, previously unseen hardware faults. For soft errors, the policy achieves near-perfect recovery (>99.99\% accuracy) from damage sizes far exceeding training conditions. We further observe generalisation across circuit scales: accuracy improves on graphs substantially wider than those seen during training. This work bridges the principles of biological self-organisation with the practical domain of digital hardware.

</details>


### [378] [ISEE: Interactive Semantic Enrichment for Database Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02604)
*Yuan Tian,Yiru Chen,Rakesh R. Menon,Zifan Liu,Ting Cai,Fei Wu,Anudeep Chimakurthi,Prashanthi Ramamurthy,Sridevi Aishwariya Ganesan,Kun Qian,Yunyao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了ISEE（Interactive SEmantic Enrichment）系统，旨在解决LLM智能体在数据任务中因字段描述模糊或不完整而导致的性能下降问题。ISEE通过评分系统衡量描述质量、收集领域知识，并与用户协作丰富数据语义。通过用户研究、自动化用户模拟、定量评估和案例研究，证明该系统能显著降低认知负担、提升描述质量并改善下游任务（如实体链接）的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在数据感知、探索和检索等任务中的性能严重依赖数据语义的清晰度和完整性。然而现实中许多字段描述模糊或不完整，因为关键上下文（如自定义字段的含义）来自用户的领域知识，很少被公开记录，这限制了智能体在下游任务（如实体链接）中的表现。

Method: 提出ISEE（Interactive SEmantic Enrichment）系统：1）通过评分系统衡量给定数据字段描述的质量；2）收集用户的领域知识；3）与用户协作，交互式地丰富和增强数据语义。

Result: 通过用户研究、自动化用户模拟、定量评估和案例研究，验证了ISEE系统能够显著降低用户的认知负荷、提高字段描述质量，并增强下游任务（如实体链接）的性能。

Conclusion: ISEE是一个有效的交互式语义增强系统，填补了数据字段语义信息缺失的空白，为提升LLM智能体在数据相关任务中的表现提供了可行方案。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly being deployed for data-related tasks, including data sense-making, exploration, and retrieval. However, their performance heavily depends on the clarity and completeness of data semantics. In practice, many field descriptions remain ambiguous or incomplete, as much of the essential context (e.g., the meaning of a customized field) originates from users' domain knowledge and is rarely documented publicly. This gap restricts the agents' task performance in downstream tasks, such as entity-linking. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel and comprehensive Interactive SEmantic Enrichment system (ISEE). Given a data field description, ISEE measures its quality through a scoring system, gathers domain knowledge, and collaboratively enriches the semantics with users. Through a user study, automated user simulation, quantitative evaluation, and case study, we demonstrate that ISEE significantly reduces cognitive load, improves description quality, and enhances downstream task performance.

</details>


### [379] [Rethinking Modality Reliability in Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Incomplete Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03611)
